Bava Batra 9b:7-10a:1: Amar rabbi elazar: gadol haose tzedaka basseter, yoter mimmoshe rabbenu – deillu bemoshe rabbenu ketiv: "ki yagorti mippene haaf vehachema", veillu beose tzedaka ketiv: "mattan basseter yichpe af, [veshochad bachek chema azza]". ufeliga derabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: af kofe, chema eno kofe; shenneemar: "veshochad bachek chema azza" – af al pi sheshshochad bachek – chema azza. ikka deamri, amar rabbi yitzchak: kol dayyayn shennotel shochad – mevi chema azza laolam [shenneemar: veshochad bachek vegomer].

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: kol hannoten peruta leani – mitbarech beshesh berachot, vehamefayyeyso bidvarim – mitbarech beachat esre berachot. hannoten peruta leani mitbarech beshesh berachot – dichtiv: "halo faros vegomer, vaaniyyim merudim tavi vayit (vegomer) ki tire arom vegomer".

Vehamefayyeyso bidvarim mitbarech beachat esre berachot – shenneemar: "vetafek laraev nafshecha venefesh naana tasbia, vezarach bachoshech orecha vaafelatcha katztzohorayim. venachacha Adonai tamid, vehisbia betzachtzachot nafshecha vegomer, uvanu mimmecha chorvot olam, mosde dor vador tekomem vegomer".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "rodef tzedaka vachased yimtza chayyim tzedaka vechavod"? mishshum derodef tzedaka – yimtza tzedaka?! ella lomar lach: kol harodef achar tzedaka – hakkadosh baruch hu mamtzi lo maot veose bahen tzedaka.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: hakkadosh baruch hu mamtzi lo bene adam hamehugganim laasot lahen tzedaka, kede lekabbel alehem secharo. leappoke may? leappoke middedaresh rabba – dedaresh rabba, may dichtiv: "veyihyu muchshalim lefanecha, beet appecha ase bahem"? amar yirmeya lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, [afillu] beshaa shekkofin et yitzran umevakkeshin laasot tzedaka lefanecha, hacheshilem bivne adam sheenan mehugganin, kede shello yekabbelu alehen sachar.
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: kol haragil laasot tzedaka – zoche, havyin lo banim baale chochma, baale osher, baale aggada. baale chochma – dichtiv:
"Yimtza chayyim". baale osher – dichtiv: "tzedaka". baale aggada – dichtiv: "vechavod" – ketiv hacha: "vechavod", uchetiv hatam: "kavod chachamim yinchalu".
Berakhot 14b:24-15a:5: Amar ulla: kol hakkore keriat shema belo tefillin, keillu meid edut sheker beatzmo. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: keillu hikriv ola belo mincha, vezevach belo nesachim.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: harotze sheyyekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim shelema
Yippane, veyittol yadav, veyanniach tefillin, veyikra keriat shema, veyitpallel, vezo hi malchut shamayim shelema.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hannifne, venotel yadav, umanniach tefillin, vekore keriat shema, umitpallel — maale alav hakkatuv keillu bana mizbeach vehikriv alav korban, dichtiv: "erchatz benikkayon kappay vaasovva et mizbachacha Adonai". amar leh rava: la savar la mar keillu taval, dichtiv: "erchatz [benikkayon]" — vela katav "architz [kappay]".
Amar leh ravina lerava: chazi mar hay tzureba merabbanan daata mimmareva veamar: mi sheen lo mayim lirchotz yadav — mekanneach yadav beafar uvitzror uvekismit.
Amar leh: shappir kaamar, mi ketiv "erchatz bemayim"? "benikkayon" ketiv — kol midde dimnakke, deha rav chisda layet amman dimhaddar ammayya beiddan tzelota.
Vehane mille likriat shema, aval litfilla mehaddar. vead kamma? — ad parsa. vehane mille lekammeh, aval laachoreh — afillu mil eno chozer. [uminna] mil hu deeno chozer, ha pachot mimmil — chozer.
I Kings 18:20-25: Vayyishlach achav bechol-bene yisrael vayyikbotz et-hanneviim el-har hakkarmel
Vayyiggash eliyyahu el-kol-haam vayyomer ad-matay attem poschim al-shete hasseippim im-Adonai haelohim lechu acharav veim-habbaal lechu acharav velo-anu haam oto davar
Vayyomer eliyyahu el-haam ani notarti navi laAdonai levaddi unevie habbaal arba-meot vachamishshim ish
Veyittenu-lanu shenayim parim veyivcharu lahem happar haechad vinattechuhu veyasimu al-haetzim veesh lo yasimu vaani eese ׀ et-happar haechad venatatti al-haetzim veesh lo asim
Ukeratem beshem elohechem vaani ekra veshem-Adonai vehaya haelohim asher-yaane vaesh hu haelohim vayyaan kol-haam vayyomru tov haddavar
Vayyomer eliyyahu linvie habbaal bacharu lachem happar haechad vaasu rishona ki attem harabbim vekiru beshem elohechem veesh lo tasimu
I Kings 18:26-29: Vayyikchu et-happar asher-natan lahem vayyaasu vayyikreu veshem-habbaal mehabboker vead-hatztzohorayim lemor habbaal anenu veen kol veen one vayfassechu al-hammizbeach asher asa
Vayhi vatztzohorayim vayhattel bahem eliyyahu vayyomer kiru vekol-gadol ki-elohim hu ki siach vechi-sig lo vechi-derech lo ulay yashen hu veyikatz
Vayyikreu bekol gadol vayyitgoddu kemishpatam bacharavot uvarmachim ad-shefoch-dam alehem
Vayhi kaavor hatztzohorayim vayyitnabbeu ad laalot hammincha veen-kol veen-one veen kashev
I Kings 18:30-34: Vayyomer eliyyahu lechol-haam geshu elay vayyiggeshu chol-haam elav vayrappe et-mizbach Adonai heharus
Vayyikkach eliyyahu shetem esre avanim kemispar shivte vene-yaakov asher haya devar-Adonai elav lemor yisrael yihye shemecha
Vayyivne et-haavanim mizbeach beshem Adonai vayyaas teala kevet satayim zera saviv lammizbeach
Vayyaaroch et-haetzim vaynattach et-happar vayyasem al-haetzim
Vayyomer milu arbaa chaddim mayim veyitzku al-haola veal-haetzim vayyomer shenu vayyishnu vayyomer shalleshu vayshalleshu
I Kings 18:35-40: Vayyelchu hammayim saviv lammizbeach vegam et-hatteala mille-mayim

Vayhi ׀ baalot hammincha vayyiggash eliyyahu hannavi vayyomar Adonai elohe avraham yitzchak veyisrael hayyom yivvada ki-atta elohim beyisrael vaani avdecha (vabedaberaych) [uvidvarcha] asiti et kol-haddevarim haelle
Aneni Adonai aneni veyedu haam hazze ki-atta Adonai haelohim veatta hasibbota et-libbam achorannit
Vattippol esh-Adonai vattochal et-haola veet-haetzim veet-haavanim veet-heafar veet-hammayim asher-batteala lichecha
Vayyar kol-haam vayyippelu al-penehem vayyomru Adonai hu haelohim Adonai hu haelohim
Vayyomer eliyyahu lahem tifsu ׀ et-nevie habbaal ish al-yimmalet mehem vayyitpesum vayyoridem eliyyahu el-nachal kishon vayyishchatem sham
I Kings 18:41-45: Vayyomer eliyyahu leachav ale echol ushete ki-kol hamon haggashem
Vayyaale achav leechol velishtot veeliyyahu ala el-rosh hakkarmel vayyighar artza vayyasem panav ben birkav
Vayyomer el-naaro ale-na habbet derech-yam vayyaal vayyabbet vayyomer en meuma vayyomer shuv sheva peamim
Vayhi bashsheviit vayyomer hinne-av ketanna kechaf-ish ola miyyam vayyomer ale emor el-achav esor vared velo yaatzorcha haggashem
Vayhi ׀ ad-ko vead-ko vehashshamayim hitkadderu avim veruach vayhi geshem gadol vayyirkav achav vayyelech yizreela
Ketubot 64b:18-65b:11: Venoten lah chatzi kav kitnit. veillu yayin la katane. mesayyay leh lerabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar
En poskin yenot laishsha, veim tomar: "elcha achare meahavay notne lachmi umemay tzamri ufishti shamni veshikkuyay" — devarim shehaishsha mishtokeket alehen, umay ninhu — tachshitin.

Daresh rabbi yehuda ish kefar nevirya, veamri la ish kefar nefor chayil: minnayin sheen poskin yenot laishsha — shenneemar: "vattakom channa achare ochla veshilo veachare shato". "shata", velo "shatat".
Ella meatta "achla" velo "ochlo", hachi name?! anan middeshanni kera bedibbureh kaamrinan. mikkede begavva ka asek veate, may tama shanni? shema minna "shata" velo "shatat".
Metivi: regila — notnin lah! regila shane, deamar rav chinnana bar kahana amar shemuel: regila — notnin lah kos echad. sheenah regila — notnin lah shene kosot.

May kaamar?! amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: regila, bifne balah — shene kosot, shello bifne valah — notnin lah kos echad. enah regila, bifne valah — ella kos echad, shello bifne valah — en notnin lah kol ikkar.

Vei baet ema: regila, notnin lah letzike kedera. deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: maase bechallato shel nakdimon ben gureyon sheppasku lah chachamim satayim yayin letzike kedera meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. amra lahen: kach tifseku livnotechem. tana: shomeret yavam hayta, velo anu achareha amen.

Tana: kos echad — yafe laishsha. shenayim — niuul hu. shelosha — tovaat bappe. arbaa — afillu chamor tovaat bashshuk veenah makpedet. amar rava: lo shanu ella sheen balah immah. aval balah immah, let lan ba.

Veha channa, devalah immah havay! achsenay shane. deamar rav huna: minnayin leachsenay sheasur betashmish hammitta, shenneemar: "vayyashkimu vabboker vayyishtachavu lifne Adonai vayyashuvu vayyavou el betam haramata vayyeda elkana et channa ishto vayyizkereha Adonai", hasheta — in, meikkara — la.

Chuma devethu deabbaye atay lekammeh derava, amara leh: pesok li mezone! pesak la. pesok li chamra! amar leh: yadana beh benachmani dela hava shate chamra. amara leh: chayye demar dahava mashke li beshuferaze ki hay. bahade deka machveya leh iggalli deraa, nefal nehora beve dina.

Kam rava, al leveteh tava levat rav chisda. amara leh bat rav chisda: man havay haiddana beve dina? amar la: chuma devethu deabbaye. nafka abbatra, machata lah bekulefe deshidda ad deappeka la mikkulle machoza. amra la: ketalt lich telata, veatet lemiktal acharina?!
Devethu derav yosef bereh derava atay lekammeh derav nechemya bereh derav yosef. amara leh: pesok li mezone! pesak la. pesok li chamra! pesak la. amar la: yadana behu bivne machoza deshatu chamra.

Devethu derav yosef bereh derav menashsheya middevil atay lekammeh derav yosef. amara leh: pesok li mezone! pesak la. pesok li chamra! pesak la. pesok li shirae! amar la: shirae lema? amara leh: lach ulechavrach ulechavrurach.
Venoten lah mitta umappatz vechulei. mappatz umachtzelet lema la deyahev la? amar rav pappa: beatra dinhigi demalu pureya bechavle, demavgar la.
Tanu rabbanan: en notnin lah kar vacheset. mishshum rabbi natan amru: notnin lah kar vacheset. hechi dame: i deorcha, may tama detanna kamma? vei delav orcha, may tama derabbi natan?

La tzericha, kegon deorcheh dideh velav orcha dida. tanna kamma savar, amar la: ki azelna shakelna lehu, vechi atena, mayytena lehu bahaday. verabbi natan savar: amara leh: zimnin demitreme ben hashshemashot vela matzet mayytet lehu, veshaklat lehu ledidi umagnet li al ara.
Venoten lah kippa. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye:

Hay tanna sheliach artilay ureme mesane! amar leh: tanna bimkom harim kae, dela saggi bela telata zuge mesane. veaggav orcheh ka mashma lan denittevinhu nihala bammoed, ki hechi denehve la simcha begavvayyhu.

Vechelim shel chamishshim zuz. amar abbaye: chamishshim zuze peshite. mimmay? middekatane: bamme devarim amurim — beani shebbeyisrael, aval bimchubbad — hakkol lefi kevodo. vei salka datach chamishshim zuz mammash, ani, chamishshim zuz mena leh? ella shema minna chamishshim zuze peshite.

Veen notnin lah lo chadashim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: motar mezonot labbaal, motar belaot laishsha. motar belaot laishsha, lema la? amar rachava: shemmitkassa bahen bime niddatah, kede shello titganne al balah.
Amar abbaye: naktinan, motar belaot almana leyorshav. hatam hu dela titganne beappeh, hacha — titganne vetitganne.
Noten lah maa kesef vechulei. may "ochelet"? rav nachman amar: ochelet mammash. rav ashe amar: tashmish.

Tenan: ochelet immo lele shabbat. bishlama leman deamar achila — hayeynu dekatane "ochelet", ella leman deamar tashmish, may "ochelet"? lishshana mealleya, kedichtiv: "achla umachata fiha veamra lo faalti aven".

Metivi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ochelet belele shabbat veshabbat. bishlama leman deamar achila — hayeynu dekatane "veshabbat". ella leman deamar tashmish — tashmish beshabbat mi ikka? vehaamar rav huna: yisrael kedoshim hen, veen meshammeshin mittotehen bayyom! haamar rava: bevayit afel muttar.
Veim hayta menika. daresh rabbi ulla rabba appitcha deve nesia: af al pi sheamru en adam zan et banav uvenotav keshehen ketannim, aval zan ketanne ketannim.
Ad kamma — ad ben shesh, kidrav assi. deamar rav assi: katan ben shesh yotze beeruv immo.
Mimmay? middekatane: hayta menika — pochatin lah mimmaase yadeha, umosifin lah al mezonoteha. may tama? lav mishshum devae lemechal bahada? vedilma mishshum dechola hi.
Im ken, litne "im hayta chola", may im hayta menika? vedilma ha ka mashma lan distam menikot cholot ninhu. ittemar, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mosifin lah yayin, shehayyayin yafe lechalav.
Menachot 99a:11-99b:7: Umenalan demaalin? amar rabbi acha bar yaakov: deamar kera "et machtot hachattaim haelle benafshotam veasu otam rikkue fachim tzippuy lammizbeach ki hikrivum lifne Adonai vayyikdashu veyihyu leot livne yisrael" – battechilla tashmishe mizbeach, veachshav gufo shel mizbeach.

"Asher shibbarta vesamtam baaron" – tane rav yosef: melammed shehalluchot veshivre luchot munnachin baaron. mikkan letalmid chacham sheshshachach talmudo mechamat onso, sheen nohagin bo minhag bizzayon.
Shebbittulah shel tora zehu yissudah, dichtiv: "asher shibbarta", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: yishar kochacha sheshshibbarta.
Veamar resh lakish: talmid chacham shessarach, en mevazzin oto befarhesya, shenneemar: "vechashalta hayyom vechashal gam navi immecha layla" – kassehu kallayla.

Veamar resh lakish: kol hameshakkeach davar echad mittalmudo over belav, shenneemar: "hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha meod pen tishkach et haddevarim", vechidrabbi avin amar rabbi ila, deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi ila: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer", "pen", veal" – eno ella lo taase.
Ravina amar: "hishshamer" ufen" shene lavin ninhu. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: bishlosha lavin, shenneemar: "hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha meod pen tishkach et haddevarim".
Yachol afillu mechamat onso? talmud lomar "ufen yasuru millevavcha" – bimsiram millibbo hakkatuv medabber. rabbi dostay berabbi yannay amar: yachol afillu takfa alav mishnato? talmud lomar "rak".

Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: tora nittena bearbaim, uneshama notzra bearbaim. kol hameshammer torato – nishmato mishtammeret, vechol sheeno meshammer et hattora – en nishmato mishtammeret.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: mashal leadam shemmasar tzippor deror leavdo, amar: kimdumme atta sheim atta meabbedah sheani notel mimmecha issar bedameha? nishmatcha ani notel mimmecha!
Mishnah Bava Kamma 1:1-2:1:
Arbaa avot nezikin, hashshor vehabbor vehammave vehahever. lo hare hashshor kahare hammave, velo hare hammave kahare hashshor. velo ze vaze, sheyyesh bahen ruach chayyim, kahare haesh, sheen bo ruach chayyim. velo ze vaze, sheddarkan lelech ulehazzik, kahare habbor, sheen darko lelech ulehazzik. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen, sheddarkan lehazzik ushemiratan alecha. ucheshehizzik, chav hammazzik leshallem tashlume nezek bemetav haaretz: 
Kol shechavti vishmirato, hichsharti et nizko. hichsharti vemiktzat nizko, chavti vetashlumin kehechsher kol nizko. nechasim sheen bahem meila, nechasim shel bene verit, nechasim hameyuchadim, uvechol makom chutz mershut hameyuchedet lammazzik ureshut hannizzak vehammazzik. ucheshehizzik, chav hammazzik leshallem tashlume nezek bemetav haaretz: 
Shum kesef, veshave chesef, bifne vet din, veal pi edim bene chorin bene verit. vehannashim bichlal hannezek. vehannizzak vehammazzik battashlumin: 
Chamishsha tammin vachamishsha muadin, habbehema enah muedet lo liggach velo liggof velo lishshoch velo lirbotz velo livot. hashshen muedet leechol et harauy lah, haregel muedet leshabber bederech hilluchah, veshor hammuad, veshor hammazzik birshut hannizzak, vehaadam. hazzeev vehaari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash, hare ellu muadin. rabbi eliezer omer, bizman shehen bene tarbut, enan muadin. vehannachash muad leolam. ma ben tam lemuad. ella shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo, umuad meshallem nezek shalem min haaliyya: 
Ketzad haregel muedet. leshabber bederech hilluchah. habbehema muedet lehallech kedarkah uleshabber. hayta mevaetet, o shehayu tzerorot menattezin mittachat ragleha veshibbera et hakkelim, meshallem chatzi nezek. darsa al hakkeli veshibberatto, venafal al keli ushevaro, al harishon meshallem nezek shalem, veal haacharon meshallem chatzi nezek. hattarnegolim muadin lehallech kedarkan uleshabber. haya delil kashur beraglav, o shehaya mehaddes umeshabber et hakkelim, meshallem chatzi nezek:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 2:2-5:
Ketzad hashshen muedet. leechol et harauy lah. habbehema muedet leechol perot virakot. achla chesut o chelim, meshallem chatzi nezek. bamme devarim amurim. birshut hannizzak, aval birshut harabbim, patur. im nehenet, meshallem ma shennehenet. ketzad meshallem ma shennehenet. achla mittoch harchava, meshallem ma shennehenet. mitztzidde harchava, meshallem ma shehizzika. mippetach hachanut, meshallem ma shennehenet. mittoch hachanut, meshallem ma shehizzika: 
Hakkelev vehaggedi shekkaftzu merosh haggag veshibberu et hakkelim, meshallem nezek shalem, mippene shehen muadin. hakkelev shennatal charara vehalach laggadish, achal hacharara vehidlik haggadish, al hacharara meshallem nezek shalem, veal haggadish meshallem chatzi nezek: 
Eze hu tam, veeze hu muad. muad, kol sheheidu vo shelosha yamim. vetam, mishsheyyachazor bo shelosha yamim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, muad, sheheidu vo shalosh peamim. vetam, kol sheyyehu hattinokot memashmeshin bo veeno nogeach: 
Shor hammazzik birshut hannizzak ketzad. nagach, nagaf, nashach, ravatz, baat, birshut harabbim, meshallem chatzi nezek. birshut hannizzak, rabbi tarfon omer nezek shalem, vachachamim omrim chatzi nezek. amar lahem rabbi tarfon, uma bimkom shehekel al hashshen veal haregel birshut harabbim, shehu fatur, hechmir alehem birshut hannizzak leshallem nezek shalem, mekom shehechmir al hakkeren birshut harabbim, leshallem chatzi nezek, eno din shennachmir aleha birshut hannizzak leshallem nezek shalem. amru lo, dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, ma virshut harabbim chatzi nezek, af birshut hannizzak chatzi nezek. amar lahem, ani lo adun keren mikkeren, ani adun keren meregel. uma vimkom shehekel al hashshen veal haregel, birshut harabbim, hechmir bakkeren, mekom shehechmir al hashshen veal haregel, birshut hannizzak, eno din shennachmir bakkeren. amru lo, dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, ma birshut harabbim chatzi nezek, af birshut hannizzak chatzi nezek:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 2:6-3:3:
Adam muad leolam, ben shogeg, ben mezid, ben er, ben yashen. simme et en chavero veshibber et hakkelim, meshallem nezek shalem: 
Hammanniach et hakkad birshut harabbim uva acher venitkal bah ushevarah, patur. veim huzzak bah, baal hechavit chayyav benizko. nishbera chaddo birshut harabbim, vehuchlak echad bammayim, o shellaka vacharaseha, chayyav. rabbi yehuda omer, bemitkavven, chayyav. beeno mitkavven, patur: 
Hashshofech mayim birshut harabbim, vehuzzak bahen acher, chayyav benizko. hammatznia et hakkotz, veet hazzechuchit, vehaggoder et gedero bekotzim, vegader shennafal lirshut harabbim, vehuzzeku vahen acherim, chayyav benizkan: 
Hammotzi et tivno veet kashsho lirshut harabbim lizvalim, vehuzzak bahen acher, chayyav benizko, vechol hakkodem bahen zacha. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol hamekalkelin birshut harabbim vehizziku, chayyavin leshallem, vechol hakkodem bahen zacha. hahofech et haggalal birshut harabbim, vehuzzak bahen acher, chayyav benizko:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:4-8:
Shene kaddarin shehayu mehallechin ze achar ze, venitkal harishon venafal, venitkal hashsheni barishon, harishon chayyav benizke sheni: 
Ze ba vechavito, veze ba vekorato, nishbera chaddo shel ze bekorato shel ze, patur, shellaze reshut lehallech velaze reshut lehallech. haya vaal kora rishon, uvaal chavit acharon, nishbera chavit bakkora, patur baal hakkora. veim amad baal hakkora, chayyav. veim amar levaal hechavit amod, patur. haya vaal chavit rishon uvaal kora acharon, nishbera chavit bakkora, chayyav. veim amad baal chavit, patur. veim amar levaal kora amod, chayyav. vechen ze va venero veze vefishtano: 
Shenayim shehayu mehallechin birshut harabbim echad ratz veechad mehallech, o shehayu shenehem ratzim, vehizziku ze et ze, shenehem peturin: 
Hamevakkea birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim vehizzik birshut hayyachid, birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut hayyachid acher, chayyav: 
Shene shevarim tammim shechavlu ze et ze, meshallemim bammotar chatzi nezek. shenehem muadim, meshallemim bammotar nezek shalem. echad tam veechad muad, muad battam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem, tam bammuad meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek. vechen shene anashim shechavlu ze vaze, meshallemim bammotar nezek shalem. adam bemuad umuad beadam, meshallem bammotar nezek shalem. adam betam vetam beadam, adam betam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem, tam beadam meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek. rabbi akiva omer, af tam shechaval beadam, meshallem bammotar nezek shalem:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:9-4:1:
Shor shave mane shennagach shor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa chelum, notel et hashshor. shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa chelum, amar rabbi meir, al ze neemar (Shemot 21) umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo. amar lo rabbi yehuda, vechen halacha, kiyyamta umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo, velo kiyyamta (sham) vegam et hammet yechetzun, veeze, ze shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, vehannevela yafa chamishshim zuz, shezze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet, veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet: 
Yesh chayyav al maase shoro ufatur al maase atzmo, patur al maase shoro vechayyav al maase atzmo. shoro shebbiyyesh, patur, vehu shebbiyyesh, chayyav. shoro shessimme et en avdo, vehippil et shinno, patur, vehu shessimme et en avdo, vehippil et shinno, chayyav. shoro shechaval beaviv veimmo, chayyav, vehu shechaval beaviv veimmo, patur. shoro shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat, chayyav, vehu shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat, patur, mippene shehu mitchayyev benafsho: 
Shor shehaya rodef achar shor acher, vehuzzak, ze omer shorcha hizzik, veze omer lo chi, ella vesela laka, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. hayu shenayim rodfim achar echad, ze omer shorcha hizzik, veze omer shorcha hizzik, shenehem peturin. im hayu shenehen shel ish echad, shenehen chayyavin. haya echad gadol veechad katan, hannizzak omer gadol hizzik, vehammazzik omer lo chi, ella katan hizzik. echad tam veechad muad, hannizzak omer, muad hizzik, vehammazzik omer lo chi, ella tam hizzik, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. hayu hannizzokin shenayim, echad gadol veechad katan, vehammazzikim shenayim, echad gadol veechad katan, hannizzak omer, gadol hizzik et haggadol vekatan et hakkatan, umazzik omer lo chi, ella katan et haggadol vegadol et hakkatan. echad tam veechad muad, hannizzak omer, muad hizzik et haggadol vetam et hakkatan, vehammazzik omer lo chi, ella tam et haggadol umuad et hakkatan, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Shor shennagach arbaa vachamishsha shevarim ze achar ze, yeshallem laacharon shebbahem. veim yesh bo motar, yachazir leshellefanav. veim yesh bo motar, yachazir leshellifne fanav. vehaacharon acharon niskar, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer, shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa chelum, ze notel mane veze notel mane. chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim, haacharon notel mane, veshellefanav, ze notel chamishshim zuz veze notel chamishshim zuz. chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim, haacharon notel mane, veshellefanav, chamishshim zuz, ushenayim harishonim, dinar zahav:
Mishnah Bava Kamma 4:2-5:
Shor shehu muad lemino veeno muad lesheeno mino, muad leadam veeno muad livhema, muad liktannim veeno muad ligdolim, et shehu muad lo meshallem nezek shalem, veet sheeno muad lo meshallem chatzi nezek. amru lifne rabbi yehuda, hare shehaya muad leshabbatot veeno muad lechol. amar lahem, lashshabbatot meshallem nezek shalem, limot hachol meshallem chatzi nezek. ematay hu tam. mishsheyyachazor bo shelosha yeme shabbatot: 
Shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel hekdesh, veshel hekdesh shennagach leshor shel yisrael, patur, shenneemar (Shemot 21) shor reehu, velo shor shel hekdesh. shor shel yisrael shennagach leshor shel nachri, patur. veshel nachri shennagach leshor shel yisrael, ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem: 
Shor shel pikkeach shennagach shor shel cheresh, shote vekatan, chayyav. veshel cheresh, shote vekatan, shennagach shor shel pikkeach, patur. shor shel cheresh, shote vekatan shennagach, bet din maamidin lahen appotroppos umeidin lahen bifne appotroppos. nitpakkach hacheresh, nishtappa hashshote vehigdil hakkatan, chazar letammuto, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, hare hu vechezkato. shor haitztadin eno chayyav mita, shenneemar (Shemot 21) ki yiggach, velo sheyyaggichuhu: 
Shor shennagach et haadam vamet, muad, meshallem kofer, vetam, patur min hakkofer. veze vaze chayyavim mita. vechen beven vechen bevat. nagach eved o ama, noten sheloshim selaim, ben shehu yafe mane uven sheeno yafe ella dinar echad:
Mishnah Kelim 16:8-17:3: Tik hassayif vehassakkin vehappigyon, tik misperet umisparayim vehattaar, tik michchol, uvet hakkochal, tik machtev, uterunetek, tik tavla usekorteya, bet hachitztzim, bet happagoshot, hare ellu temeim. tik simponya, bizman shehu noten milmala, tame. mitztziddo, tahor. tik chalilin, rabbi yehuda metaher, mippene shehu notno mitztziddo. chippuy haalla, hakkeshet, veharomach, hare ellu tehorin. ze hakkelal, heasuy letik, tame. lechippuy, tahor:

Kol kele vaale vattim, shiuran berimmonim. rabbi eliezer omer, bema shehen. kuppot haggannanim, shiuran baaguddot shel yarak. shel baale vattim, beteven. shel ballanin, bigvava. rabbi yehoshua omer, kullan berimmonim:

Hachemet, shiurah bifkaiyyot shel sheti. im enah mekabbelet shel sheti, af al pi shemmekabbelet shel erev, temea. bet kearot sheeno mekabbel kearot, af al pi shemmekabbel et hattamchuyin, tame. bet hari sheeno mekabbel mashkin, af al pi shemmekabbel et hari, tame. rabban gamliel metaher, mippene sheen mekayyemin oto:

Hassallin shel pat, shiuran bechikkarot shel pat. efifyarot sheasa lahen kanim millemattan lemala lechizzuk, tehora. asa lah gappayim kol shehen, temea. rabbi shimon omer, im enah yechola lehinnatel baggappayim, tehora:
Mishnah Kelim 17:13-16: Kol shebbayyam tahor, chutz mikkelev hammayim, mippene shehu voreach layyabbasha, divre rabbi akiva. haose chelim min haggadel bayyam vechibber lahem min haggadel baaretz, afillu chut, afillu meshicha, davar shehu mekabbel tuma, tame:

Veyesh beme shennivra vayyom harishon tuma, bashsheni en bo tuma, bashshelishi yesh bo tuma, barvii uvachamishi en bahem tuma, chutz mikkenaf haoz uvetzat naamit hametzuppa. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, ma nishtanna chenaf haoz mikkol hakkenafayim. vechol shennivra vayyom hashshishshi, tame:

Haose cheli kibbul, mikkol makom, tame. haose mishkav umoshav, mikkol makom, tame. haose chis meor hammatztza, min hanneyar, tame. harimmon, haallon, vehaegoz, shechakakum hattinokot lamod bahem et heafar o shehitkinum lechaf moznayim, tame, sheyyesh lahem maase veen lahem machashava:

Kene moznayim vehammachok sheyyesh bahen bet kibbul mattachot, vehaesel sheyyesh bo vet kibbul maot, vekane shel ani sheyyesh bo vet kibbul mayim, umakkel sheyyesh bo vet kibbul mezuza umargaliyyot, hare ellu temein. veal kullan amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay, oy li im omar, oy li im lo omar:
Mishnah Kelim 17:17-18:3:
Tachtit hatztzorfim, temea. veshel nappachin, tehora. mashchezet sheyyesh bah bet kibbul shemen, temea. vesheen bah, tehora. pinkas sheyyesh bah bet kibbul shaava, temea. vesheen bah, tehora. machatzelet hakkash ushefoferet hakkash, rabbi akiva metamme, verabbi yochanan ben nuri metaher. rabbi shimon omer, af shel pakkuot kayyotze vahen. machatzelet kanim veshel chelef, tehora. shefoferet hakkane shechatachah lekabbala, tehora, ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkachay:  
Hashshidda, bet shammay omrim, nimdedet mibbifnim. uvet hillel omrim, nimdedet mibbachutz. modim ellu vaellu sheen ovi haraglayim voovi lizbezin nimdad. rabbi yose omer, modim sheovi haraglayim voovi lizbezin nimdad, uvenehem eno nimdad. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, im hayu haraglayim gevohot tefach, en benehem nimdad. veim lav, benehen nimdad: 
Mucheni shellah, bizman shehi nishmetet, enah chibbur lah, veenah nimdedet immah, veenah matztzelet immah beohel hammet, veen gorrin otah beshabbat bizman sheyyesh betochah maot. veim enah nishmetet, chibbur lah, venimdedet immah, umatztzelet immah beohel hammet, vegorrin otah beshabbat af al pi sheyyesh betochah maot. hakkimron shellah, bizman shehu kavua, chibbur lah venimdad immah. veim eno kavua, eno chibbur lah veeno nimdad immah. ketzad moddin oto, rosh tor. rabbi yehuda omer, im enah yechola laamod bifne atzmah, tehora: 
Hashshidda vehatteva vehammigdal shennittela achat meraglehen, af al pi shemmekabbelin, tehorin. vesheenan mekabbelin kedarkan, rabbi yose metamme. venaklite hammitta vachamor vechippuy, tehorin. en tame ella mitta umalben. umalbene vene levi, tehorin:
Mishnah Kelim 17:4-7: Harimmonim sheamru, shelosha, achuzin ze vaze. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, benafa uvichvara, kede sheyyittol vihallech, uvekuppa, kede sheyyafshil laachorav. ushear kol hakkelim sheenan yecholin lekabbel rimmonim, kegon harova, vachatzi harova, hakkenonim hakketannim, shiuran berubban, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer, bezetim. nifretzu, shiuran bezetim. nigmemu, shiuran bema shehen:

Harimmon sheamru, lo katan velo gadol ella venoni. ulema huzkeru rimmone vadan, sheyyehu mekaddeshin kol shehen, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, leshaer bahen et hakkelim. rabbi akiva omer, lechach ulechach huzkeru, leshaer bahen et hakkelim, veyihyu mekaddeshin kol shehen. amar rabbi yose, lo huzkeru rimmone vadan vachatzire geva, ella sheyyihyu mitasserin vadday bechol makom:

Kabbetza sheamru, lo gedola velo ketanna ella venonit. rabbi yehuda omer, mevi gedola shebbaggedolot uketanna shebbakketannot, venoten letoch hammayim, vecholek et hammayim. amar rabbi yose, vechi mi modieni ezohi gedola veezohi ketanna, ella hakkol lefi dato shel roe:
Kaggerogeret sheamru, lo gedola velo ketanna ella venonit. rabbi yehuda omer, haggedola shebbeeretz yisrael hi habbenonit shebbammedinot:
Mishnah Kelim 17:8-12: Kazzayit sheamru, lo gadol velo katan ella venoni, ze egori. kasseora sheamru, lo gedola velo ketanna ella venonit, zo midbarit. kaadasha sheamru, lo gedola velo ketanna ella venonit, zo mitzrit. kol hammittaltelin meviin et hattuma boovi hammardea, lo gadol velo katan ella venoni. eze hu venoni, kol shehekkefo tefach:

Haamma sheamru, baamma habbenonit. ushete ammot haya veshushan habbira, achat al keren mizrachit tzefonit veachat al keren mizrachit deromit. sheal keren mizrachit tzefonit hayta yetera al shel moshe chatzi etzba. sheal keren mizrachit deromit hayta yetera aleha chatzi etzba, nimtzet yetera al shel moshe etzba. velamma amru achat gedola veachat ketanna, ella shehaummanin notlin bakketanna umachazirin baggedola, kede shello yavou lide meila:
Rabbi meir omer, kol haammot hayu venoniyyot, chutz mimmizbach hazzahav vehakkeren vehassovev vehayesod. rabbi yehuda omer, ammat habbinyan shishsha tefachim, veshel kelim chamishsha:

Veyesh sheamru bemidda dakka, middot hallach vehayyavesh shiuran baitalki, zo midbarit. veyesh sheamru, hakkol lefi ma shehu adam, hakkometz et hammincha, vehachofen et hakketoret, vehashshote chimlo lugmav beyom hakkippurim, vechimzon shete seuddot laeruv, mezono lechol aval lo leshabbat, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, leshabbat aval lo lechol. ellu vaellu mitkavvenin lehakel. rabbi shimon omer, mishshete yadot lechikkar, mishshalosh lekav. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, mikkikkar befundeyon, mearba sein besala:

Veyesh sheamru vemidda gassa, melo tarvad rakav, kimlo tarvad gadol shel rofim. ugeris negaim, kaggeris hakkilki. haochel beyom hakkippurim kakkotevet haggassa, kamoha uchegarinatah. venodot yayin vashemen, shiuran kefika gedola shellahen. umaor shello naasa vide adam, shiuro chimlo egrof gadol, ze hu egrofo shel ben batiach. amar rabbi yose, yeshno cherosh gadol shel adam. veshennaasa vide adam, shiuro chimlo makdeach gadol shel lishka, shehu chefundeyon haitalki, uchesela hanneronit, vechimlo nekev shebbaol:
Mishnah Kelim 18:4-8:
Malben shennetano al leshonot, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda metammein, rabbi yose verabbi shimon metaharin. amar rabbi yose, ma shana ze mimmalbene vene levi, shemmalbene vene levi tehorin: 
Mitta shehayta temea midras, nittela ketzara ushete cheraayim, temea. arukka ushete cheraayim, tehora. rabbi nechemya metamme. gadad shete leshonot lochsan, gadad shete cheraayim (tefach al tefach) lochsan, o shemmiatah pachot mittefach, tehora: 
Mitta shehayta temea midras, nishbera arukka vetikkenah, temea midras. nishbera sheniyya vetikkenah, tehora min hammidras, aval temea magga midras. lo hispik letakken et harishona ad shennishbera sheniyya, tehora: 
Kera shehayta temea midras, vechibberah lammitta, kullah temea midras. persha, hi temea midras, vehammitta magga midras. hayta temea tumat shiva vechibberah lammitta, kullah temea tumat shiva. persha, hi temea tumat shiva, vehammitta temea tumat arev. hayta temea tumat erev vechibberah lammitta, kullah temea tumat arev. persha, hi temea tumat erev, vehammitta tehora. vechen hashshen shel mader: 
Tefilla, arbaa chelim. hittir ketzitza harishona vetikkenah, temea teme met, vechen sheniyya, vechen shelishit. hittir et harviit, tehora mitteme met, aval temea magga teme met. chazar larishona vehittirah vetikkenah, temea vemagga, vechen sheniyya. hittir et hashshelishit, tehora, sheharviit bemagga, veen magga ose magga:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 4:11-5:2: Hammotze cheli vechatuv alav kuf, karban. 40, maaser. 4, demay. 9, tevel. 400, teruma, shebbishat sakkana hayu chotvin 400 tachat teruma. rabbi yose omer, kullam shemot bene adam hem. amar rabbi yose, afillu matza chavit vehi melea ferot vechatuv aleha teruma, hare ellu chullin, sheani omer eshtakad hayta melea ferot teruma, ufinnah:
Haomer livno, maaser sheni bezavit zo, umatza vezavit acheret, hare ellu chullin. haya sham mane umatza matayim, hashshear chullin. matayim umatza mane, hakkol maaser:

Kerem revai, metzayyenin oto bekozzot adama, veshel arla becharsit, veshel kevarot besid, umemache veshofech. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, bamme devarim amurim, bashsheviit. vehatztzenuim mannichin et hammaot veomrim, kol hannilkat mizze, yehe mechullal al hammaot haellu:

Kerem revai haya ole lirushalayim mahalach yom echad lechol tzad. veezo hi techumah, elat min haddarom veakrabbat min hatztzafon, lod min hammaarav vehayyarden min hammizrach. umishsherabbu happerot, hitkinu sheyyehe nifde samuch lachoma. utenay haya haddavar, sheematay sheyyirtzu, yachazor haddavar lichmot shehaya. rabbi yose omer, mishshecharav bet hammikdash, haya hattenay hazze. utenay haya, ematay sheyyibbane bet hammikdash, yachazor haddavar lichmot shehaya:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 4:2-5:
Podin maaser sheni beshaar hazzol, kemot shehachenvani lokeach, lo chemot shehu mocher. kemot shehashshulchani foret, velo chemot shehu metzaref. veen podin maaser sheni achsara. et sheddamav yeduim, yippade al pi ed echad. veet sheen damav yeduim, yippade al pi shelosha, kegon hayyayin shekkaram uferot shehirkivu umaot shehecheliu: 
Baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela, baal habbayit kodem, mippene shehu mosif chomesh. baal habbayit omer besela veacher omer besela veissar, et shel sela veissar kodem, mippene shehu mosif al hakkeren. happode maaser sheni shello, mosif alav chamishshit, ben shehu shello uven shennittan lo bemattana: 
Maarimin al maaser sheni. ketzad, omer adam livno ulevitto haggedolim, leavdo uleshifchato haivrim, helach maot ellu ufede lach maaser sheni ze. aval lo yomar ken livno ulevitto hakketannim, leavdo uleshifchato hakkenaanim, mippene sheyyadan keyado: 
Haya omed baggoren veen beyado maot, omer lachavero, hare happerot haellu netunim lach bemattana. chozer veomer, hare ellu mechullalin al maot shebbabbayit:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 4:6-10:
Mashach mimmennu maaser besela, velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad bishtayim, noten lo sela, umistakker besela, umaaser sheni shello. mashach mimmennu maaser bishtayim, velo hispik lifdoto ad sheamad besela, noten lo sela mechullin vesela shel maaser sheni shello. im haya am haaretz, noten lo middemay: 
Happode maaser sheni velo kara shem, rabbi yose omer, dayyo. rabbi yehuda omer, tzarich lefaresh. haya medabber im haishsha al iske gittah vekiddusheha, venatan lah gittah vekiddusheha velo feresh, rabbi yose omer, dayyo. rabbi yehuda omer, tzarich lefaresh: 
Hammanniach issar veachal alav chetzyo, vehalach lemakom acher vahare hu yotze befundeyon, ochel alav od issar. hammanniach pundeyon veachal alav chetzyo, vehalach lemakom acher vahare hu yotze beissar, ochel alav od pelag. hammanniach issar shel maaser sheni, ochel alav achad asar beissar veechad mimmea beissar. bet shammay omrim, hakkol asara. uvet hillel omrim, bavvadday achad asar, uvaddemay asara: 
Kol hammaot hannimtzaim, hare ellu chullin, afillu dinar zahav im hakkesef veim hammaot. matza vetochan cheres vechatuv alav maaser, hare ze maaser: 
Hammotze cheli vechatuv alav karban, rabbi yehuda omer, im haya shel cheres, hu chullin uma shebbetocho karban. veim haya shel mattechet, hu karban uma shebbetocho chullin. amru lo, en derech bene adam lihyot konsin chullin lekarban:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:12-15: Lo achalti veoni mimmennu (sham), ha im achalo vaanina eno yachol lehitvaddot. velo viarti mimmennu betame, ha im hifrisho vetuma eno yachol lehitvaddot. velo natatti mimmennu lemet, lo lakachti mimmennu aron vetachrichim lemet, velo netattiv leonnim acherim. shamati vekol Adonai elohay, havetiv levet habbechira. asiti kechol asher tzivvitani, samachti vesimmachti vo:

Hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim (Devarim 26, 15), asinu ma sheggazarta alenu, af atta ase ma shehivtachtanu, hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha min hashshamayim uvarech et ammecha et yisrael bevanim uvevanot. veet haadama asher natatta lanu, betal uvematar uvevaldot behema. kaasher nishbata laavotenu eretz zavat chalav udevash, kede shettitten taam bapperot:

Mikkan amru, yisrael umamzerim mitvaddim, aval lo gerim velo avadim meshuchrarim, sheen lahem chelek baaretz. rabbi meir omer, af lo chohanim uleviyyim, shello natlu chelek baaretz. rabbi yose omer, yesh lahem are migrash:
Yochanan kohen gadol heevir hodayot hammaaser. af hu bittel et hameorrim, veet hannokfim. vead yamav haya fattish makke virushalayim, uveyamav en adam tzarich lishol al haddemay:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:3-6: Kerem revai, bet shammay omrim, en lo chomesh veen lo viur. uvet hillel omrim, yesh lo. bet shammay omrim, yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot, vehaaniyyim podin leatzman. uvet hillel omrim, kullo laggat:

Ketzad podin neta revai, manniach et hassal al pi shelosha, veomer, kamma adam rotze lifdot lo vesela al menat lehotzi yetziot mibbeto. umanniach et hammaot, veomer, kol hannilkat mizze, mechullal al hammaot haellu bechach vechach sallim besala:
Uvashsheviit, podehu veshavyo. veim haya hakkol mufkar, en lo ella sechar lekita. happode neta revai shello, mosif alav chamishshito, ben shehu shello uven shennittan lo bemattana:

Erev yom tov harishon shel pesach shel reviit veshel sheviit, haya viur. ketzad haya viur, notnin teruma uterumat maaser labbealim, umaaser rishon livalav, umaasar ani livalav. umaaser sheni vehabbikkurim mitbaarim bechol makom. rabbi shimon omer, habbikkurim nittanin lakkohanim katteruma. hattavshil, bet shammay omrim, tzarich levaer. uvet hillel omrim, hare hu kimvoar:
Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:7-11: Mi shehayu lo ferot bazzeman hazze vehiggia sheat habbiur, bet shammay omrim, tzarich lechallelan al hakkesef. uvet hillel omrim, echad shehen kesef veechad shehen perot:

Amar rabbi yehuda, barishona hayu sholchin etzel baale vattim shebbammedinot, maharu vehatekinu et perotechem ad shello taggia sheat habbiur. ad shebba rabbi akiva velimmed, shekkol happerot shello vau leonat hammaasrot, peturim min habbiur:

Mi shehayu ferotav rechokim mimmennu, tzarich likro lahem shem. maase verabban gamliel vehazzekenim shehayu vain bisfina, amar rabban gamliel, issur sheani atid lamod, natun lihoshua, umekomo muskar lo. issur acher sheani atid lamod, natun laakiva ven yosef sheyyizke vo laaniyyim, umekomo muskar lo. amar rabbi yehoshua, issur sheani atid lamod natun leelazar ben azarya, umekomo muskar lo. venitkabbelu ze mizze sachar:

Bammincha veyom tov haacharon hayu mitvaddin. ketzad haya havvidduy, biarti hakkodesh min habbayit (Devarim 26), ze maaser sheni veneta revai. netattiv lallevi, ze masar levi. vegam netattiv, zo teruma uterumat maaser. lagger layyatom velaalmana, ze maasar ani, halleket vehashshichcha vehappea, af al pi sheenan meakkevin et havvidduy. min habbayit, zo challa:

Kechol mitzvatcha asher tzivvitani (sham), ha im hikdim maaser sheni larishon, eno yachol lehitvaddot. lo avarti mimmitzvotecha, lo hifrashti mimmin al sheeno mino, velo min hattalush al hamechubbar, velo min hamechubbar al hattalush, velo min hechadash al hayyashan, velo min hayyashan al hechadash. velo shachachti, lo shachachti millevarechcha umillehazkir shimcha alav:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Mitzvat ase lehitpallel bechol yom shenneemar <small>(Shemot 23 25)</small> "vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem". mippi hashshemua lamdu sheavoda zo hi tefilla shenneemar <small>(Devarim 11 13)</small> "uleavdo bechol levavchem" amru chachamim e zo hi avoda shebballev zo tefilla. veen minyan hattefillot min hattora. veen mishne hattefilla hazzot min hattora. veen lattefilla zeman kavua min hattora:

Ulefichach nashim vaavadim chayyavin bitfilla lefi shehi mitzvat ase shello hazzeman gerama ella chiyyuv mitzva zo kach hu sheyyehe adam mitchannen umitpallel bechol yom umaggid shivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu veachar kach shoel tzerachav shehu tzarich lahem bevakkasha uvitchinna veachar kach noten shevach vehodaya laAdonai al hattova shehishpia lo kol echad lefi kocho:

Im haya ragil marbe bitchinna uvakkasha veim haya aral sefatayim medabber kefi yechalto uvechol et sheyyirtze. vechen minyan hattefillot kol echad kefi yechalto. yesh mitpallel paam achat beyom. veyesh mitpallelin peamim harebe. vehakkol yihyu mitpallelin nochach hammikdash bechol makom sheyyihye. vechen haya haddavar tamid mimmoshe rabbenu vead ezra:

Kevan sheggalu yisrael bime nevuchadnetztzar harasha nitarvu befaras veyavan ushear haummot venoldu lahem banim beartzot haggoyim veotan habbanim nitbalbelu sefatam vehayta sefat kol echad veechad meorevet milleshonot harebe vechevan shehaya medabber eno yachol ledabber kol tzarko belashon achat ella beshibbush shenneemar <small>(nechemya 13 kad)</small> "uvenehem chatzi medabber ashdodit" vegomer <small>(nechemya 13 kad)</small> "veenam makkirim ledabber yehudit vechilshon am veam". umippene ze keshehaya echad mehen mitpallel tiktzar leshono lishl chafatzav o lehaggid shevach hakkadosh baruch hu bilshon hakkodesh ad sheyyearvu immah leshonot acherot. vechevan sheraa ezra uvet dino kach amdu vetikkenu lahem shemone esre berachot al hasseder. shalosh rishonot shevach laAdonai veshalosh acharonot hodaya. veemtzaiyyot yesh bahen sheelat kol haddevarim shehen kemo avot lechol cheftze ish vaish uletzarche hatztzibbur kullan, kede sheyyihyu aruchot befi hakkol veyilmedu otan vetihye tefillat ellu haillegim tefilla shelema kitfillat baale hallashon hatztzecha. umippene inyan ze tikkenu kol habberachot vehattefillot mesuddarot befi kol yisrael kede sheyyehe inyan kol beracha aruch befi hailleg:

Vechen tikkenu sheyyehe minyan hattefillot keminyan hakkarbanot. shete tefillot bechol yom keneged shene temidin. vechol yom sheyyesh karban musaf tikkenu bo tefilla shelishit keneged karban musaf. utefilla shehi keneged tamid shel boker hi hannikret tefillat hashshachar. utefilla shekkeneged tamid shel ben haarbayim hi hannikret tefillat mincha utefilla shekkeneged hammusafin hi nikret tefillat hammusafin:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 3:18-19: Shenayim shehayu yeshenim betallit achat kol echad mehen asur likrot af al pi sheyyechasse mittachat libbo ad shettehe tallit mafseket benehen ad shello yigga besar ze bivsar ze mimmatnav ulematta. veim haya yashen im ishto o banav uvene beto hakketannim hare gufan kegufo veeno margish mehen. lefichach af al pi shebbesaro nogea bahem machazir panav vechotzetz mittachat libbo vekore:

Ad ematay hem ketannim leinyan ze ad sheyyehe hazzachar ben shetem esre shana veyom echad vehannekeva bat achat esre shana veyom echad vehu sheyyehe tavnitam ketavnit gedolim <small>(yechezkel 16 7)</small> "shadayim nachonu usearech tzimmeach". veachar kach lo yikra ad shettafsik tallit benehen. aval im adayin lo hayu shadayim nachonu usearech tzimmeach kore immahen bekeruv basar veeno tzarich hefsek ad sheyyihye hazzachar ben 13 shana veyom echad vehannekeva bat shetem esre shana veyom echad:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 4:1-2: Nashim vaavadim uketannim peturim mikkeriat shema. umelammedin et hakketannim likrotah beonatah umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha kede lechannechan bemitzvot. mi shehaya libbo tarud venechpaz lidvar mitzva patur mikkol hammitzvot umikkeriat shema. lefichach chatan shennasa betula patur mikkeriat shema ad sheyyavo aleha. lefi sheen dato penuya shemma lo yimtza lah betulim. veim shaha ad motzae shabbat velo baal chayyav likrot mimmotzae shabbat veelach shehare nitkarra dato velibbo gas bah af al pi shello baal:
Aval hannose et habbeula af al pi sheosek bemitzva chayyav likrot hoil veen lo davar shemmevalbel dato. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Reading the Shema 4:6-7: Kavru et hammet vechazru haavelim lekabbel tanchumin vechol haam holchim acharehem mimmekom hakkever lammakom sheomdim bo haavelim laasot shura lekabbel tanchumin. im yecholin haam lehatechil veligmor afillu pasuk echad kodem sheyyaggiu lashshura yatchilu veim lav lo yatchilu ella yenachamu et haavelim veachar sheyyippatru mehen yatchilu likrot. bene adam haomdin bashshura, happenimiyyim shehen roin pene haavelim peturin mikkeriat shema vehachitzonim hoil veenan roin et haavelim chayyavin bikriat shema bimkoman:

Kol mi shehu patur millikrot keriat shema im ratza lehachamir al atzmo likrot kore. vehu shettehe dato penuya alav. aval im haya ze happatur millikrot mevohal eno rashshay likrot ad shettityashshev dato alav:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:14-15: Lefichach happosek im hannachri livnot lo chatzero o katlo o liktzor et sadehu o shessecharo shana o shetayim livnot lo chatzer o litta lo kerem. im hayta hammelacha bammedina o betoch hattechum asur lo lahanichan laasot beshabbat mippene haroim sheenam yodim sheppasak. veim hayta hammelacha chutz lattechum muttar sheen sham yisrael sheyyire et happoalin keshehen osin beshabbat:

Vechen muttar leadam lehasekir karmo o sadehu lenachri af al pi shehu zoran venotan beshabbat. sheharoe yodea shessechurin hen o baarisut natan lahen. vedavar sheshshem yisrael bealav karuy alav veen derech rov anshe oto hammakom lehasekiro o litteno baarisut asur lehasekiro lenachri. mippene shehannachri ose beoto hammakom melacha beshabbat vehu nikra al shem hayyisrael bealav:
Niddah 19b:14-16: Ezehu adom — kedam hammakka. may "kedam hammakka"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kedam shor shachut.
Velema "kedam shechita"! i amar "kedam shechita" — hava amena kechulla shechita, ka mashma lan "kedam hammakka" — kitchillat hakkaa shel sakkin.
Ulla amar: kedam tzippor chayya. ibbaya lehu: chayya — leappoke shachut, o dilma leappoke kachush? teku.

Proverbs 19:6-10: Rabbim yechallu fene-nadiv vechol-harea leish mattan
Kolache-rash ׀ seneuhu af ki mereehu rachaku mimmennu meraddef amarim (lo) [lo]hemma
Kone-lev ohev nafsho shomer tevuna limtzo-tov
Ed shekarim lo yinnake veyafiach kezavim yoved {p}
Lo-nave lichsil taanug af ki-leeved ׀ meshol besarim
Shabbat 142b:12-143a:2: Maot sheal hakkar. amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: lo shanu ella beshocheach, aval bemanniach — naasa basis ledavar haasur.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella letzorech gufo, aval letzorech mekomo — metaltelo veodan alav. vechen tane chiyyay bar rav middifti: lo shanu ella letzorech gufo, aval letzorech mekomo — metaltelo veodan alav.

Maot sheal hakkar menaer vechulei. amar rabbi oshaya: shachach arnaki bechatzer — manniach aleha kikkar o tinok umetaltelah. amar rav yitzchak: shachach levena bechatzer — manniach aleha kikkar o tinok, umetaltelah. amar rabbi yehuda bar shela amar rabbi assi: paam achat shachchu disakkayya melea maot bisratya, uvau veshaalu et rabbi yochanan, veamar lahen: hannichu aleha kikkar o tinok, vetalteluha.
Amar mar zutera: hilcheta kechol hane shematata beshocheach. rav ashe amar: afillu shocheach name [la] — velo amru kikkar o tinok ella lemet bilvad.
Abbaye mannach kappa akkife. rava mannach sakkina abbar yona umetaltelah. amar rav yosef: kamma charifan shematata dedardakke! emar daamur rabbanan beshocheach, lechattechilla mi amur?!
Amar abbaye: i lav deadam chashuv ana, kappa akkife lema li? ha chazu lemizga alayyhu!
Amar rava: ana, i lav deadam chashuv ana — sakkina abbar yona lema li? ha chaze li leumetza.
Tama dachaze leumetza, ha la chaze leumetza — la. lememra derava kerabbi yehuda sevira leh?
Vehaamar rava leshammaeh: tevivy li bar avoza, ushedi meeh leshunnara.
Hatam kevan demasrach, dateh illaveh meetmol.

Hachi name mistabbera derava kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, dedaresh rava: ishsha lo tikkanes levet haetzim littol mehen ud. veud shennishbar — asur lehassiko beyom tov, lefi shemmassikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim. shema minna.
Zohar, Ki Tisa 11: Ta chaze ketiv (Shemot lak) vayyar haam ki voshesh moshe. man haam. innun erev rav. man erev rav. vechi ludim vechushim vechaftorim vetugarmim havo, dekaran lon erev rav, vahalo mitzriyyim havo, umimmitzrayim natlu, veillu havo irbuveya deammin saggiin, hachi hava leh lemichtav, erev rav alu ittam lefi irbuveya dilhon.

Ella (Shemot 12:38) erev rav ala ittam. amma chad hava, velishan chad, aval kol charashe mitzrayim, vechol chartume dilhon havo, dichtiv behu, (Shemot 7:11) vayyaasu gam hem chartumme mitzrayim. devau lemekam lokovel pelian dekudesha berich hu, kevan dechamu nissin ufelian deavad moshe bemitzrayim, ahadru legabbe moshe. amar leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, la tekabbel lon. amar moshe, mareh dealma, kevan dechamu gevureta dilach, baan leitgayyeyra. yechomun gevuretach bechol yoma, veyindeun delet elaha bar minach. vekabbil lon moshe.

Amay kara lon erev rav. ella kol charashin demitzrayim havo, uvereshehon (balak 194 amud alef) yonos (amru hamegayhaym ulay ellu hem yochani umamre shennizkeru beshemot Rabba parashat 9 daf amud bet 73 shura 31 amru yochani umamre el moshe teven atta machnis laapareyym) veyyimberus, uveshaatte deyoma havo avde tadir charashayyhu. vechol illen charashin illain, havo mistakkele mikki nate shimsha, mishsheruta deshit shaot umechtza, ad sheruta detesha umechtza. dehayynu erev ravreva. kol innun charashin zeirin, mishsheruta detesha umechtza, ad palgut lelya.

Innun illain divhu, havo mistakkele mikki nate shimsha. deha keden sharan tesha mea vetishin vachamesh dargin, limshatteta al ture chashuch. verucha dilhon, hava (balak 191 amud alef) meshatteta al kol innun charashin (nusach acher dargin) becharshayyhu. veillen havo avde, kol ma deinnun baan. ad dechol mitzrae rachtzanu dilhon beillen hava. vekaran lon erev rav. begin deit erev zeera, mittesha shaot umechetza uletatta, da erev zeera. utere arve innun, veal da vegam erev rav ala ittam.

Vechachmeta dilhon, hava saggi. veinnun istakkalu beshate deyoma, veistakkalu bedarga demoshe, vechamu deha bechol sitrin beshesh moshe: beshesh shate kadmain deyoma, deinnun la yachlin leshalletaa behu, (nusach acher begin shit) beshit dargin illain deachdinan beh (nusach acher deachid behu.) uvechol sitrin beshit hava, uveitrin deillen shit, hava zammin laredet min hahar, dichtiv ki voshesh moshe laredet min hahar.

Miyyad vayyikkahel haam al aharon, (dehachi tanenan divhahi shaata denachit moshe vekabbil orayyta bilchodoy kelala dechol yisrael veihu kabbil orayyta bealma. vaafillu mageylet Ester dichtiv (Ester 9:23) vekibbel hayyehudim. vekibbelu hayyehudim mibbae leh. may vekibbel ella da moshe deihu hayyehudim kelala dihudae. vayyakhel haam al ahechan) amay al aharon. begin leitkallela besitra dimina, deha innun semala bau minneh, uvegin deliheve kalil bimina, itkenashu al aharon, vayyomru elav kum ase lanu elohim. (elohim vadday bau setar semala. asher yelchu asher yelech mibbae leh. may asher yelchu. ella elohim shit darga inun (davar acher sheshet yeme hammaase) kullehu bistar semala deelohim shit inun. dei tema deha sheva inun. hahu elohim ilaa lo al bichlala).

Ta chaze, kol zimna dehava moshe bemitzrayim, shema deelohim la dachir, ella shema daAdonai, veal da kashya leh lefaro begin dela yehe tukepa lehahu sitra achara, vela yittakaf bealma. hasheta bau hahi milla, vehayeynu kum ase lanu elohim. lanu dayyka, deanan tzerichin lehay milla, letakkefa sitra dilan, dehava itdachya ad hasheta.

Asher yelchu lefaninu. may amru. ella hachi amru, chamenan deattun yisrael, kol tuv vechol yekar dealma lechu, vaanan dachyayn levar. dilchu, (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam. uf hachi elohim asher yelchu lefanenu, kema deazil kamayychu Adonai. deha reshu it lesitra dilan lemehach uf hachi lekamana, i nazmin leh ovada.

Ta chaze, kol anane yekar deazlu bemadbera, la havo chafyayn ella livni yisrael lechodayyhu. vehahu anana dikar, dichtiv vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam, azla lekamayyhu. veillen erev rav, vechol innun beire anin vetorin, havo azlu levar mimashiryyayta, levatrayyta. veta chaze, kol innun arbein shenin deka azlu yisrael bemadbera, shum lichlucha vetinnufa la hava go anani lego. veal da ane vetore dahavo achle esev levar havo, vechol innun denatre lon.

Amar ribbi elazar, abba, i hachi innun erev rav la havo achle min manna. amar leh vadday hachi hu. ella ma deyahavin lon yisrael, keman deyahiv leavdeh. umimma havo achle. mittamtzit, ma deishtear mibbatar rechaya, pesolet. ukera achriz veamar, (Shemot 16:35) uvene yisrael achlu et hamman arbaim shana. bene yisrael, vela achara. vayyiru veni yisrael vayyomru man hu, vela shear erev rav, ani vetore, dahavo benayyhu.

Ad hasheta, havo itkafyayn innun erev rav vehasheta kamu uvau ovada, leattakfa lesitra achara. amru, o nehe kullana amma chada, veneheve bichlala immechon, o yehe lan man deyyehach kamana, kema deyyehach elahachon kamechon. amar aharon, chas veshalom deillen yishtattefun beamma kaddisha, lemehve kolla kelala chada, vela yitarvun amma kaddisha beamma da, kelala chada, ella tav ihu leafresha lon miggo amma kaddisha, ad deyete moshe.

Veaharon letav itkevavn, ella saggiin havo miyisrael deishtattafu bahadayyhu belibba. uvegin kach, kad ata moshe, itzterich levarra ulelabbena leamma kaddisha mehahu chova, veashke lon shakyu, ad deitberiru kullehu vela ishtear behu pesolet kelal.

Amar lon aharon, (Shemot 32:2) paraku nizme hazzahav, vechi la hava lon dahava achara. ella amar aharon, beod deit lon ketata bivnayyhu uvenashayyhu, yitakkevun, uven kach yete moshe. ta chaze, tanenan kashim gerim leyisrael kessappachat bivsar hachay, kol shekken illen, dela havo gerim kedka yeot. innun ma avdu. vayyitparaku kol haam et nizme hazzahav asher beaznehem. kama alfe verivvavn havo minnizmehon tamman.

Ma ketiv, vayyikkach miyyadam vayyatzar oto bacheret vegomer. aharon la istammar, meinnun teren chakkimin, dahavo bereshehon dehahu erev rav. chad minnayyhu hava kameh, veachara hava avid becharshoy. kevan detarvavyyhu ityayatu kachada, natlu hahi dahava, (chad) teren shelishe bida dechad, ushelish bida deachara. begin dehachi itzterich behahu zina decharsha.

Bacha rabbi shimon, amar i chasida kaddisha, aharon meshicha deelaha rabba, bachasidutach naflu kama meamma kaddisha. veant la havet yada leistammera. mahu avadu. kad matu shit shaattin, veyoma hava bematkela, natlu hahu dahava defariku meudenehon. may tama. begin deman deitzterich lemebad charsha, la bae lemechas enoy al mamona. veinnun amri, shaata kayyayma lan, i anan la meakkevin. lav shaata lemechas al dahava, miyyad vayyitparaku kol haam. may vayyitparaku. kema deat amer (Melachim 1 19:11) mefarek harim umeshabber selaim, dechabbilu vetavru udenayyhu. bacha kemillekaddemin veamar i amma kaddisha i amma kaddisha, dekudesha berich hu.

Patach rabbi shimon bevichya, veamar, (Shemot 21:6) vehiggisho adonav el haelohim vegomer. ha ukemuha chavrayyay, ozen deshama besinay, (Vayikra 25) ki li vene yisrael avadim vegomer. veihu parik ol malchut shamayim mealeh, vezavin garmeh leacher, tiratza. veillen chayyayvayya reshiin, guverin bishin, betiuveta dilhon lemehadar lesarchanayyhu, la bau minneshehon uvenehon ella chavilu urechayyhu (sefer acher udenayyhu) veitperaku meol shemaya defakid lehu moshe, vetavru udenayyhu, delet lon chulaka bishma kaddisha, veamma kaddisha.

Ma avadu. peligu tarvavyyhu hahu dahava, chad natil teren shelishin, vechad shelish. kamu lokovel shimsha, beshit shatin. avadu charshayyhu, uvaltu belatehon becharsha defuma. kevan demata sheruta dishva, arimu tarvavyyhu yedayyhu al yedoy deaharon. (umenalan dameydea detarvayhu yad mikkol chad natal velo yattir) dichtiv vayyikkach miyyadam, tarvavyyhu havo, vela yattir. kevan deihu kabbil miyyadam (sefer acher tere velo yedehem), kalla nafik veamar, (Mishlei 11:21) yad leyad lo yinnake ra, dichtiv ki vera hu. ayyte ra lealma.

Raza demilla. innun reshaim chayyayvin charshin benoy devilam chayyayva, beni benoy delavan reshia, chamu dechos shel beracha bimin ihu, umin yemina ittakaf tadir. (sefer acher yattir) amru, i yehe bistar da, hahu resha dimina, ha tukepa dilan kedka yeot.

Kevan demata sheva shatin deyoma, yahavu leh leaharon miyyad. i ihu hava amar lon shavu leh beara bekadmita, vaana etol, la havo yachlin becharshayyhu kelum, ella miyyadam natal. ukera mitraam veamar, vayyikkach miyyadam, chamu ma avad aharon gevar nevia gevar chakkim, la yada leistammera, deillu natil meara, kol charshin dealma la havo yachlin leatzlecha. aval bema atzlachu beovada da, begin devayyikach miyyadam vela meara.

(Shemot 32:4) vayyatzar oto bacheret, lav kema dechashvin bene nasha, deavad tziyyurin bimchuga, o bemilla achara. ella ata kera leochacha milla, deaharon la yada leistammera. ilu kad natal miyyedehon, hava shadde leara, veaf al gav deyittol leh levatar, la hava atzlach ovada bisha da. aval becholla siyyua bisha hava, denakit dahava, utemareh meena, bish batar bish, may vayyatzar oto bacheret. deshavve kol dahava bechisa chada, veistemar meena. keden salik kolla leovada.

Besifra dechanoch ashkachna, dehava amar hachi, bera yechidaa yityyeylid lehahu risha chivvavra, vechad yiyitun mibbisra dachamare, yatin leh, behahu deayil (nusach acher denatil) margelan bezagin dedahava, bela data dileh, udeyyukena yetzuyayr betziyyura bacheret. may bacheret. becheret enosh. da kolmusa deenosh chayyayva, deate livne nasha.

Vadday da berira demilla, deenosh kad ate alma, bekolmusa hava rashim reshimin, dechol diukenin ufulchanin nochrain behahu kolmusa, (sefer acher rashim reshimin) veal da ketiv bacheret, hahu deishtemoda lemebad hachi. veda hu beriru demilla.

Vecholla hava, devadday bechisa arme dahava, vechasse leh meena, kema deamru innun charshin, vehachi itzterich bezine decharashin illen. veda hu ovada decharshin illen, milla deitzterich beitgalleya, leitgallaa levatar, itzterich temiru vechisuya bekadmita, deyitkase meena, uvatar yippok umana leumanuteh. umilla deitzterich bechissuya levatar, itzterich beitgalleya bekadmita.

Hasheta banay rechimay, rechimin denafshay, ma abid, vadday itzterichna legallaa, atzitu veatmiru millin. bistar kedushsha hahu, elohim dikshot, melech al alma, bitlat (milin) almin (illen) ittakkaf. (Bereshit 177 amud bet, Rosh Chodesh amud alef) bibberia. biytzira. baasiyya. veha ittemar, raza dechol chada vachada hacha. lokovel beria, vayyikkach miyyadam, mila dela hava beh ad kean kelum. lokovel yetzira, vayyatzar oto bacheret. lokovel asiyya, vayyaasehu egel massecha. man chama charshin bechol alma keillen.

Hasheta it lememar, vechi la ketiv vaashlichehu baesh, vela yattir, ucheden vayyetze haeggel hazze. vehashsheta at amart vayyaasehu egel massecha ella chas veshalom deaharon avad, ukera ochach dichtiv vayyikkach et haeggel asher asu. aval mimma dichtiv vayyikkach miyyadam, uchetiv vayyatzar oto. mechela ditren illen, itavid kolla. kivyachol hu avid leh, dei teren illen la havo, la itavid vela nafak leumanuta. aval man garam deitavid. innun teren. (kivyachol vayyaasehu ihu vadday osehu) beod deihu lakach miyyadam, inhu avde charshayyhu, umelachashe befumayyhu, umeshache rucha letatta, min sitra achara.

Umeshachu teren ruchin kachada, chad min dechar, vechad min nukeba. dechar itlavash bediyyukena deshor. nukeba bediyyukena dechamor, tarvavyyhu havo kelilan kachada. amay teren illen. ella shor ha ittemar. chamor amay. begin decharshin illen demitzrae, ketiv behu, (yechezkel 23:20) asher besar chamorim besaram.

Veal da, kol innun deyisrael demitu, itchabbaru bahadayyhu belibbehon. uvegin dahavo teren diukenin, ketiv elle elohecha yisrael, vela ketiv ze, ella elle, teren havo kachada, asher heelucha meeretz mitzrayim. heelucha vela heelcha ketiv.
(Shemot 32:4) vayyaasehu egel massecha vayyomru. vayyomer la ketiv, ella vayyomru, deaharon la amar midi. tanenan, (Vayikra 79 amud alef) mea veesrim vechamesh kanterin havo beh.
Hech ketiv vayyikkach miyyadam, vechi beyadam havo kol illen kanterin. ella mikkelala deinnun kanterin natlu male yedayyhu. vehahu zeer, istallak al kolla, keillu hava kolla bidayyhu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vayyar aharon vayyiven mizbeach lefanav. i chasida kaddisha, kama reutach hava letav, vela yadat leistammera. kevan dearme leh benura, ittakkaf chela desitra achara tamman benura, venafak diyyukena deshor, kema deittemar bitren meshichin desitra achara. miyyad vayyar aharon. mahu vayyar aharon. chama desitra achara ittakkaf, miyyad vayyiven mizbeach lefanav, deilmale deakdim uvana mizbeach da, alma ithaddar lecharbana.

Lelistim dehava nafik lekappecha ulekatla bene nasha, chama ligyona demalka, dehahu listim nafak bechela takkif ma avad hahu ligyona, ishtaddal bahade malka lenafka bearcha. umashich leh hahu ligyona behahu archa, ad deazil hahu listim behahu archa, chama diyyukena demalka kaim kammeh, kevan dechama leh lemalka dehava azil kammeh bearcha, miyyad nirta veahdar laachora.

Kacha vayyar aharon distar achara ittakaf, achid beasvavta, veatkif bistar kedusha veshavve leh kameh. kevan dechama sitra bisha diyyukena demalka dekaim kameh, miyyad ahdar laachora, veitchallash tukpeh vecheleh, deha ittakkaf, (miyyad vayyiven mizbeach lefanav) umizbeach da itgabbar, veitchallash sitra achara.

Ta chaze ma ketiv (Shemot 32:5) vayyikra aharon vayyomar chag laAdonai machar. chag laAdonai, vela laegel. velistar kedushsha avad, velistar kedushsha kara veamar. veda asvavta akdim, deilmale deavad da, la kaim alma al kiyyumeh, veim kol da, la shachich rugezeh meaharon, af al gav dela itkavavn levish.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, aharon, teren charshin illen mashchu lach lemma devau. chayyecha, teren benach yippelun, veal chova da yitpaskun (sefer acher vabechavebaa da yittafsun) hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 9:20) uveaharon hitannaf Adonai meod lehashemido. may lehashemido. illen benoy, kema deat amer (Amos 2:9) vaashmid piryo mimmaal, difri devar nash benoy innun.

Ta chaze, aharon shavve leh lehahu mizbeach lefanav, veeggela tav laachora. benoy shavu listar achara lefanav, usetar kedushsha ahdar laachora, dichtiv, (Vayikra 10:1) vayyakrivu lifne Adonai, lifne Adonai shavu. itpasu bechova da.

Aharon chashav, deven kach yete moshe, veal da hahu mizbeach la satir leh moshe, deillu hava kema dechashvin beni nasha, mila kadmaa deivae lemoshe, lenattetza lehahu mizbeach itzterich, kema denabbe iddo al mizbeach devet el, unevuateh al hahu mizbeach hava. aval hacha mila achara hava kema deittemar. uchetiv, vayyikkach et haeggel asher asu, vela ketiv vayyintotz et hammizbeach.

Ta chaze vayyikra aharon. achriz ihu bekala veamar. ketiv hacha vayyikra vayyomar, uchetiv beyona (Yona 3:4) vayyikra vayyomar, ma lehallan kariz ledina, uf hacha kariz ledina. chag laAdonai machar, nabbe nevua behahu ruach demizbeach, dezammin dina lesharya alayyhu. chag laAdonai, lemebad bechu dina.

Utelat dinin havo, chad, vayyiggof Adonai et haam. vechad, bivne levi. vechad, deashke livne yisrael. vehayeynu chag divne levi. laAdonai, devayiggof Adonai. machar, deashke lon moshe. uvito behahu lelya, ulemachar ishtechachu nefichin umetin. veinnun mayin havo mechashkeshin bimehon kol lelya, uvetzafra ishtechachu metin, veal da chag laAdonai machar. vechol asvata deavad aharon, begin dichtiv vayyiven mizbeach lefanav.

Ta chaze, (hahu mizbeach dikdushsha hava) dichtiv vayyar et haegel umecholot, veillu mizbeach la ketiv. deha aharon minda hava yada, dichtiv, (Shemot 22:19) zoveach laelohim yochoram bilti laAdonai levaddo, vadday ishteziv aharon beeta tava dedavar lenafsheh, vecholla biruta shelim tav, dela itkavvayn levish.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, abba vadday hachi hu, veyisrael la havo. aval yaravam deavad agalin, ha yisrael havo, veegel avdu. amar leh vadday, veukemuha, aval yaravam chata vehechoti, velav kema deamru. devadday chova bisha aved uvammalchut chata.

Amar yaravam, vadday yadana deha setar kedusha la sharya, ella belibba dechol alma, veda yerushalam. ana la yachilna leamshacha lehahu setar hacha, ma abid. miyyad (Melachim 1 12:28) vayyivvaatz hammelech vayyaas vegomer. natal eta bisha, amar ha sitra achara, deitmashshecha miyyad lechol atar. vekol shekken beara da, detiuvete leashraa begavvay, aval la yachla leitlabbesha ella bediyyukena deshor.

Teren aggalim amay. ella amar yaravam, (sefer acher bemitzrayim uvemadbera) bemadbera havo innun charshin, dichtiv, (yechezkel 23:20) besar chamorim besaram. (sefer acher laaaynaven mitzrayim ella) hacha, innun teren ruchin bishin, yitlabbeshu kadka chaze lon, dechar venukeba innun. dechar hava bevet el, venukeba havat bedan. umiggo dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:3) nofet tittofna sifte zara, itmashchu yisrael avatre yattir, dichtiv vayyelchu haam lifne haechad ad dan. ubbegin kach teren agalin havo. umashich lon yaravam beara kaddisha, vahava chova aleh veal yisrael, umana birkan min alma. vealeh ketiv (Mishlei 28:24) gozel aviv veimmo vegomer.

Veal da havo agalin, deha levusha kadmaa demitlabbash sitra achara shor ihu, (191 amud alef) kema deittemar. vei tema amay ihu egel vela shor. ella vadday kach itchaze, vechen vechol sitrin, sheruta dilvusha zuta ihu, veha okimna.

Veal da banay rechimay, kevan deelohim bau, uvistar deelohim itbene ovada, elohim kaddisha, ima, daachidat tadir bidroa demalka, uselikat retzua, la havat tamman, veitzterich leh lemoshe lemeheve tamman beatraha, kevan deankkid leh kudesha berich hu, istakkal.

Telat zimnin ankkid leh, i moshe raya mehemana, kamma chelach takkif, kamma gevuretach rav, telat zimnin ankkid leh, dichtiv veatta hannicha li ha chad. vayyichar appi vahem vaachallem, ha teren. veeese otcha legoy gadol, ha telat. chachmeta demoshe bitlat nekudin illen. achid bidroeh yemina, lokovel hannicha li. achid bidroeh semala, lokovel vayyichar appi vahem vaachallem. itchabbak begufa demalka, lokovel veeese otcha legoy gadol. vechad itchabbak begufa, teren deroin missitra da umissitra da, la yachil leitnanea lesitra bealma. da have chachmeta demoshe, (sefer acher dabemaylay) demini nekudin demalka yada bechol chad minnayyhu, bean atar yittakaf, uvechachmeta avad.

Atu ribbi elazar vechavrayya, venashku yedoy. hava tamman ribbi abba, amar, ilmale la atena lealma ella lemishma da, day lan. bacha veamar, vavy ribbi, kad tistallak mealma, man yanher vigalle nehorin deorayyta. milla da, bachashocha ittemar ad hasheta, denafak mittamman, veha nahir ad rum rekia, uvechurseyya demalka rashim, vekudesha berich hu chadde hasheta behay milla. vechamma chedu al chedu, ittosaf mikkamme malka kaddisha. man yittear mille dechachmeta bealma den kevavtaych.

Ta chaze, ad la chata adam, hava salik vekaim (Bereshit 52 amud bet) bechachma dinhiru illaa, vela hava mitperash meilana dechayye. kevan deasge tiuveta leminda, ulenachta letatta, itmeshich avatrayyhu, ad deitperash meilana dechayye, veyada ra veshavak tov. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra, man deitmeshach bera, let leh diyyura im ilana dechayye. vead la chatu, havo shamin kalla milella, veyadin chachmeta illaa, vela dachale. kevan dechatu, afillu kalla diltatta, la havo yachlin lemekam beh.

Kegavvna da, ad la chavu yisrael, beshaata dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay, itavar minnayyhu zuhama dehay chivya, deha keden bitul yetzer hara hava mealma, vedachu leh minnayyhu. ucheden itachidu beilana dechayye, useliku leella, vela nachtu letatta. keden havo yadin, vahavu chaman, aspaklaryan illain, veitnaharan enayyhu, vechaddan leminda ulemishma. ucheden chagar lon kudesha berich hu, chaggirin deatvavn dishma kaddisha, dela yachil leshalletaa alayyhu hay chivya, vela yesaav lon kedibbekadmeta.

Kevan dechatu baegla, itavaru minnayyhu kol innun dargin, unehorin illain, veitavar minnayyhu chagiru mezayyeynin, deitattaru mishshema kaddisha illaa, veamshichu alayyhu chivya bisha kemillekaddemin, vegarimu mota lechol alma. ulevatar ma ketiv. vayyar aharon vechol bene yisrael et moshe vehinne karan or panav vayyiru miggeshet elav.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv bekadmita, (Shemot 14:31) vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola, vechullehu chaman zaharin illain, itnaharin beaspaklarya denahara, dichtiv, (Shemot 20) vechol haam roim et hakkolot. veal yamma, havo chaman vela dachalin, dichtiv ze eli veanvehu, levatar dechatu, pene hassirsur la havo yachle lemechome. ma ketiv, vayyiru miggeshet elav.

Veta chaze, ma ketiv behu (Shemot 33:6) vayyitnatztzelu veni yisrael et edyam (73 amud bet) mehar chorev, deitaveru minnayyhu, innun mezayyeynin deitchabbaru behu betura desinay, begin dela yishlot behu hahu chivya bisha, kevan deitabbar minnayyhu, ma ketiv, umoshe (236) yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachan harechek min hammachane. amar ribbi elazar, may hay kera legabbe hay. ella, kevan deyada moshe, deitavaru minnayyhu deyisrael innun zayynin illain, amar, ha vadday mikkan ulehala, chivya bisha yete ledayyayra benayyhu, vei yekum makdesha hacha benayyhu yisteav, miyyad umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane harechek min hammachane. begin dechama moshe, deha keden yishlot chivya bisha, ma dela hava mikkadmat dena.

Vekara lo ohel moed, vechi la hava bekadmita ohel moed. ella, bekadmita ohel setam, hasheta ohel moed. may moed. ribbi elazar amar letav, ribbi abba amar levish, ribbi elazar amar letav, ma moed deihu yom chedva desihara, deittosfa beh kedushsha, la shalta bah pegimuta, uf hacha kare leh bishma da, leachazaa deha itrechik mibbenayyhu, vela itpegim, veal da vekara lo ohel moed ketiv.

Veribbi abba amar levish, deha bekadmita hava ohel setam, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 33:20) ohel bal yitzan bal yissa yetedotav lantzach. vehasheta ohel moed. bekadmita, lemehav chayyin aruchin lealmin, dela yishlot behu mota. mikkan lehalea ohel moed, kema deat amer (iyyov 30:23) uvet moed lechol chay, hasheta, ityeyhiv beh zimna vechayyin ketzuvin lealma. bekadmita la itpegim, vehasheta itpegim. bekadmita chavruta veziuuga lesihara beshimsha, dela yadun. hasheta ohel moed, ziuuga dilhon mizzeman lizman, ubbegin kach vekara lo ohel moed, ma dela hava kodem.
Zohar, Ki Tisa 5: Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Yeshayahu 41:11) hen yevoshu veyikkalmu kol hannechorim bach vegomer. zamin kudesha berich hu lemebad leyisrael, kol innun tavan, dekaamar al yede nevie keshot, veyisrael savlu alehon, kema bishin begalutehon. veilmale kol innun tavan deka mechakkan vechaman ketivin beorayyta, la havo yachlin lemekam ulemisbal galuta.

Aval azlin leve midrashot, patchin sifrin, vechaman kol innun tavan, deka mechakkan, vechaman ketivin beorayyta, deavtach lon kudesha berich hu alayyhu, umitnachamin begalutehon, ushear amin mecharfin umegadfin lon, veamre an hu lahachon, an innun tavan deattun amrin dizminin lechon, vechi kol ammin dealma yichsefun minnayychu.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:5) shimu devar Adonai hacharedim el devaro amru achechem sonechem vegomer. may hacharedim el devaro, innun desavlu kama bishin, kama shemuot shame, illen al illen, veillen batar illen, vecharidan alehon, kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 30:Adonai) ki vegomer kol charada shamanu pachad veen shalom vegomer. innun charedim tadir el devaro kad itavid dina.

Amru achechem sonechem, illen innun achuchon bene esav. menaddechem, kema deat amer (Eicha 4:15) suru tame karu lamo. delet amma deka mevazzin lon beanpe, umerakkekin beanpayyhu leyisrael kivne edom. veamre kullehu misavin kannidda, veda ihu menaddechem. lemaan shemi yichbad Adonai, anan (deamrin) benoy deel chay. di ban yityaykar shemeh. anan shaltanin al alma begin hahu deikre gadol. (Bereshit 27:5) esav beno haggadol. uvishma da ikre kudesha berich hu gadol, (Tehillim 145:3) gadol Adonai umehullal meod. anan bene haggadol, veihu gadol. vadday lemaan shemi yichbad Adonai.

Aval attun zeirin mikkolla, (Bereshit 27:15) yaakov benah hakkatan ketiv, an hu elahachon. an hu innun tavan, deyichsefun kol amamya mechedva dilchon. man yitten venire vesimchatchem kema deattun amrin. vehem yevoshu (ruach hakkodesh omer vehem yevoshu) (sefer acher tu keman) keman detale killata beachara, begin deattun amrin dichden yevoshu veyikkalmu, uvegin da ruach kudsha hava amar milla hachi, veal da, hen yevoshu veyikkalmu kol hannechorim bach. may kol hannecherim bach. deitkafu nechirehon berugeza alach begaluta da. behahu zimna, yevoshu veyikkalmu mikkol tavin diyechomun lehon leyisrael.
Zohar, Ki Tisa 6: Amar ribbi chiyyay hachi hu vadday, aval chamenan vehachi chamu takife alma, deha galuta itmeshach vaadayin bereh dedavid la ate. amar ribbi yose, vechol da hachi hu, aval man avid deyisbelun yisrael galuta da, kol innun havetachot deavtach lon kudesha berich hu. veha ittemar, dealin levatte kenesiyyot ulevate midrashot, vechaman kol innun nechamot, vechadan belibbayyhu lemisbal kol ma deyete alayyhu, veilmale da la yachlin lemisbal.

Amar ribbi chiyyay vadday hachi ihu, vecholla bitshuva talya. vei tema deyichlun hasheta leatara teshuva kullehu kachada. la yachlin. may tama la yachlin. begin dichtiv, (Devarim 30:1) vehaya ki yavou alecha kol haddevarim haelle. uchetiv vahashevota el levavecha bechol haggoyim asher hiddichacha vegomer. uchetiv veshavta ad Adonai elohecha vegomer. ucheden (Devarim 30:4) im yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim mishsham yekabbetzcha vegomer. vead dechol innun millin la yitkayyeymun, la yachlin leatara teshuva minnayyhu.

Amar ribbi yose, kama satamt kol archin ushevilin mikkol beni galuta, vela shavkat lon pitchon pe. i hachi, lihvo kema dahavo bechol dara vedara, dela yisbelun galuta vela agra, veyifkun (sefer acher i hachi, lehevo kema dilhon bechol dara vedara, yisbelun galuta velo yifkun) middina deorayyta, veyitarvun bishar ammin.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 26:17) kemo hara takriv laledet tachil tizak bachavaleha vegomer. may kemo hara, arach ihu leubbarta, leabera alah tesha yarchin shelemin. veit bealma kama vechamma, dela avar alah ella yoma chad o teren yomin mitteshiaa, vechol tzirin vachavalin deubbarta bitshiaa innun. veaf al gav dela abar alah ella yoma chada, itchashiv alah keillu itavaru kol teshiaa shelim. uf hachi yisrael, kevan deitame taam galuta, i yahadrun bitshuva, yitchashav alayyhu keillu aberu alayyhu kol innun millin dichtivin beorayyta. kol shekken vekol shekken dechamma vechamma yissurin aberu alayyhu min yoma degaluta share.

Aval may dichtiv, (Devarim 4:30) batztzar lecha umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim. ta chaze, kamma rachamanuta rachim kudesha berich hu leyisrael bemilla da. lemalka dehava leh bera yechidaa, verachim leh rechimu denafsha, umiggo rechimu dileh, yahav leh leimmeh matronita ditrabbe leh, vetolif leh arche metatkenan. zimna chada chav legabbe avuha, ata avohi vealke leh, ulevatar abar al choveh. tav kemillekaddemin vechav laavuha, veafkeh avuha mibbeteh, veargiz aleh, nafak hahu bera mibbeteh.

Uveatar diyyehach beorach keshot, vihe zakkaa kedka yeot, begin deyishma malka avuha, vihe tiuveteh aleh. ma avad. amar hoil venafakna mehechala deabba, avid mikkan ulehala kol ma daana bae. ma avad. azal veitchabbar bezonot, veitlachlach belichlucha detinnufa bahadayyhu, vela hava mishtechach ella bahadayyhu, bechibbura dilhon. dematronita immeh pakdat bechol yoma al hahu bera, veyadat divrah bahade zonot itchabbar, vechol chavruta dideh bahadayyhu havavt. shariat lemivke, uleitmarra al berah.

Yoma chad al malka legabbah, chama lah deihi mevakka. shail lah al ma at bachat. amra vela evke, deha berana levar mehechala demalka. vela day dehu la yativ behechala demalka, ella dehu yativ bahade zonot. ma yemrun kol bene alma, bereh demalka ihu deyativ beve zonot. sheriat lemivke, uleitchannena lemalka. amar malka, beginach ahdar leh, veant arva dileh. amrat ha vadday.

Amar malka hoil vechach hu, la itzterich leahaddera leh bimama beitgalleya. dechissufa dilan ihu lemehach beginih leve zonot. vei la have kegavvna da, detinef garmeh hachi vechillel yekari. havena ana, vechol chayyaylin dili, azlin begineh bechamma yekar, bechamma bukinas kameh, bechamma mane kerava, mimineh umismaleh, ad dechol beni alma yizdazeun, veyindeun kolla, dibbera demalka ihu. hashsheta kevan deihu tinef garmeh, vechillel yekari, ihu yehdar bitmiru, dela yindeun beh. ahdar legabbe malka, yahaveh legabbe immeh.

Leyomin sarach kemillekaddemin. ma avad malka. appik leh uleimmeh bahadeh miggo hechala, amar tarvavyychu tehachun, vetarvavyychu tisbelun galuta, umalkiuta tamman. kevan detarvavyychu tisbelun kachada, keden yadana divri yetuv kadka chaze.

Kacha yisrael benoy demalka kaddisha innun. achit lon lemitzrayim. vei tema behahu zimna la chavu, gezera degazar kudesha berich hu ben habbetarim hava itchaze lemehve kayyaym, vekudesha berich hu ashgach litren millin, chad begin hahu milla deamar avraham, (Bereshit 15:8) bama eda ki irashenna, da hu sibba veila. aval ad denafku mimmitzrayim, la have goy, vela itchazu kadka yeut.

Patach veamar, (Shir hashshirim 2:2) keshoshanna ben hachochim ken rayati ben habbanot. baa kudesha berich hu lemebad lon leyisrael kegavvna dilella ulemeheve shoshanna chada beara, kegavvna illaa. veshoshanna desalleka recha, veitberir mikkol shear vevradin dealma, la have ella hahi desalleka ben hachochim. veda archa kedka yeot. veal da zara shivin zugin, dahavo shivin nefesh, veail lon ben hachochim, veinnun chochim, miyyad dahavo innun zugin tamman, seliku anfin vetarpin ushelitu al alma, ucheden parchat shoshana benayyhu.

Kevan devaa kudesha berich hu leappaka shoshana velakit lah mibbenayyhu, keden yavshu chochim, veizderiku, veishtetziu, vela itchashvu lichlum. beshaata deazil lemilkat shoshana da, leappaka bereh buchereh, behahu zimna azal malka go kama chayyaylin ravrevanin veshallitin, im degalin perisan, veappik livreh buchereh bechamma gevurin, veayyte leh lehechaleh, veyativ saggi beve malka.

Kevan dechav legabbe avuha, ochach leh, vealke leh, dichtiv, (Shoftim 2:14) vayyichar af Adonai beyisrael vayyittenem beyad shosim vegomer, sarach kemillekaddemin, umarad beavuha, afkeh mibbeteh. ma avdu yisrael, chamu deha itbadru levavel, itarvu beammaya, nasivu nashin nachriyyot, veolidu benin minnehon. im kol da, ima kaddisha havat appotropposa alayyhu.

Veal deavad hachi, kudesha berich hu amar, hoil vechissufa ihu, lete beri ihu miggarmeh, hoil vechillel yekari, la itchaze deana ezil tamman leappaka leh, ulemebad leh nissin ugevuran kemillekaddemin. tavu innun, bela siyyua deitchazu lon, bela pelian venissin, ella kullehu mitbadderan, kullehu lean bemiskenu, vetavu lehechala demalka bechissufa, veema kaddisha arvat lon.
Zohar, Ki Tisa 7: Chavu kemillekaddemin. ma avad kudesha berich hu. appik lehay bera kemillekaddemin mehechaleh, veimmeh bahadeh. amar, mikkan ulehala, ima uverah yisbelun kama bishin kachada, hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya 3) uvefishechem shullecha immechem. veal da ketiv, (Devarim 4:30) batztzar lecha umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim. may beacharit hayyamim. ella da hi ima kaddisha, dehi acharit hayyamim, veimmah savlu kol ma desavlu begaluta.
