Veillu yehadrun betiyyuveta, afillu chad bish, o chad tzaara, diavar alayyhu, itchashev alayyhu, keillu savlu kolla (sefer acher vei lav satim kitza) vei la, kad yistayem kitza, (bisha) vechol darin dileh. kema deamar butzina kaddisha, dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:30) litztzemitut lakkone oto ledorotav. vechol da, betiyyuveta talya milleta. amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday hachi hu. veal da galuta itmeshach.

Aval kudesha berich hu, kol ma dechame (sefer acher demata) (nusach acher dalka) lon leyisrael, behay acharit hayyamim, uvehay acharit hayyamim yaavid lon nissin venukemin, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:2) vehaya beacharit hayyamim nachon yihye har bet Adonai berosh heharim. man rosh heharim. da avraham sava, (252 amud bet) kahana rabba, rosh decholla. uvegin deihu rosh, kos divracha, yihye nachon berosh heharim, da avraham sava, kadmaa lishar heharim. kos divracha, itzterich lemeheve metakkena bimina.

(252 Amud bet) venissa (112 amud bet) miggevaot. itzterich lemehve zakif min pattora, shiura deikre (sefer acher deihu) zeret, levarcha lekudesha berich hu, veda hu venissa miggevaot. miggevaot may hu. ella bena, uven betulot achareha reoteha, shiura dezeret ihu. nisa kos divracha miggevaot vadday, veal da tava dihe leh lehay bera buchera, beacharit hayyamim ihu.

Amar leh shappir kaamart, hay kera vadday hachi hu. berosh heharim, da yemina, avraham sava, deihu rosh heharim vadday. venissa miggevaot, mishshiura digvaot, deinnun reuteh. veshappir kaamret. (Yeshayahu 2:2) venaharu elav kol haggoyim. may hu. amar leh, vaafillu nashim uketannim veshammash defalach al pattora, af al gav deihu la achal, itzterich lemishma, ulememar amen. (sefer acher leharik beracha lachos dela vechulei) dela yiyima bar nash, ana la achalit, vehoil dela itzterifna lezimmun, la eshma vela ema amen. hakkol chayyayvin beh.

Davar acher venaharu elav kol haggoyim, af al gav denashim uketanim peturin min hammitzvot, bechos divracha hakkol chayyayvin, bilvad deyindeun leman mevarchin, veda hi venaharu elav kol haggoyim. ata ribbi yose uneshakeh, amar kama shappir milla da, umetika lechikka.

Hasheta it ledayyka, i hay acharit hayyamim, ihu kos divracha mammash, mahu har bet Adonai, hava leh lemichtav hachi, vehaya acharit hayyamim nachon yihye berosh heharim. mahu beacharit hayyamim nachon yihye har bet Adonai. amar leh, acharit hayyamim ihu ilana kolla, meresheh vead sefeh, dehu ilana detov vara. veata kera levarra beacharit hayyamim, veappik har bet Adonai, da tov bela ra. har bet Adonai vadday delet tamman chulaka lesitra achara, deha itberir har bet Adonai, miggo ilana deihu acharit hayyamim. veda ihu kos divracha, deihu nachon berosh heharim.

Amar ribbi yose, zakkaa archa da, dezachena lehay milla. amar leh mimman shamat lah. amar leh, yoma chada havena azil bearcha, ushemana vachamena leh lerav hamenuna sava, (nusach acher lerabbi shimon) dehava darish lehay kera leribbi acha, vechevan deshamana chaddena beh, unetirnna leh tzarir bechanfa dilvushai, dela yitade minnay lealmin. amar leh, vadday milla kaddisha da, minnehiru devutzina kaddisha itnehir. zakkaa dara, dekayyme alma vesamchoy, sharyayn begavveh. vei ant tzerirat lehay milla bekishra chada dela yitade minach. ana etzror lah bitllatin, o bearbein kishrin bechisai, dela yitade minnay lealmin. (kan chaser).

Al hahi milla deachme kudesha berich hu lemoshe, begin deaf al gav deyisrael chavin kameh bechol dara vedara, la bae man deyema alayyhu daltorin. menalan. mehoshea, dichtiv, (Hoshea 1:2) techillat dibber Adonai behoshea, ha ukemuha milla. veal da (Hoshea 2:1) vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam vegomer. uvegin da barich lon bechamma birkan, leahaddera betiyyuveta, uleatava lon legabbe avuhon devishmayya, vela ade mittamman, ad dekudesha berich hu machal al chovayyhu, veitnekiu kameh.
Zohar, Vayakhel 1: (Shemot 35:1) vayyakhel moshe et kol adat beni yisrael vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Shmuel 1 15:6) vayyomer shaul el hakkeni lechu suru redu vegomer. ta chaze, ma ketiv baamalek, (Shmuel 1 15:6) pakadti et asher asa amalek leyisrael vegomer. vekudesha berich hu bechullehu keravin deavdu shear ammin legabbayyhu deyisrael, may tama la akshe kammeh, kehay kerava deavad amalek legabbayyhu. ella vadday, kerava deamalek hava bechol sitrin, leella vetatta, deha behahu zimna ittakkaf chivya bisha leella, vittakkaf letatta.

Ma chivya bisha kamin al parashat archin, uf hacha name amalek, chivya bisha hava legabbayyhu deyisrael, dechamin lon al parashat archin, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 15:2) asher sam lo badderech baaloto mimmitzrayim. kamin hava leella, lesoova makdesha. vechamin hava letatta, lesaava leyisrael. menalan, dichtiv (Devarim 25:18) asher karcha badderech. ketiv hacha asher karcha, uchetiv hatam (Devarim 23:11) ki yihye vecha ish asher la tahor mikre layla.

Val da bevilam ketiv, (Bamidbar 23:4) vayyikkar elohim el bilam. vayyikkar lishana dimsaava nakat. vei tema, ha ketiv elohim. ella kudesha berich hu azmin leh hahu atar dimsaava, leistaava beh, behahu darga deihu itdabbak leistaava beh. ma avad bilam. ihu chashiv beinnun karbanin lesalleka leella, miyyad zamin leh kudesha berich hu hahu atar. amar leh ha misavu legabbach, kema deitchaze lach, veal da vayyikkar elohim el bilam.

Kegavvna da asher karcha badderech vegomer. azmin legabbach hahu chivya bisha leella, lesaava lecha bechol sitrin. veilmale deittakkaf moshe leella, vihoshua letatta, la yachilu yisrael leh. uvegin kach, natir kudesha berich hu hahu devavu, ledare darin. may tama. begin dechashiv leakera at kayyayma meatreh. uvegin kach pakadti, bifkidda, deha tamman (vayyetze 159 amud bet) itremiz raza deat kayyayma kaddisha.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyomer shaul el hakkeni. man keni. da yitro. vechi man yahiv bene yitro hacha, lemehve diyyurehon baamalek, veha biricho havo sharyayn. ella ha ketiv, (Shoftim 1:16) uvene keni choten moshe alu meir hattemarim et bene yehuda midbar yehuda vegomer. vechad alu mittamman, sharu bitchuma daamalek, ad hahu zimna deata shaul malka, dichtiv vayyasar keni mittoch amalek.

Begin deha bezimna dechayyayvayya ishtechachu, (nusach acher itanashu) innun chaside vezakkae demishtachchin benayyhu, mittafsan bechovehon, veha ukemuha. kegavvna da, ilmale hahu irbuveya deitchabbaru behu beyisrael, la itanashu yisrael, al ovada deegla.

Veta chaze ma ketiv (197, 224 amud alef) bekadmita, (Shemot 25:2) meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo, leachlela kolla, begin devaa kudesha berich hu lemebad ovada demashkena mikkol sitrin, bemocha ukelifa. uvegin dahavo innun erev rav begavvavyyhu, ittemar meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo, leachlela lon benayyhu deyisrael, deinnun mocha. vechullehu itpekadu.

Levatar sata zina lezineh, veatu innun erev rav veavadu yat egla, vesatu avatrayyhu innun demitu, vegarmu lon leyisrael mota vekatola. amar kudesha berich hu, mikkan ulehala ovada demashkena la yehe, ella (197 amud alef) missitra deyisrael bilchodayyhu. miyyad vayyakhel moshe et kol adat beni yisrael vegomer. uchetiv batreh kechu meittechem teruma laAdonai. meittechem vadday, vela kekadmita dichtiv, meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo. vayyakhel moshe vegomer, mean atar kanish lon. ella begin dahavo innun erev rav benayyhu, itzterich moshe leachnasha lon, uleyachada lon mibbenayyhu.

(Shemot 35:1) vayyakhel moshe. ribbi abba patach, (Devarim 31:12) hakehel et haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf. ma lehallan kelala dechullehu yisrael, uf hacha kelala dechullehu yisrael, uman innun. shittin ribbo.

Ribbi elazar patach kera beyisrael, kad nachit moshe min tura desinay, dichtiv, (Shemot 32:17) vayyishma yehoshua et kol haam bereo vayyomer el moshe kol milchama bammachane. vayyishma yehoshua, vechi yehoshua shama, umoshe la shama. ella vadday, ad hasheta yehoshua la hava yada, umoshe hava yada. i hachi mahu bereo. ella bereo baAdonai ketiv, dehahu kalla besitra achara hava. vihoshua dehava anpoy desihara, istakkal behahu kala, dehava desitra deraa, miyyad vayyomer el moshe kol milchama bammachan.
Behahi shaata itbaru teren luche avna dahavo bekadmita. veha okimna, deinnun ityaykaru al yedoy venaflu veitbaru. may tama. begin defarchu atvavn miggo luche avanin. (81 amud alef, Vayikra 76)

Ta chaze, bed tekufin deshatta, kala ittear, bed sitrin dealma, behahu kalla ittearuta desitra achara ittear beh. vehahu ittearuta desitra achara al ben kalla lekala, veitchashach nehora bekala diltatta. begin dela mata nehora dekala dilella, lekala diltatta, keden akdim hahu ittearuta, veal ben da leda nachash dimfatte leitteta, venatil nehora. vehahu kala, hu kol milchama, kol raa. veda ihu bereo.

Veal da shama yehoshua vela moshe, begin denatal hahu raa nehora desihara dehava achid bah yehoshua. umoshe dehava achid beshimsha, la shama. veyisrael kullehu itchashach nehora dilhon, begin hahu raa deitdabbekat behu. kevan demachal kudesha berich hu chovehon, keden vayyakhel moshe et kol adat bene yisrael vayyomer alehem elle haddevarim vegomer, deha hahu erev rav itabbar minnayyhu.
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

rashi: Vaymaher moshe. kesheraa moshe shechina overet, veshama kol hakkeria, miyyad vayyishtachu:
Vayyiggof Adonai et haam. mita vide shamayim leedim belo hateraa:
ohc: Asher asa aharon. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan amar ze, veulay shehikpid Adonai al sheggarmu leaharon kedosh Adonai lachato, ki chet adam gadol lu yihye kechut hassaara yakpid Adonai alav limod.

O yirtze lehotzi hallaaz meal aharon, ki yisrael hem sheasu haegel asher asa aharon, ki maase aharon alehem yechashev, o letzad sheanasuhu o letzad shehem asu ikkar hammaase shehu hakkishshuf shebbo yatza medabber.

rashi: Uvacharoshet. leshon ammanut, kemo charash chacham (Yeshayahu 40), veunkelos peresh, veshinna beferushan, shecharash avanim karuy amman vecharash etz karuy naggar:
Lemallot. lehoshivah bemishbetzet shellah bemilluah – laasot hammishbetzet lemiddat moshav haeven veavyah:

Venatatta oto al avodat ohel moed. lamadta shennitztauu limnotam bitchillat nidvat hammishkan, achar maase haegel, mippene shennichnas bahem maggefa, kemo shenneemar vayyiggof Adonai et haam; mashal letzon hachaviva al bealeha shennafal bah dever umishsheppasak amar lo laroe bevakkasha mimmecha mene et tzoni veda kamma notru vahem, lehodia shehi chaviva alav; vei efshar lomar shehamminyan hazze hu haamur bechummash happekudim, shehare neemar bo beechad lachodesh hashsheni vehammishkan hukam beechad lachodesh harishon, shenneemar beyom hachodesh harishon beechad lachodesh takim vegomer (Shemot 40), umehamminyan hazze naasu haadanim – mishshekalim shello – shenneemar vayhi meat kikkar hakkesef latzeket vegomer (sham 38), ha lamadta shetayim hayu, echad bitchillat nidvatan achar yom hakkippurim beshana rishona, veachat beshana sheniyya beiyyar mishshehukam hammishkan. veim tomar vechi efshar shebbishnehem hayu yisrael shavim – 6 meot elef veg alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim – shehare vechesef pekude haeda neemar ken, uvechummash happekudim af bo neemar ken vayyihyu kol happekudim shesh meot elef usheloshet alafim vachamesh meot vachamishshim (Bamidbar 1), vahalo vishte shanim hayu, veie shelo hayu vishat minyan harishon bene 19 shana shello nimnu uvashsheniyya naasu bene 20! teshuva laddavar: etzel shenot haanashim beshana achat nimnu, aval leminyan yetziat mitzrayim hayu shete shanim, lefi shellitziat mitzrayim monin minnisan, kemo sheshshaninu vemasse rosh hashshana (daf 2), venivna hammishkan barishona vehukam bashsheniyya, shennitchaddesha shana beechad benisan, aval shenot haanashim menuyin leminyan shenot olam, hammatchilin mittishre, nimtzeu shene hamminyanim beshana achat – hamminyan harishon haya betishre leachar yohakki shennitratztza hammakom leyisrael lisloach lahem venitztauu al hammishkan, vehashsheni beechad beiyyar:
Al avodat ohel moed. hen haadanim shennaasu vo:
Uvelev kol chacham lev vegomer. veod shear chachme lev yesh bachem, vechol asher natatti vo chachma veasu et kol asher tzivviticha:
Nachon. mezumman:
Veish lo yaale immach. harishonot ay shehayu vitshuot vekolot ukehillot, shalta vahen ayin raa – en lecha yafe min hatztzeniut (sham):

Rega echad eele vekirbecha vechilliticha. im eele vekirbecha veattem mamrim bi bekashyut arpechem ezom alechem rega echad – shehu shiur zamo, shenne chavi chimat rega ad yaavar zaam (Yeshayahu 26) – vaachalle etchem, lefichach tov lachem sheeshlach malach:
Veatta. puranut zo tilku miyyad – shettoridu edyechem mealechem:
Veeda ma eese lach. bifkuddat shear heavon ani yodea ma shebbelibbi laasot lecha:
Lo nave lichsil taanug af ki leeved. kal vachomer hu, sheen nae sheeved yimshol bindivim:
targum: La yae lesachla finuka af la leavda denishtelat beravrevanin:

rashi: Vayyikra veshem Adonai. metargeminan ukera vishma da:

Hinne makom itti. bahar asher ani medabber immecha tamid, yesh makom muchan li letzarkecha sheatmincha sham shello tizzok, umishsham tire ma shettire, zehu peshuto; umidrasho, al makom shehashshechina sham medabber, veomer hammakom itti, veeno omer ani vammakom, shehakkabba mekomo shel olam veen olamo mekomo (tanchuma):
Vayyizer. leshon nipputz, vechen yezore al navehu gafrit (Iyov 18), vechen ki chinnam mezora harashet (Mishlei 1), shezzorin bah dagan vekitniyyot:

Vayyashk et bene yisrael. nitkavven levadkan kesotot; shalosh mitot niddonu sham, im yesh edim vehateraa besayif – kemishpat anshe ir hanniddachat shehen merubbin – edim belo hateraa bemaggefa, shenneemar vayyiggof Adonai et haam, lo edim velo hateraa behidrokan, shebbedakum hammayim vetzavu vitnehem (yoma 66):
ohc: Vayyikkach et haegel asher asu. lo haya tzarich lomar "asher asu", veulay ki letzad shehaegel hayu bo shete bechinot: letzad rosho haya dome leegel, uletzad zenavo haya dome lachamor, kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 2 192,1). laze lo yaspik lomar "vayyikkach haegel" levad, sheaz yite hattoe ki lo saraf ella tzad haegel shebbo velo tzad hachamor, laze amar asher asu lerabbot kol hammaase afillu chelek hachamor.

Od yirtze al derech amro (yirmeya 2:19) "teyasserech raatech", "vattemugenu" vegomer (yeshaya 64:6), ki hachet beatzmo hu yippara meosehu, ki achizat hara hi atzmo teabbed ohaveha vesone hakkedushsha, vehu amro asher asu vegomer "vayyashk et bene yisrael", vedavar ze yihye leven daat lifkoach enayim ivrot lisno bechinat hara veleehov madregat hakkedushsha ahavat hattov bema shehu tov.

Od ulay sheyyechavven lirmoz el bechinat hara sheasu shene hamechashshefim, shebbeemtzauto yatza haegel vehaya medabber veamar "elle elohecha", sheggam otah lakach. ki letzad bechinat shelitat hakkedushsha bakkelippa yutzdak lomar leshon lekicha, sheyyishlot alav leval yifne millefanav ad asot bo kattov beenav. vehinne lefanecha maase anshe keneset haggedola (yoma 69,2) asher lakchu yitzra daavoda zara vegam daavera veratzu leabbedo. umizze taskil ki kemo chen yishlot moshe bechayyotze baze lelakcho ulevaaro beesh ochalto. vehu amro vayyisrof baesh, sheyyoter yutzdak lomar leshon serefa bivchinat ruach raa shebbetoch haegel millomar kifshat hakkatuv shehu al guf haegel shehu hazzahav, ki lo yissaref hazzahav baesh im lo shettomar maase nissim o al yede emtzai, aval bechinat ruach haraa shebbo yoter yutzdak serefa. vehu sod (Yeshayahu 11,4) "uveruach sefatav yamit rasha".

rashi: Vayyar aharon. shehaya vo ruach chayyim, shenneemar betavnit shor ochel esev (tehillim 106), veraa shehitzliach maase satan velo haya lo pe lidchotam legamre:
Vayyiven mizbeach. lidchotam:

Vayyikra chag laAdonai machar. velo hayyom, shemma yavo moshe kodem sheyyaavduhu, zehu peshuto; umidrasho, bevayyikra rabba, devarim harebe raa aharon – raa chur ben achoto shehaya mochicham vaharaguhu, vezehu vayyiven mizbeach lefanav – vayyaven mizzavuach lefanav – veod raa veamar mutav sheyyittale vi hasserachon velo vahem, veod raa veamar im hem bonim et hammizbeach, ze mevi tzeror veze mevi even venimtzet melachtan asuy bevat achat, mittoch sheani vone oto vaani mitatztzel bimlachti, ben kach uven kach moshe va:
Chag laAdonai. belibbo haya lashshamayim, batuach haya sheyyavo moshe veyaavdu et hammakom:
ohc: Vayyar aharon. perush, raa devar pele, ki lo asa davar ella hishlicho baesh veyatza haegel meatzmo.

Vayyiven mizbeach lefanav. velo amar "vayyiven lefanav mizbeach", sheaz yihye nishma shellichvodo asa, vehu lo asa hammizbeach laegel ella lefanav asao vechavvanato lammakom. uledivre hazzohar (10 193.) yechuvvan gam ken al nachon, ki asa leval yafli chutz vehaya lo hammizbeach lemaasar kechol mechuyyeve mita.

Veamar chag laAdonai machar, nitkavven lidchot hashshaa, vechavvanato umachshavto bidvarav hayta lelohe yisrael emet, ki shem ze hu shem hameyuchad, veyisrael gam ken lema shepperashti ki lo neekra machashavtam veemunatam meAdonai emet veelav yechavvenu, ella sheratzu lakachat chelek mimmennu sheyyihye lifnehem, en devar negdiyyut ledatam bedivre aharon.

rashi: Yelech na adonay bekirbenu. kemo shehivtachta, meachar sheatta nose avon; veim am keshe oref hu veyamru vecha veamarta al zot pen achelcha baddarech, atta tislach laavonenu vegomer; yesh ki bimkom im:
Unechaltanu. vetittenenu lecha lenachala meyuchedet, zo hi vakkashat veniflinu ani veammecha – shello tishre shechinatcha al haummot:
ohc: Yelech vegomer ki am vegomer. kashe, ki bedivre Adonai (Shemot 33:3) neemar lo "lo eele bekirbecha ki am keshe oref", im ken ki taam am keshe oref hu yimna alot Adonai bekirbam, veech noten moshe hattaam atzmo kede sheyyaale? od kashe, lamma hutzrach lishol davar shekkevar nitratztza lo Adonai kesheshshaal mimmennu lalechet immahem veheshivo (Shemot 33:17) "gam et haddavar hazze vegomer eese"?
Achen yitbaer hainyan bedikduk od lamma amar moshe kan shem adnut, vetigdal hakkushya lema shepperashti lemala (Shemot 33:3) ki lo chafetz moshe ella bivchinat harachamim.

Veulay ki kesheggilla Adonai lemoshe middotav yitbarach veraa hafelagatam, hiskil ki im yitnaheg Adonai im yisrael bemiddot ellu belo din kol ikkar, kemo sheshshaal kodem haavarat hattov lefanav, lo yuchelu amod bederech yashar lifne Adonai ki am keshe oref hu. laze chazar bo veshaal sheela shehu letzad kevod hammelech, leval yesovev tuvo lezalzel bemitzvotav yitbarach, ki behistallek meharshaim bechinat haddin kol ikkar yihyu pokrim. laze amar yelech na adonay shehi bechinat haddin, veshaal midda shehaya tzarich lah keamro vesalachta laavonenu, umidda zo enah bivchinat adnut, vechen hu omer (Shemot 23:21) "ki lo yissa lefishachem" ella bemiddat harachamim. nimtzeta omer ki yachpotz moshe berachamim vedin, ki tovim hashshenayim min haechad.
Unechaltanu. perush, shello yachlifem beumma acheret, ella yihyu lo nachalat olam.

rashi: Gedol chema nose onesh vegomer. im taavir al chamatcha vetatztzil et sonaacha im raita raa baa lo, od tosif yamim vetova:
targum: Gavra chemtana mekabbel takka uchema demitale al tuaneh mosif:

rashi: Ze yittenu. hera lo kemin matbea shel esh umishkalah machatzit hashshekel veomer lo kaze yittenu (talmud yerushalmi 400 1):
Haover al happekudim. derech hammonin maavirin et hannimnin ze achar ze, vechen kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet (Vayikra 27), vechen taavorna hatztzon al yede mone (Yirmeyahu 33):
Machatzit hashshekel beshekel hakkodesh. bemishkal hashshekel shekkatzavti lecha lishkol bo shikle hakkodesh, kegon shekalim haamurin befarashat arachin usede achuzza:
Esrim gera hashshekel. achshav peresh lecha kamma hu:
Gera. leshon maa; vechen bishmeuel (1 2), yavo lehishtachavot lo laagorat kesef vechikkar lachem:

Esrim gera hashshekel. shehashshekel hashshalem arbaa zuzim, vehazzuz mittechillato chamesh maot, ella vau vehosifu alav shetut veheeluhu leshesh maa chesef, umachatzit hashshekel hazze sheamarti lecha yittenu teruma laAdonai (bechorot Adonai):
ohc: Ze yittenu vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (tanchuma) lakach kemin matbea shel esh mittachat kisse hakkavod veherahu lemoshe. vekashe, vahalo yoter tihye nisseget hayyedia baamira kesheyyomar lo hammishkal beferush mimma sheyyakkir betavnit esh, ki hashearat shiur haddemut lo techakek betziyyur leshaer eleha ella bismichut.
Venire behair, lamma nitratztza Adonai bemachatzit hashshekel levad, ulefachot haya lo lomar shekel shalem, gam lamma yetzav Adonai leval yosif heashir uleval yigra heani mimmachatzit hashshekel.

Velatet taam lishte hearot nitkavven Adonai veamar lo ze yittenu, da ki en ikkar hainyan hu hannigle ella hannistar shezze ba bedimyono, uchevar katavnu bechamma mekomot ki shechinato yitbarach shehi bechinat kisse kevodo yitbarach al yede maase bene yisrael yesovvu happereda, vehu amro (Yeshayahu 50:1) "uvefishechem shullecha immechem", gam amro (Mishlei 16:28) "venirgan mafrid alluf", veal yede maase haegel shehu keneged kol hattora kullah yesovvu haferadat hashshechina besharshe bechinat kol nishmot yisrael. laze tzivva Adonai sheyyittenu machatzit hashshekel shehu siman lema shehifridu hem bemaasehem lashuv leyachadam yachad, ulehakkarat haddavar herahu kemin matbea shel esh mittachat kisse kevodo ki sham bechinat sharshe nishmot bene yisrael, veamar lo ze yittenu, perush, yachzor latet sod machatzit hashshekel shehifrid vehu ze yesod vesod haddavar, velaze yechavven kol noten verachamana libba bae lechavven el hamechuvvan leyached hannifrad vehannechlak, velaze gamar omer et terumat Adonai vehu ma sheramaznu bemachatzit hashshekel ki mitkannet bechina zo beshem terumat Adonai.

Umeatta im yarbe heashir hinne hu mafsid hakkavvana shehi haikkar. laze tzivva veamar heashir lo yarbe vehaddal lo yamit, vehattaam latet et terumat Adonai kannizkar, sheim yarbe o yamit en rishshum terumat Adonai nikkar. uletaam ze hikdim hakkatuv zichron hashshiur veachar kach zichron hannetina, shehaya lo lehakedim zichron hannetina veachar kach shiurah, ella nitkavven latet taam hakkitzba lamma katzav machatzit hashshekel, veamar latet vegomer kemo shepperashnu. veulay ki ramaz gam ken sheen hakkitzba shava ella bivchinat hakkitzba, aval bivchinat hakkavvana – min hannimna ki yishvu kol yisrael bechavvanat hallev, shekkol echad kefi bechinat chibbato bekono yaase haddavar becheshek gadol, vehaven. velaze samach mitzvat hahashvaa lo yarbe heashir velo yamit heani mimmachatzit hashshekel, aval bivchinat hakkavvana en metziut lehashevot hallevavot.

Uvederech remez titbaer al ze hadderech, ki va hakkatuv legallot nistarot laAdonai asher yaase beolamo, davar shekkol roe yitma behillakach ish tzaddik yashar kodem zemanno, yechetzu yamav kammishpat hammitchayyev leanshe damim umirma. veyibbahalu rayone haadam lachshov echad mishshene derachim: o yachchish bar minnan osher hatztzaddikim ki en tov beamal haelohi, o yachshov ki ze haish matzpuno eno kannigle mimmennu vehurea chezkato letov. asher al ken amar Adonai ki tissa et rosh bene yisrael, perush, im tire sheyyistallek rosh bene yisrael belo et velo yaale bechelach kaalot gadish beitto, hattaam hu lifkudehem, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:14:2) befasuk "eshkol hakkofer dodi li" veamru zichronam livracha: ish shehakkol bo hu kofer nafsham shel yisrael. vehu amro lifkudehem leshon chissaron, al derech amro (Bamidbar 31:49) "velo nifkad mimmennu ish", ki letzad chissaron yisrael shennitchayyevu, laze ani notel et rosham baadam lechofer nafsham shello yamutu kol yisrael. veyitbaer gam ken lifkudehem al derech amram bazzohar (Zohar chodesh) befasuk "kol haover al happekudim" – kol haover al hammitzvot, lomar ki taam hachissaron hu letzad avram al mitzvot Adonai. umeatta lo yachshov adam ra lo al hammesallek lamma velo al hammistallek ki nistaro bilti hagun.

Veamar Adonai ki letzad shehaddor hu haggorem lillakach hatztzaddik, laze tzarich latet kol ish yisrael kofer nefesh hatztzaddik shemmet baado, vehu amro venatnu ish kofer nafsho shel hammistallek o gam ken shel hannisharim sheyyargishu biftirat hatztzaddik shennilkad bishchitotam, vechol echad yaskil ki chayyav mita lashshamayim vitakken maasav, vehu ma shemmeforash bedivre kabbala (Yeshayahu 57:1) "mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik", perush, im hassovvim davar hirgishu bechesrono vetikkenu maasehem shello tavo, veim lo hirgishu kede shello yihye betoch haraa shettavo acharav, velaze tzivva Adonai kan venatnu ish vegomer.

Veamro bifkod otam, perush, lo yeacharu netinat hakkofer ella techef umiyyad bifkod otam, bemaase ze shennatal rosham kol echad yetakken meuvvato. veamro velo yihye vahem vegomer, ha lamadta sheim lo yaasu kannizkar yihye vahem vegomer. veamar bifkod otam ramaz ki lo yeuchar haonesh ella techef lappekida, vechen timtza shebbechol et sheyyistallek hatztzaddik raa habbaa acharav hi semucha liftirato, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 113:) uchemo sherainu beenenu baddorot hallalu.

Veamro ze yittenu, kan peresh hakkatuv ma hu kofer nefesh shetztzivva latet, veamar ze yittenu, yechavven el sefer hattora dichtiv (Yehoshua 1:8) "lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha". gam amru zichronam livracha ki hakkadosh baruch hu lefanav kol hayyom munach sefer tora kemishpato asher tzivva lemelech yisrael (Devarim 17:19) "vehayta immo" vegomer, vehu ma sheherahu baetzba "ze yittenu", usetamo keferusho sheal hammunach lefanav tamid tzivva Adonai, uveemtzaut ma sheyyilmedu battora hi meginna umechapperet avon umarba zechuyyot, keamram (menachot 110,1) "vetalmud tora keneged hakkol", vaafillu hayu beyad haadam averot rabbot "zot hattora laola lammincha velachattat velaasham" keillu hikriv kol hakkarbanot hammechapperim. vehu amro kol haover al happekudim shehem hammitzvot, ze yihyu lo letikkun kol davar. venimshach gam ken amro kol haover im shellematta, lomar tikkun lemi sheeno ben tora bema yitten kofer nafsho ki hu bor rek en bo mayim, laze amar kol haover vegomer yitten machatzit hashshekel, keyissashochar uzevulun veshimon achi azarya (sota ka,1), verabbim kahem asher yechetzun kaspam laamele tora.

Veamro beshekel hakkodesh perush bead shekel hakkodesh shehu hattora, o yirtze shebbaze yishve hu lenoten imre sefer, keamro (Kohelet 7:12) "betzel hachachma betzel hakkasef". od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (bechorot 5.) shekel hakkodesh kaful haya, uva lehodia ki ma sheyyittol mehakkodesh bead machatzit kaspo lo sheyyitnakke mechelek hallomed venimtza kol echad en beyado ella machatzit sachar, lo chen hu, ki shekel hakkodesh kaful haya venimtza kol echad beyado shekel shalem, vehaven.

Veamro esrim gera vegomer, ramaz lishte asiriyyot shebbashshechina, kisse Adonai, vehammelech hayyoshev al hakkisse, vehaven. vehinne beemtzaut hallomed vehaose yitkavven haddavar leyichud habbechinot, verasham beamro machatzit hashshekel teruma laAdonai ki hi zot shechinat el chay vehi hannifgemet bemaase yisrael umityachedet battora umaasim, umeatta hagam ki shenayim asu haddavar kol echad yittol keneged hashshenayim kayyadua hattaam.

Veamro heashir lo yarbe, perush ki hannoten machatzit shiklo baolam hazze lo yerae beenav shehu davar merubbe veyera beenav lechallek machatzito, veamar vehaddal lo yamit, perush letzad heyoto dal unechasav metzumtzamim lo yamit. vetaam sheni amar latet et terumat Adonai lechapper al nafshotechem, uveerech hammutztzag yuktan kol hannittan baado. vechan yesh shete hassagot yekarot: achat shebbaze yitten terumat Adonai veyichud kudesha berich hu veen erech laddavar hallaz, veod lechapper bead hannefesh asher baadah yitten adam "or bead or" vegomer (Iyov 2:4).

Veamro kol haover vegomer mibben esrim shana, kan hodia sod ma shello chiyyeva hattora laadam ella ad shehu ben esrim, shehu letaam ad sheyyaggia legader ze shettihye nafsho shelema mehassagat hammuskol mehahadragot haruchaniyyim haelohiyyim asher nefesh yisrael mishsham hu velazzeman hannizkar tassig, vehu sod amro (tehillim 2:7) "Adonai amar elay beni atta ani hayyom yelidticha", veayyen bedivre hazzohar (mishpatim tzach.). veyesh taam nichbad lamma lo yeanesh adam ad gevul ze, ki hu letzad sheadayin lo shalma dato behakkarat hammuskol uvehaskalat hayyedia uvetigboret hammaspik lehaarachat milchama lishbor koach hammesit ulenatztzeach taavot hattiviyyot ulehaskil birtzon hannefesh ulehavchin et asher yedabber belibbo im leosher, uvihyoto ben esrim hinne hu shalem bedato lehachazik magen vetzinna betigboret hassechel vehahavchana vehabbechira bederech hachayyim, vehaven.

rashi: Farua. megulle; nitgalla shimtzo ukelono, kemo ufara et rosh haishsha (Bamidbar Adonai):
Leshimtza bekamehem. lihyot lahem haddavar hazze lignut befi kol hakkamim alehem:
ohc: Ki farua hu. perush, sar tzillam mealehem, ki noam Adonai haya alehem miyyom shekkibbelu hattora vehusar mesukkatam.

Ki ferao aharon. ulay sheyyechavven lomar sheal yede teshuvat aharon nishar kol chov heavon alehem, ki aharon lo asa davar sheyyesh bo mammash beinyan haegel, vehakkol naasa al yede notne zahav: natnu hazzahav veasu bo mechashshefut latzet haegel sheyyatza, velo asa aharon ella lekichat hazzahav unetinato baesh, veaf ze beones keamro "ki vera hu", umeatta mityaches kol heavon alehem veen lahem michse hashshiggayon, vehu amro ki ferao aharon perush betaanato.

Leshimtza bekamehem. kol shiur katan mibbechinat hattiuv yikkare shemetz, veamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kav.) en lecha tzara sheoveret al yisrael sheen bo meavon chet ze, gam yirtze ki haummot hakkamim alenu tamid maane befihem: "kevar hitavtem atzmechem veniznachtem".

rashi: Vehaya. leshon hove:
Ketzet. moshe min hammachane lalechet el haohel:
Yakumu kol haam. omdim mippanav, veen yoshvin ad shennitkassa mehem:
Vehibbitu achare moshe. leshevach – ashre yelud ishsha shekkach muvtach shehashshechina tikkanes acharav lefetach oholo:

Lechapper al nafshotechem. shelo tinnagfu al yede minyan; davar acher lechapper al nafshotechem, lefi sheramaz lahem kan 3 terumot – shennichtav kan terumat Adonai shalosh peamim, achat terumat adanim shemmenaan keshehitchilu venidvat hammishkan, shennatnu kol echad veechad machatzit hashshekel, veala limat hakkikkar, shenneemar vechesef pekude haeda meat kikkar (Shemot 38), umehem naasu haadanim shenneemar vayhi meat kikkar hakkesef vegomer (sham); vehashshenit af hi al yede minyan, shemmenaan mishshehukam hammishkan, hu hamminyan haamur bitchillat chummash happekudim beechad lachodesh hashsheni bashshana hashshenit (Bamidbar 1), venatnu kol echad machatzit hashshekel, vehen liknot mehen karbenot tzibbur shel kol shana veshana, vehushvu vahem aniyyim vaashirim, veal otah teruma neemar lechapper al nafshotechem, shehakkarbanot lechappara hem baim; vehashshelishit hi terumat hammishkan kemo shenneemar kol merim terumat kesef unechoshet (Shemot 35), velo hayta yad kullam shava vah ella ish ma shennedavo libbo:

ohc: Vayyinnachem Adonai. perush, lishne teamim nicham: haechad letzad heyot haddavar ra, hashsheni leheyot hara leammo.
Od yirtze al ze hadderech – vayyinnachem al haraa asher dibber, davka letzad haddibbur, aval im nishba – lo.
Od yirtze, shello nicham ella al haraa asher dibber, dehaynu lechallotam, aval yesh adayin raa acheret shello nicham aleha, vehem haddevarim haraim asher sibbevam haegel kayyadua.

Od yirtze, shello nicham ella al haraa asher dibber laasot leotam shello chatu, shemmityachasim beshem ammo, aval otam sheavdu avoda zara beedim o belo edim, ella ballev heeminu bah – raatam amda leummatam: mehem nagaf Adonai vechulei, umehem hishkam moshe, umehem hikkum bene levi.

rashi: Mishshene evrehem. hayu haotiyyot nikraot, umaase nissim hu (shabbat 104):
ohc: Vayyifen vayyered. tzarich ladaat amro vayyifen sheeno mehilchot derech eretz sheyyifen moshe, veulay ki laze dikdek lomar min hahar shello lomar shechas veshalom nahag minhag miut derech eretz sheppana oref mippene hashshechina ella min hahar hu sheppana, vekashe im ken haya lo lomar "vayyifen min hahar", veod kashe shello haya tzarich lomar "vayyifen" kol ikkar.
Veulay sheyyechavven lomar shettashash kocho, vehaya mityare mehammalachim, vehaya mefanne atzmo letzidde hahar keadam hannechba lalechet.

Od yirtze al derech amram (Devarim Rabba 1) ki lema doma darko shel moshe, keshehaya medabber im hakkadosh baruch hu haya omer "lamma Adonai yechere" vegomer, ucheshehalach etzel yisrael hafach hasseder veamar "attem chatatem" vegomer ad kan, vehu amro vayyifen, perush shello nishar keseder panim harishonim shehaya mare keshehaya omed lifne hammakom.

Luchot haedut. ulay sheramaz gam ken beamro haedut, shehem meidim ki hem ketuvim ketav elohim, letzad heyot ketavam mufla mizze umizze behashevaa, ma sheen michtav ze yachol lihyot al yede maase adam, ki haot tishtanne tzuratah meever haacher. gam maamaram zichronam livracha (Megila 3.) sheamru mem vesamech shebballuchot benes hayu omdim, veulay shehaot hazze yitztaref im ot maase halluchot vehayu shene haotot leedut, sheen edut pachot mishshenayim, vehu amro vehalluchot maase elohim hare ed echad, vehammichtav michtav elohim ed sheni.

rashi: Mibben esrim shana vamala. limmedcha kan sheen pachut mibben esrim yotze latztzava venimne bichlal anashim:
Rabbim yechallu fene nadiv vechol harea. hakkol naasim reim leish mattan. yesh lefotro benotne tzedaka veyesh lefotro bemarbitze tora:
targum: Sagie dimshamshin kodam rabba vedilvishin yahev muhavta:

rashi: Vayyomer ani aavir vegomer. higgia shaa shettire bichvodi ma shearshe otcha lirot, lefi sheani rotze vetzarich lelammedcha seder tefilla; shekkeshennitzrachta levakkesh rachamim al yisrael hizkarta li zechut avot, kesavur atta sheim tamma zechut avot en od tikva, ani aavir kol middat tuvi lefanecha al hatztzur veatta natun bammeara:

Vekarati veshem Adonai lefanecha. lelammedcha seder bakkashat rachamim af im tichle zechut avot, vechasseder ze sheatta roe oti – meuttaf vekore 13 middot – heve melammed et yisrael laasot ken, veay sheyyazkiru lefanay "rachum vechannun" yihyu naanin – ki rachamay lo chalim:
Vechannoti et asher achevan. otan peamim sheertze lachon:
Verichamti. et sheechpotz lerachem; ad kan lo hivticho ella ittim eene veittim lo eene, aval bishat maase amar lo hinne anochi koret berit (Shemot 34) – hivticho sheenan chozrot rekam:
ohc: Ani aavir kol tuvi al panecha. perush, kol middot tovot sheani metiv bahem livriyyotay, veamro al panecha, perush, taam hassagatcha davar ze mimmenni hu "al panecha", perush, panim asher atta mare beotzem hafelagat ahavatcha vecheshkecha bi kemo shepperashti befasuk "panim el panim" (Shemot 33:11).

Vekarati vegomer. perush, aavir middotay veekraem kol achat bishmah lefanecha, veulay ki kol midda tikkare bishmah vechullam yikkaru beshem havaya baruch hu, veen lecha hodaa gedola mizzo shehikkir bishmiat haozen kol middotav yitbarach kol achat tikkare beaznav.
Veamro vechannoti vegomer, hodio ki otah shaa hi sheat rachamim vachanina lishol maavav.

rashi: Adonai Adonai. middat rachamim hi, achat kodem sheyyecheta, veachat achar sheyyecheta veyashuv (rosh hashshana 17):
El. af zo middat rachamim, vechen hu omer eli eli lama azavtani (Tehillim 22) – veen lomar lemiddat haddin lama azavtani, kach matzati bimchilta:
Erech appayim. maarich appo veeno memaher lippara, shemma yaase teshuva:
Verav chesed. latztzerichim chesed – sheen lahem zechuyyot kol kach:
Veemet. leshallem sachar tov leose retzono:
ohc: Adonai Adonai el rachum. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (rosh hashshana 17:) ki shete middot ellu shel rachamim, achat kodem sheyyecheta adam veachat achar sheyyecheta. veharosh zichrono livracha hiksha: kodem sheyyecheta lamma tzarich rachamim? veteretz ki tzarich rachamim letzad ki Adonai yodea sheatid lachato, o medabber hakkatuv bechoshev baavoda zara veelav yikra kodem sheyyecheta, perush kodem sheyyaavor. veen devarav rishonim veacharonim muvanim li, ki im yavo Adonai lehaanish al ma sheatid, nomar lefanav gam ken lamma barata oto kevan sheatta yodea sheyyecheta, veyadin oto al heatid, ki kodem ledato vekodem cheto yishve bahem hammishpat vaafillu samuch lemaase hachet, vehaven. uma shekkatav bechoshev baavoda zara vaadayin lo asa, kashe, ki ze yikkare achar maase, ki hagam shello avad, chet hammachashava nitpas alav.

Vaani omer sheyyitztarech lerachamim afillu kodem sheyyecheta, im en lo zechut shehu kiyyum mitzvot ase lehanot mehem, hu haadon yachon oto berachamim. vehinne lefanecha mikra (Devarim 11:13): "vehaya im shamoa tishmeu vegomer venatatti metar" vegomer, hare shebbischar maase hattov yavo hattov, veim haya adam anus velo lamad vechulei en lo lo sachar velo onesh uvamme yerucham, laze amar Adonai kodem sheyyecheta, vehu chiddush. veod afillu hitiv maasav veavar al mitzvot lo taase yitnaheg immo berachamim.

Od yirtze lehodia ki kesheyyetiv Adonai berachamav leish, hagam sheyyecheta lo yifchot mittuvo davar, vetihye hammidda shehaya bah kodem mitnaheget gam achar shechata. laze amar rachamim shekkodem sheyyecheta lehashevot lahem rachamim sheyyihyu achar sheyyecheta. uvaze nacha dati birot ki lo yishtanne tuv harshaim velo chelum ki chen hi hammidda.

rashi: Koret berit. al zot:
Eese niflaot. leshon veniflinu, shettihyu muvdalim bezo mikkol haummot, shello tishre shechinati alehem:
Naham kakkefir zaaf melech. hakkadosh baruch hu:
targum: Nahem hech arya zaafeh demalka vehech tala al isba reuteh:

rashi: Et yedehem veet raglehem. bevat achat haya mekaddesh yadav veraglav; vechach shaninu vizvachim (daf 19); ketzad kiddush yadayim veraglayim? manniach yado hayemanit al gabbe raglo hayemanit veyado hassemalit al gabbe raglo hassemalit umekaddesh:
ohc: Et yedehem veet raglehem. lo haya tzarich lomar ella yedehem veraglehem, ella nitkavven lomar sheen rechitza leyadayim belo raglayim velo leraglayim belo yadayim, laze amar et perush im yedehem raglehem veim raglehem yedehem, vehem divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha bizvachim (zevachim 19:) shetztzarich lekaddesh yadayim veraglayim keechad.

rashi: Lama Adonai yechere appecha. kelum mitkanne ella chacham bechacham, gibbor begibbor:
ohc: Lamma Adonai yechere vegomer. al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 42,6) sheamru sheerev rav levad asu et haegel, vehu amro (Shemot 32:7) "shichet ammecha", uledivrehem zichronam livracha behechreach lomar shehayta hahakpada al kol yisrael shello michu, uchefi ze yihye kavvanat moshe beamro lamma taana hannishmaat ki kevan sheerev rav hem hammashchitim en rauy sheyyechere appo beammo shehem yisrael, vahagam sheyyesh lahem din umishpat, im kol ze lo lacharot appo bahem, umimmotza davar atta yodea ki hiskim al hashemadat erev rav. veulay ki ze diyyek beamro asher hotzeta meeretz mitzrayim velo erev rav shemmeatzmam yatzu. venire ki chol erev rav shehayu az metu, sheafillu patron shekkibbelam hiskim al kelayatam vegam en lo panim levakkesh rachamim alehem im al kabbalatam neenash kemo shekkatavnu lemala, gam en lahem zechut avot vetaanot shehizkir moshe betaanato.

Ulefi peshat hakkatuv sheyyisrael asu haegel vehishtachavu lo, taan moshe keneged chelek shello asu, ki halo timtza shemmetu kol ose risha vehem shelosha: yesh sheavdu beedim vehateraa, veyesh beedim levad, veyesh behateraa levad, vechol ellu metu velo nisharu ella mi shello hayu bo echad mishshelosha, vaAdonai amar lemoshe "vaachallem veeese otcha legoy gadol", ze yore shebbikkesh laakor et hakkol, laze tzaak libbo el Adonai lamma Adonai yechere appecha beammecha, perush, beotam shello avdu kol ikkar velo mardu becha, ki al taanat haarvanut lo yeaker mehem zichron ammecha.

Asher hotzeta vegomer. betaana ba listor ma sheamar veeese otcha legoy vegomer, ki lo yittachen sheyyimmatze hachanat osher hatztzidkut kaasher yimmatze beam ze ki hem hotziam mimmitzrayim, ma sheen ken bene moshe asher yakum Adonai enam begeder ze. vahalo timtza ki techillat devar Adonai baaseret haddibberot (Shemot 20:2) amar "asher hotzeticha" vegomer, ze yore ki yetziat mitzrayim hu davar hammaamid hishtabedutam labbore, velech na ree ma shekkatavti beferush pasuk ze. veod bechol hammitzvot timtza remez yetziat mitzrayim, veim ellu lo yaamdu baavodat hakkodesh mikkol shekken habbaim mimmoshe asher lo yadu veenam begeder yetziat mitzrayim. umeatta hefsed ze en lo tikkun bivne moshe. veamro bechoach gadol perush, veyesh lachush lema shebba bechoach gadol leval yafsidennu.

Od yirtze beamro asher vegomer, perush, letzad ki Adonai amar elav shichet ammecha shello ratza lechannotam elav, im ken ech yashuv moshe lehazekiram lefanav beshem "ammecha" shehu davar sheshshelalo Adonai? asher al ken dikdek bilshono veamar hotzeta vegomer, perush, lo letzad shehem ammecha adayin ani kore otam ammecha, ella livchina zo asher vegomer.

rashi: Vayyitten el moshe vegomer. en mukdam umeuchar battora – maase haegel kodem letziuuy melechet hammishkan yamim rabbim haya – shehare veyz betammuz nishtabberu halluchot, uveyom hakkippurim nitratztza hakkabba leyisrael, ulemochorat hitchilu venidvat hammishkan vehukam beechad benisan (tanchuma):

Kechalloto. kechalloto ketiv – chaser – shennimsera lo tora bemattana kechalla lechatan, shello haya yachol lilmod kullah bizman muat kaze. davar acher, ma kalla mitkashshetet bechd kishshutin – hen haamurim besefer yeshaya – af talmid chacham tzarich lihyot baki bechd sefarim:
Ledabber itto. hachukkim vehammishpatim shebbivelle hammishpatim:
Ledabber itto. melammed shehaya moshe shomea mippi haggevura vechozrin veshonin et hahalacha shenehem yachad:
Luchot. luchot ketiv shehayu shetehen shavot (sham):
ohc: Vayyitten vegomer kechalloto. tzarich ladaat lamma hifsik ben zichron hannetina lezichron davar hannittan behodaat hazzeman, shehaya lo lomar "vayyitten el moshe shene luchot kechalloto", o haya lo lehakedim "kechalloto" kodem zichron hannetina. od yesh lehair lamma icher Adonai netinat halluchot ad zeman ze, kevan shello haya bahem ella aseret haddibberot, beyom mattan tora o lemochorato haya lo latet halluchot?

Achen yitbarer hainyan al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Zohar 10 93:) sheamru shekkol hammitzvot halo hemma betoch tocham shel aseret haddevarim, vehu amro vayyitten el moshe kechalloto ledabber itto behar sinay, uma dibber itto? shene luchot haedut, perush ki haddevarim balluchot sam lo el elyon, veeno min harauy latet lo halluchot ad sheyyigmor harashum bahem, velaze gamar haddevarim hannirmazim bahem beluchot haedut unetanam lo velo kodem. uvaze nityashshevu shene haddikdukim keachat al nachon, uchefi ze maamar "shene luchot" nimshach im "kechalloto ledabber itto" vegomer, venimshach im "vayyitten" haamur bitchillat hakkatuv.

Ketuvim beetzba elohim. hakkavvana baze al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, ekev) ki halluchot nechtzevu mittachat kisse kevodo yitbarach, veulay ki ze hu sheramaz beamro "maase elohim", perush maase (elohim) hu hakkisse, vehaven. uchevar nitparesh ki yesh bechinot rabbot orot hakkedushsha besod (Kohelet 5:7) "ki gavoah meal gavoah vegomer ugevohim", vetze ulemad mimmaase hannifla shehuva besefer hazzohar hakkadosh (Zohar 10 52.) kesheala moshe lammarom ufaga bemalach sandal vechulei, veachar kach bemalach metat vehaya yare malach meishsho shel ma shelmala mimmennu pen yisrefehu vechen vechulei, vehinne amar hakkatuv (Devarim 4:24) "ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu", ki ishsho hakkedosha hi ochelet kol esh zulatah.

Vehodia hakkatuv ofen ketivat halluchot bamme nichtevu, veamar ketuvim beetzba elohim, perush ki haya Adonai metzayyer tzurat haot beetzbao kivyachol, perush bechinat or echad meoro yitbarach bidmut etzba keneged halluach keshiur shetach evre haotiyyot, kede shello yihye charut ella et asher yetzayyer kenegdo. uletzad otzem tokef oro yitbarach lo haya or shel halluchot yachol amod bechol hammakom asher yechavven kenegdo etzba elohim, vehaya neechol o mitztamtzem latztzedadin vehaya nishar kol asher yitztayyer kenegdo chalul. velaze nichtevu mishshene evrehem, vehu amro (Shemot 32:16) "charut al halluchot", velo amar charut balluchot sheyyihye nishma sheasa hacherut balluchot ella al, perush shehaya manniach etzbao baruch hu al halluchot bedimyon tzurat haot, uvaze nechretu haotiyyot shel aseret haddevarim.

rashi: Yasser bincha ki yesh tikva veel hamito al tissa nafshecha. al takkehu makkat mavet:
targum: Rede verach metul deit sichveya ulemituteh la terim nafshach:

rashi: Vekiddashta otam. meshicha zo mekaddashtam lihyot kodesh kadashim, uma hi kedushshatam? kol hannogea vegomer: kol harauy lichli sharet, mishshennichnas letocho, kadosh kedushshat hagguf – lippasel beyotze velina utevul yom veeno nifde latzet lechullin, aval davar sheeno rauy lahem en mekaddeshin; ushenuya hi mishna shelema etzel mizbeach: mittoch shenne kol hannogea bammizbeach yikdash (Shemot 29), shomea ani ben rauy ben sheeno rauy, talo kevasim, ma kevasim reuyim af kol rauy; kol meshichat mishkan vechohanim umelachim meturgam leshon ribbuy, lefi sheen tzorech meshichatan ella ligdulla, ki chen yissad hammelech shezze chinnuch gedullatan, ushear meshichot – kemo rekikin meshuchin (sham), vereshit shemanim yimshachu (Amos 6) – leshon arammit bahen kilshon ivrit:
Chachma. ma sheadam shomea meacherim velamed:
Tevuna. mevin davar millibbo mittoch devarim shellamad:
Daat. ruach hakkodesh:

Vedibber im moshe. kemo umedabber im moshe; targumo umitmallel im moshe shehu kevod shechina, kemo vayyishma et hakkol middabber elav (Bamidbar 7), veeno kore medabber elav; keshehu kore middabber, pitrono hakkol middabber beno leven atzmo, vehahedyot shomea meelav, ucheshehu kore medabber mashma shehammelech medabber im hahedyot:
Ree atta omer elay. ree – ten enecha velibbecha al devarecha:
Atta omer elay vegomer veatta lo hodatani vegomer. vaasher amarta li hinne anochi sholeach malach, en zo hodaa, sheen ani chafetz bah:
Veatta amarta yedaticha veshem. hikkarticha mishshear bene adam beshem chashivut, shehare amarta li hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan vegomer vegam becha yaaminu leolam (Shemot 19):
ohc: Ree atta omer vegomer. kavvanat hainyan hu ki letzad sheasao shaliach lehaalot yisrael el haaretz, vehu amro atta omer elay haal vegomer, veshittef immo od shaliach echad mehaelyonim, dichtiv "veshalachti lefanecha malach", umin harauy haya lehodio ladaat et mi yelech, laze amar veatta lo hodatani mi hu hammalach asher yelech immi, ladaat im askim al haddavar o lo, ki en adam mishtattef bedavar im mi sheeno makkiro. veim tomar shebbeal karchi askim lalechet im hammalach shettitten li, ben im yihye noach li o lo, halo atta amarta yedaticha veshem, perush, amarta li sheoti giddalta mikkol asher ahavta, meamro (Shemot 6:3) "vaera el avraham vegomer ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem", ha lamadta sheelay noda bishmo yitbarach hammeyuchad, vehu ma sheamar kan yedaticha veshem, veshiur tevat yedaticha tair lemulach keshiur "nodati" bimkomah, vehaven.

Veamar od vegam matzata chen beenay, titbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni 173) sheamru: kesheala moshe lammarom matza rabbi akiva shehaya doresh vechulei, amar moshe lifne hammakom: "shelach shelichut ze beyad rabbi akiva shehu yoter mimmenni", veheshivo Adonai ki eno chafetz ella bemoshe. vehinne hainyan yaggid sheen ze ella metziut chen velo letzad hahassaga bammuskalot, shehare hikkir moshe beene sichlo ki rabbi akiva atzum hu mimmennu, veaf al pi chen lo ratza Adonai ella bemoshe, veze siman lechen. umeatta ech titnaheg immi bemidda zo? en ze ella sheadayin lo noda li middotecha, laze shaal lehodio middotav.

rashi: Lo tishchat vegomer. lo tishchat et happesach vaadayin chametz kayyam; azhara lashshochet o lazzorek o leechad mibbene chavura (148 63):
Vela yalin. ketargumo; en lina moelet berosh hammizbeach veen lina ella beammud hashshachar (zevachim 87):
Zevach chag happasach. emurav, umikkan atta lamed lechol hekter chalavim veevarim:
Vaydabber. leshon koshi hu, kemo vaydabber ittam kashot (Bereshit 42):
Lech red. miggedullatcha – lo natatti lecha gedulla ella vishvilam (berachot 32), beotah shaa nitnadda moshe mippi vet din shel mala (tanchuma):

Shichet ammecha. shichet haam lo neemar, ella ammecha – erev rav shekkibbalta meatzmecha vegiyyartam velo nimlachta bi, veamarta tov sheyyidbeku gerim bashshechina – hem shichatu vehishchitu (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Lech red ki vegomer. kafal lomar lech red, achat legufo sheyyelech veachat lomar lo sheyyered miggedullato. veim haya omer red levad, hayinu omrim ki leheyoto bahar amar leshon yerida, vechen hu omer (Shemot 19:14) "vayyered moshe min hahar". vetzarich ladaat ofen yerida zo ma hi. veulay shehodio ki kol maalato hayta bishvil yisrael, umeatta shechatu lo yassig hannevua kammachaze harishon. o efshar ki sham bimkom amidato lo haya bo koach laamod sham kevan shekkashal ozer, vehu ma sheamar lo red, perush, lo taamod bammakom harishon, vehattaam – ki shichet ammecha shemmikkocham bata.

Vekashe, im ken haya lo lomar ken meet sheamru yisrael "elle elohecha", im letzad sheyyisrael avdu avoda zara titchayyev yeridat moshe miggeder shehaya bo. veyesh lomar, behair od lamma hutzrach Adonai lehaarich hodaat avon yisrael, uma gam ledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin mag:) sheamru bemaase achan sheshshaal yehoshua davar meet Adonai lehodia mi hammoel bacherem, vehayta teshuvat Adonai elav: "delator ani lecha"? im ken kan bema shellefanenu lo haya lo lomar lemoshe haddevarim haraim sheasu yisrael. vehen emet ki sham haya davar sheeno omed lehitgallot veyesh baze delatorut, ma sheen ken bimtziut ze shehaya davar sheomed lehitgallot beredet moshe min hahar, im kol ze, beerech mekor hachasidut vetohorat hallashon, kesef nivchar leshon tzaddik lo yaggid kaddevarim haelle.

Achen taam divre Adonai hu ki chas veshalom lo ledalter al ose avel ba haelohim, ella letzaddek dino hatztzedek. vehu ki letzad sheamar lemoshe red miggedullatcha, hutzrach lomar al ma hukka bet meahavo, ma pisho ki yoridennu eloah. velaze amar ki shichet ammecha, vechal alav lehodio ofen hahashchata shealeha nitchayyev moshe hayerida, vesidder shelosha devarim: 1 asu lahem vegomer, 2 vayyishtachavu lo vayyizbechu vegomer, 3 vayyomru elle vegomer, vehem keneged dibbur machshava umaase. vehitchil bammachshava veamar asu lahem hare machshava, meet sheasauhu chashvu baavoda zara, vehu ma sheddiyyek beamro lahem. veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk (Shemot 20:3) "lo yihye lecha elohim acherim" vegomer. keneged hammaase amar vayyishtachavu lo vayyizbechu lo, en lecha maase gadol mizze. keneged haddibbur amar vayyomru elle elohecha vegomer. uletzad ze tashash koach moshe beshalosh bechinot shehem nefesh ruach neshama, velo yuchal amod bemadrega rishona. umimmotza davar atta yodea ki kodem sheavru yisrael al shelosha peratim adayin haya moshe yachol amod beemtzaut bechina hannisheret belo pegam, sheim lo chen uveachat o bishtayim mehaamur yesh taam lemishpat hayyerida, lo haya Adonai megalle lemoshe kol hammaasim mishshum pegam daltorut kemo shekkatavnu. umeatta en makom lekushyatenu lamma lo yarad meet amram "elle elohecha" o meet sheamru leaharon "ase lanu elohim".

rashi: Becharish uvakkatzir. lamma nizkar charish vekatzir? yesh merabbotenu omrim al charish shel erev sheviit hannichnas lashsheviit, vekatzir shel sheviit hayyotze lemotzae sheviit, lelammedcha shemmosifin mechol al hakkodesh, vechach mashmao: sheshet yamim taavod uvayyom hashshevii tishbot, vaavodat 6 hayyamim shehittarti lecha, yesh shana shehecharish vehakkatzir asur, veen tzorech lomar charish vekatzir shel sheviit, shehare chevar neemar sadcha lo tizra vegomer (Vayikra 25), veyesh omrim sheeno medabber ella bashshabbat, vecharish vekatzir shehuzkar bo lomar lecha, me charish reshut af katzir reshut, yatza ketzir haomer shehu mitzva vedoche et hashshabbat (rosh hashshana 9):
Vehinnachem. hitashshet machashava acheret – lehetiv lahem
Al haraa. asher chashavta lahem:
ohc: Lamma yomru vegomer. perush, yesh baze chillul hashshem, ki yomru mitzrayim: etmol amar (Shemot 4:22) "beni vechori yisrael shelach vegomer veyaavdeni", vehen atta gilla sofo al techillato ki lo letova yechavven vechas veshalom nire kesheker. od nitkavven baze, ki davar yadua sheyyisrael yaavdu Adonai vechol haummot yaavdu avodot acherim, umimma sheyyiru shehotziam Adonai leraa ma shello asa leovde zulato, im ken chas veshalom pegam gadol mufla leovde Adonai, vetechezakna yede ovde elilim chazaka sheyyesh immah taana.

Veamro tevat lemor, ki en hechreach sheyyomru haddevarim kemot shehen kesidran, ella yomru devarim shezze kavvanatam. o yirtze lomar sheen haddevarim amittiyyim chas veshalom ella bivchinat haamira. od yirtze ki lo mitzrayim levad yomru ella yomru hem veyashmiu haddevarim lakkol, shebbaze yitrabbe chas veshalom chillul hashshem.

rashi: Veatta vegomer. im emet shemmatzati chen beenecha hodieni na et derachecha. ma sachar atta noten lemotze chen beenecha:
Veedaacha lemaan emtza chen beenecha. veeda bazo middat tagmulecha – ma hi metziat chen shemmatzati beenecha; ufitron lemaan emtza chen – lemaan akkir kamma sechar metziat hachen:

Uree ki ammecha haggoy hazze. shello tomar veeese otcha legoy gadol veet elle taazov, ree ki ammecha hem mikkedem, veim bahem timas, eni somech al hayyotzim mechalatzay sheyyitkayyemu, veet tashlum hassachar shelli baam hazze todieni; verabbotenu darshu bemassechet berachot (daf 7), vaani leyashshev hammikraot al afnehem veal sidram bati:
ohc: Veedaacha lemaan emtza chen. perush, letzad sheen mehammusar lomar eved laadono sherotze ladaat oto, laze gamar omer lemaan vegomer, perush kede shennaase hanehaga yeshara bitmidut lefanecha, vehu metziut chen hammussag beene Adonai:

Uree ki ammecha haggoy hazze. kan dibber moshe bannelam meene adam vehoda elav, vehu taana hannishmaat lifne habbore mikkol hatteanot sheamar, vehu ki nishmot yisrael hem chelek Adonai, kemo shepperashti beshirat haazinu befasuk (Devarim 32:9) "ki chelek Adonai ammo", vehu gam ken ma sheramaz Adonai beamro (Shemot 20:2) "anochi Adonai elohecha" uchemo shepperashti sham, vehu ma shettaan beamro uree perush, ree bifrat ze, ki ammecha haggoy hazze perush, semuchim udevukim immecha, veech timas chelek elyon, vehaven:

rashi: Ko amar vegomer. vehechan amar? zoveach laelohim yochoram (Shemot 22) – kach shenuya bimchilta:
Achiv. meimmo vehu yisrael (yoma 66):
ohc: Ish et achiv veish et kerovo. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar veish et kerovo achar sheamar et achiv shehu karov shebbakkerovim? achen yechavven lomar sheyyesh kamma achim sheddatam merucheket ze mizze, veim anashim acherim lo kerovim hemma lahem yohavu ahavat nefesh, veze yimmashech mishshoresh hanneshamot, ki yesh neshamot shekkerovim besharsham venimshachim berichuk molidim, veyesh neshamot shehem meruchakim besharsham uvaim bekeruv molid, veyoter yohavu hakkerovim bekirvat hashshoresh mehakkerovim bivchinat molid, velakkerovim bivchinat molid yityaches shem achva velakkerovim besharsham yityaches shem karov, uchefi ze yedabber hakkatuv bishte habbechinot vezo lemala mizzo.

rashi: Veheshiv moshe et hammasve al panav ad boo ledabber itto. ucheshebba ledabber itto notlo meal panav:
ohc: Verau vene yisrael vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan chazar hakkatuv lehodia ze, veulay ki yashmienu shehutzrechu yisrael lirot haddavar peamim acherim lehatzedik ki karan or panav, letzad shehaya mechush shehaor hallaz haya letzad akkavato et Adonai notztzu orot befanav, uvehaarich hazzeman yachzor haddavar lichmot shehaya, laze hayu mistakkelim befanav bechol et lehatzedik ki karan vegomer. veulay ki chazra atara leyashnah bivchinat panav, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 20,12) besifro shel rabbi meir katuv "katnot or", kemo chen moshe naasa or panav or.

Od yirtze, ki hagam sheasa moshe hammasve, lo danu mippene ze leesor lirot panav bizman sheen masve, ella verau vene yisrael et pene moshe, vehaddavar muvan ki lo bederech issur hayu roim, mimma shello hikpid alehem, vechefetz Adonai lirot beor hachayyim.
Chassalat parashat ki tissa

rashi: Memullach. ketargumo meorav, sheyyearev shechikatan yafe yafe ze im ze; veomer ani sheddome lo vayyiru hammallachim (Yona 1), mallachayich vechovlayich (Yechezkel 27) – al shem shemmehappechin et hammayim bimshotot keshemmanhigim et hassefina, keadam hamehappech bechaf betzim terufot learvan im hammayim, vechol davar sheadam rotze learev yafe yafe mehappecho beetzba o bevazech:
Memullach tahor kodesh. memullach yihye, vetahor yihye vekodesh yihye:
ohc: Memullach tahor. nire ki perush "tahor" hu shello yerae bo irbuv gevanim, ki letzad sheyyesh bo echad asar sammanim yitrabbu haggevanim, vahagam sheyyearvem yachad, letzad ribbuy hassammanim veribbuy hakkammut shelosh meot veshishshim ushemona manim, tishshaer eze pinna bo sheen haggaven shave bah. vahagam sheyyihye shave, af al pi chen kesheyyedakdek bechush dakkut harut yaskil ki enennu gaven echad, veeno karuy metziut ze "tahor". laze amru memullach tahor, perush zach sheyyerae gaven echad mammash beemtzaut hattaarovet maase umman, uveemtzaut heyotah dakka beyoter.

rashi: Vayyomar hareeni na et kevodecha. raa moshe shehaya et ratzon udevarav mekubbalim, vehosif lishol lehareoto marit kevodo:
ohc: Hareeni na et kevodecha. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (mechilta al Shemot 15:2) sherauhu yisrael al sefat hayyam, uchetiv (Shemot 33:11) "vedibber Adonai el moshe panim el panim", en ze ella reut esh ochla, vahagam sheamar Adonai leaharon umiryam (Bamidbar 12:7) "lo chen avdi moshe vegomer umare vegomer utemunat Adonai yabbit", en ze ella temunat or elyon, umoshe ratza shettihye lo hakkara bo yitbarach yedia peratit kede sheyyuchal sichlo yaskil bechinat haelohut, ki raa sheat hakkosher vehirchiv piv lishol.

rashi: Et haddevarim haelle. velo atta rashshay lichtov tora shebbeal pe (gittin 60):
Vekidda. shem shoresh esev, uvilshon chachamim ketzia:

Hin. 12 luggin; venechleku vo chachme yisrael — rabbi meir omer bo shalku et haikkarin, amar lo Rabbi yehuda vahalo lasuch et haikkarin eno sippek ella sheraum bammayim shello yivleu et hashshemen, veachar kach hetzif alehem hashshemen ad shekkalat hareach, vekippecho lashshemen meal haikkarin (horayot 11):

ohc: Saru maher min hadderech. yitbaer al pi divrehem (chullin 5.) sheamru hammode baavoda zara kechofer bechol hattora kullah, vehu amro saru min hadderech asher tzivvitim hare kol ma shetztzivva bichlal.

Od yirtze lefi ma shepperashnu ki yisrael odam beemunat Adonai hashshelema, ella chashvu lihyot lifnehem koach echad meel elyon, laze amar saru min hadderech asher tzivvitim, perush, leval asot emtzaiyyim veasu derech emtzaiyyim, velaze lo amar mardu bi o kafru bi ki odam beemunatam.

Asu lahem vegomer. perush acherim asu lahem haegel, ki hem natnu hazzahav veyatza haegel meatzmo, vehodia Adonai ki lo meatzmo yatza kemaamar aharon (Shemot 32:24) "vayyetze haegel hazze", ella al yede maase, vehu maamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha (tanchuma) ki yonos veyimberus asu vegomer:

Vayyomru elle vegomer. kashe lamma [hippech] seder heasuy shehaya lo lehakedim amirat "elle elohecha" kodem hazzevicha, shekken matzinu shebbeyom rishon amru "elle" vegomer umimmochorat zavchu vegomer. vehinne lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 42,6) sheerev rav hem haosim kol maase haegel velo yisrael, yesadder hakkatuv haderagot heavon beerech yisrael lo beerech erev rav, veamar haderaga echad asu lahem, perush, erev rav asu egel massecha leatzman velo michu yisrael. od hishtachavu vezavchu erev rav velo michu yisrael, vezehu haderaga gedola yoter meharishona. veod amru beferush "elle elohecha yisrael" veshatku yisrael, vezo kasha mikkullam.

Ulefi peshat hakkatuv, taam sheicher amro "elle elohecha", hagam shehu bechinat pegam haddibbur vehu madrega memutztzaat ben hammachshava lammaase, letzad sheyyesh bo bivchinat dibbur ze haderaga gedola shekkibbeluhu leeloah leolam beamram "asher heelucha", vetaam ze yaggid hahatmada livne vanim vehu pegam mufla, laze siddero baacharona kederech "lo zo af zo".

Od nire ki tamo hu, lefi ma shemmaggid mashmaut "elohecha" lenocheach ki lo yisrael hem hammedabberim, im ken haddevarim shekulim hem, im hashshomim maamar "elle elohecha" hiskimu laze o lo. laze lo amar battechilla ella "asu lahem egel", veachar shehishtachavu vezavchu lo nitgalla lemafrea ki shamu vehiskimu al haddavar, velaze achar shehizkir Adonai "vayyishtachavu vayyizbechu lo", amar vayyomru elle vegomer, lomar ki hatzedakat haddavar shehem hiskimu hu mimma shehishtachavu vegomer:

rashi: Veachare chen niggeshu. achar shellimmed lazzekenim, chozer umelammed happarasha o hahalacha leyisrael; tanu rabbanan ketzad seder hammishna? moshe haya lamed mippi haggevura, nichnas aharon shana lo moshe pirko, nistallek aharon veyashav lo lismol moshe, nichnesu vanav, shana lahem moshe pirkam nistalleku hen, yashav elazar limin moshe veitamar lismol aharon, nichnesu zekenim, shana lahem moshe pirkam, nistalleku zekenim yashvu latztzedadin, nichnesu kol haam, shana lahem moshe pirkam; nimtza beyad kol haam echad, beyad hazzekenim shenayim, beyad bene aharon shelosha, beyad aharon arbaa vechulei. kidita veeruvin (daf 54):
Venatatta mimmenna vegomer. hi ketoret shebbechol yom vayom sheal mizbeach happenimi shehu veohel moed:
Asher ivvaed lecha shamma. kol moade dibbur sheekba lecha, ani kovam leoto makom:
El asher dibbarti lech. yesh kan lach etzel dibbur bimkom elecha, vechen ledabber lo al adoniyyahu (Melachim 1 2:19):
Hinne malachi. velo ani:

Uveyom pokdi vegomer. atta shamati elecha millechallotam yachad, vetamid tamid kesheefkod alehem avonotehem ufakadti alehem meat min heavon hazze im shear haavonot; veen puranut baa al yisrael sheen bah ketzat mippiron avon haegel (sanhedrin 102):
Ledorotechem. mikkan lamdu rabbotenu lomar shekkullo kayyam leatid lavo:
Ze. begimatriyya teresar luggin havu (keritut Adonai):
Maase elohim hemma. kemashmao – hu bichvodo asaan; davar acher, keadam haomer lachavero kol asakav shel peloni bimlacha pelonit, kach kol shaashuav shel hakkabba battora:
Charut. leshon cheret vacherat echad hu, shenehem leshon chikkuk, anetaleyyr belaaz:
Vayhi beredet moshe. keshehevi luchot acharonot beyom hakkippurim:

Ki karan. leshon karnayim, shehaor mavhik uvolet kemin keren; umehechan zacha moshe lekarne hahod? rabbotenu amru min hammeara, shennatan hakkadosh baruch hu yado al panav, shenneemar vesakkoti chappi (tanchuma):
ohc: Vayhi beredet vegomer. amar vayhi leshon tzaar, lirmoz ma shennichvu kol hatztzaddikim shebbemachane yisrael mimmaalat moshe asher anta befanav, dichtiv "vayyar aharon vechol bene yisrael et moshe vehinne karan" vegomer (Shemot 34:30).

Beredet moshe mehar vegomer. lo noda gezerat hakkatuv ayye mekomah, od tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar beridto min hahar velo hispik bema sheamar besamuch "beredet moshe" vegomer. od tzarich ladaat leeze inyan hodia hakkatuv shelilat yediat moshe baddavar kodem sheyyodiennu techilla inyan kerun panim sheyyeshno. od tzarich ladaat mi hodio lemoshe kevan shello yada meatzmo, veim hodiuhu lamma lo hodia hakkatuv seder hahodaa.

Achen yitbaer hainyan lefi ma shehodia hakkatuv achar ze ki natan moshe masve al panav bitmidut, zulat beet limmudo. im ken yomar haomer: lamma lo natan moshe masve al panav beridto min hahar bizman shello haya melammed et yisrael tora? laze amar hakkatuv umoshe lo yada – ze haya sibba shello natan al panav masve kodem, veraahu aharon veyisrael vehinne karan or panav. vaadayin yikshe al ze ech yihye haddavar shello yargish baal chay bedavar nosaf befanav, uvifrat kerun panim. laze hikdim hakkatuv lomar hassibba shemmana mimmenna hayyedia veamar beredet moshe mehar – perush, ki bihyoto bahar lu yihye sheyyargish behod panav yitle haddavar ki yavhiku panav meor pene el hammedabber immo, uveridto min hahar nistallek teliyyat haregashat or panav. vaadayin tikshe lamma lo hirgish bemeshech yeridato? laze amar ushene luchot haedut beyad moshe beridto min hahar – perush, bechol meshech ridto min hahar, velaze haya tole ki ma shehaya margish befanav haya meor halluchot el mul panav yairu, velo yada ki kerun panim haya kavua bo beor panav. vehu amro lo yada ki karan or panav, perush, yada bekerun panim aval lo chashav shehaya or kavua beor panav vehaya tole balluchot shebbeyado, veze haya sibba shello asa masve veraahu aharon. uchefi ze gezerat hakkatuv hi vayyar aharon vegomer, ki zulat kol hakkatuv lo hayu roim aharon veyisrael kerun panim kodem sheyyikraem, shehaya sam masve kaasher asa achar kach keshehinniach miyyado halluchot velo nishar bema litlot, meatzmo hirgish mattat elohim ki karan or panav venatan hammasve techef, besod (Mishlei 25:2) "kevod elohim haseter davar".

Uvammidrash (Shemot Rabba 47,6): rabbi yehuda bar nachman amar, keshekkatav moshe hattora nishtayyer bakkulemos kima, veheeviro al rosho, umishsham naasa karne hod, ad kan. vedivrehem zichronam livracha setumim vachatumim. veulay sheyyechavvenu lomar ki matzinu shemmiddat haanava lemala mikkol, keamram zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba 81): ma sheasta chachma atara leroshah shehu hayyira, dichtiv (tehillim 111:10): "reshit chachma yirat Adonai", asta anava akev lesandalah, dichtiv (Mishlei 22:4): "ekev anava yirat Adonai". umatzinu sheheida hattora al moshe (Bamidbar 12:3) sheanav meod mikkol haadam, uchesheamar Adonai lichtov haddevarim matzinu lo shello katav "anav" ella "anav" chasera yod, veaf ze min haanava. uvischar ze zacha lekarne hod, ki hifli birtzono yitbarach, gam Adonai hifli chasdo lo beshannoto mikkol haadam. vehu ma sheramaz rabbi yehuda beamro nishtayyer bakkulemos kima, vehu ot yod shehaya tzarich lichtov velo katav lerov anvato, umimmenna zacha kannizkar.

rashi: Veatta dabber el bene yisrael. veatta aappi shehifkadticha letzauotam al melechet hammishkan, al yekal beenecha lidchot et hashshabbat mippene otah melacha:
Ach et shabbetotay tishmoru. aappi shettihyu redufin uzerizin bizrizut hammelacha, shabbat al tiddache mippaneha, kol achin verakkin miutin – lemaet shabbat mimmelechet hammishkan:
Ki ot hiv beni uvenechem. ot gedulla hi venenu, shebbacharti vachem behanechili lachem et yom menuchati limnucha:
Ladaat. haummot bah ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem:
ohc: Veatta dabber vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro veatta ma sheeno ragil lomar bishar mitzvot. gam tosefet vav. od lamma kafal lomar dabber el bene yisrael lemor, vahagam shepperashti bitchillat parashat teruma ki tzarich lomar "dabber" velo taspik "lemor" levad, kan hosif lomar tevat lemor paam sheniyya millevad lemor rishona. od tzarich ladaat amro ach, veamro shabbetotay leshon rabbim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu beferek kelal gadol (shabbat 69,1) shebba litten shemira achat leshabbatot harebe, yeuyyan sham, uvemakom acher (mechilta) darshu "shabbetotay" lehavi devarim shehem mishshum shevut.
