Venire lefaresh hakkatuv, vekodem naamod al kavvanat tevat "ach et shabbetotay", venaale derech sham lehasekil amro "veatta" vetosefet "lemor", veyitbaer al pi ma sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (shabbat 129,1) shemchallelim et hashshabbat letzarche chole sheyyesh bo sakkana ulechol pikkuach nefesh vechaddome, vehu ma sheramaz beamro ach et shabbetotay, perush yesh metziut sheen lecha lishmor shabbat. vedikdek beamro et shabbetotay lichlol kol hannikra shabbat, ben shabbat bereshit ben yom hakkippurim ben shear moadot lammelachot haasurot bahem, gam lerabbot afillu shabbat achar shabbat im adayin hiv mesukkan lo yomar adam kevar chillalti alav shabbat achat ella hare hiv behetter ad sheyyetze mehassakkana.

Od nitkavven lirmoz inyan echad sheheelu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (yoma 84.) (haacharonim), vehu sheim amaduhu lechole sheyyesh bo sakkana shetztzarich laasot lo refua yedua sheyyesh bah melechet shabbat shemona yamim, en omrim shello lechallel ella shabbat echad, ella yaase miyyad af al pi shemmechallelin shete shabbatot, ad kan. vehu amro ach et shabbetotay:

Od yirmoz beamro et shabbetotay latet taam lammiut, lamma ani omer lecha shettechallel shabbat al hachole? en ze karuy chillul, adrabba ze karuy shemirat shabbat – challel alav shabbat echad kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harebe. veshiur hakkatuv kefi ze hiv al ze hadderech: shimru shabbatot harebe al yede shettaase miut shemira bahem, umetziut haddavar hiv lechallel shabbat al hachole, shebbaze atta mechallel shabbat echad lishmor shabbatot harebe. veen omrim baze "en omrim leadam chata bishvil sheyyizke chavercha", ki davka beover avera umechallel shabbat beyado, keotah sheamru (shabbat 4.) hidbik pat betannur shechillel shabbat vechayyav mita al ze, en omrim lo chata vechulei, aval chole amra tora challel, afillu david melech yisrael im yizdammen haddavar leyado yechallel, vehannimna mehaddavar en ze ella mezalzel bemitzvat hael chas veshalom.
Vegamar omer ki ot hi beni uvenechem, perush veim ken im en shomer en shabbat.

Veamro ladaat, kan nitchakkem Adonai lehodia shekkedushshat nefesh yisrael gedola mikkedushshat shabbat, shezze nidche mippene ze, vedavar pashut hiv shehakkatan hiv hannidche mippene haggadol, vehu amro ladaat, perush baze atta yodea ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem, yitgaddel veyitkaddesh shemo yitbarach:

Verashi zichrono livracha peresh "ach" lemaet melechet hammishkan shello tihye beshabbat, udevarav emet, ella shemmashmaut hammiut hiv beshabbat lo chutz mimmennu. gam minnayin yaale al haddaat sheyyaasu melechet hammishkan beshabbat shehutzrach lemaet? veen kavvanatenu beferush ze lehakeshot ulehassig al happerushim, uvifrat divre Rashi hammekuddashim, veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.

Uledarkenu naskil ladaat kavvanat Adonai beamro veatta dabber vegomer, shehakkavvana hi letzad sheramaz Adonai miut echad bishmirat shabbat, umiut ze lo noda maasehu ma yaggid, veel moshe amar beal pe tevunato velo bichtav meforash. ki toratenu shettitalle devareha mezukkakim veotiyyoteha sefurot, vechol ot vaot maggedet halachot veniflaot, kaasher yasad bah haadon bechachma rabba beshivim panim vearbaa ofannim usheloshim veachat netivot, vechol nativ bechamma shevilin. vetze ulemad maamaram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 19,3) befasuk "sheloshet alafim" vegomer, vehakkol bemikra muat. ella sheyyesh lecha ladaat sheyyesh derashot vedikdukim battora shehem chovat kol adam nivra lehakkiram, vehem devarim sheyyesh bahem halachot, veyesh sheen bahem chovat kol adam.

Veal yikkachacha libbecha ledabber lifne haelohim lamma yaase cho laavadav, lehaalim mehem taalumot chachma velo hodia kol davar bichtav meforash. hinne teshuvatcha lenochach enecha ki hem devarim shello yechilem sefer, vetze ulemad maamar kadmonenu (avot derabbi natan 25) shehayu omrim: im yihyu harkiim gevilim vechulei eno maspik lichtov ma shellamad merabbo velo chisser mimmennu tippa mehayyam, vechen talmido amar alav. vehakkol ramuz yosher bammikra, gadol adonenu verav tevunot asher katav mikra muat uvo hishmia ma sheen koach bannivraim lichtov miyyom bero elohim adam al haaretz ad sof kol haddorot, vehakkol nimsar lemoshe besinay. velaze, letzad sheamar bichtav miut bishmirat shabbat uveal pe neemar lemoshe kavvanat hammiut, vehi tora shebbeal pe, laze tzivva Adonai lemoshe lomar leyisrael kavvanat haddevarim asher hodio lehashemiam lechol am yisrael ki davar ze hiv chova lehashemia lakkol. vehu amro veatta, perush, millevad hammichtav tosif atta ledabber lahem beal pe kavvanat hammaamar hassatum, shehu ma shemmemaet bishmirat hashshabbatot.

Veze hiv amro dabber el bene yisrael lemor, perush, dabber lahem kavvanat hammaamar ma shepperashti lecha bo, ki hammaamar atzmo kevar amar "lemor", velo ba ella al amirat happerush hanneemar lo beal pe kannizkar, ki hiv ze mehaddevarim shehem chovat adam lishmoa. veal pi derech ze yesh lanu lehithallech bearchot chayyim bechol hattora asher yomar hakkatuv lemor, vechazar lomar dabber el bene yisrael – achat lidvarim shebbichtav veachat lidvarim shebbeal pe hatztzerichin lahalachot asher yaase otam haadam. vahagam shepperashnu beofen acher, ellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.

Od nire lefaresh amro veatta vegomer, al derech ma sheamru bemassechet shabbat (shabbat 10,1) befasuk "ladaat ki ani Adonai" vegomer, sheamar hakkadosh baruch hiv lemoshe: "mattana tova yesh li bevet genazay" vechulei, mikkan shehannoten mattana lachavero tzarich lehodio, vehattaam kede lehachazik lo tova vachaninut. vehikshu mikkerun pene moshe, veamru ki shel moshe avida leiggeluye vechulei ad kan. vehu amro veatta dabber, perush, lo tikkach shiur meatzmecha kesheyyitgalle lecha mattenat karnot hod velo hodaticha, tomar ken haddevarim bemattenat shabbat sheani noten leyisrael velo tegalle – lo chen hiv, ella dabber vegomer velo tikkach hammishpat mimmecha. vehattaam hiv sheatta atid ladaat aval yisrael lo avida leiggeluye sheyyedu sheyyesh lahem. veamro ot hi, perush, veal tomar vahalo gam shabbat avida leiggeluye veyedu meatzman sheyyesh lahem bo menucha veoneg, gam hitkonnut lagguf leval yechele migiot hattirda vechamma perate hattovot. laze amar ki ot hi, perush, kol hammenucha vehaoneg hannirgash leyisrael beyom hashshabbat eno ella ot hi beni vegomer, perush, siman lattova haggenuza, vehi bechinat olam shekkullo shabbat, vehu mushlal hahassaga zulat al yede mitzvat shabbat, vehi neshama yetera habbaa mimmennu, vehaven ki hiv sod attik. veim ken lo avida leiggeluye, laze dabber vegomer ladaat vegomer, ki tzarich lehodia maalat hammattana leachzuke aleha tova ulevarech lannoten baruch hiv asher mekaddesham bikdushshat shabbat lehassig haosher hammuflag vehammufla.

Lechem lo achal vegomer. hutzrach lefaret lechem umayim velo hispik lomar lo achal velo shata, ledayyek bidvarav ba ki davka lechem umayim hu shello achal veshata, aval achila acheret ushetiyya acheret achal veshata, keamro (tehillim 40:9) "vetoratcha betoch meay", gam nimshela lemayim (taanit 7.), veim haya omer lo achal velo shata yesh bemashma kol min achila ushetiyya:

rashi: Zechor leavraham. im avru al aseret haddibberot, avraham avihem nitnassa vaasara nisyonot vaadayin lo kibbel secharo, tenehu lo veyetzu asara vaasara (tanchuma):

Leavraham leyitzchak uleyisrael. im lisrefa hem, zechor leavraham shemmasar atzmo lissaref alecha beur kasdim, im lahariga, zechor leyitzchak sheppashat tzavvaro laakeda, im legalut, zechor leyaakov sheggala lecharan, veim enan nitztzolin bizchutan, ma atta omer li veeeshe otcha legoy gadol? veim kisse shel 3 raglayim eno omed lefanecha vishat kaascha, kal vachomer lechisse shel regel achat (berachot 32):

Asher nishbata lahem bach. lo nishbata lahem bedavar shehu kale – lo vashshamayim velo vaaretz velo veharim velo baggevaot – ella vecha, sheatta kayyam ushevuatcha kayyemet leolam, shenne bi nishbati neum Adonai (Bereshit 22), uleyitzchak neemar vahakimoti et hashshevua asher nishbati leavraham avicha (sham), uleyaakov neemar ani el shadday pere ureve (sham 35) – nishba lo beel shadday:
ohc: Zechor leavraham vegomer. en hakkavvana al hashshevua, shezze kevar heshivo Adonai sheyyekayyem shevuato bezaro shel moshe veyihye legoy gadol vehu zaram shel avot gam ken, ella ba lomar ki yitatztzevu haanashim meod al hammeora. gam ba betaana shetztzarich lizkor zechutam mittaam sheamar baaseret haddibberot (Shemot 20:6) "veose chesed laalafim leohavay", vehu amro avadecha, veamro asher nishbata vegomer, kol ze lehagedil hammussag laavot letzad haahava.

Vechol haaretz hazzot vegomer. rabbu baze hadderachim, veyesh mefarshim shehem divre moshe sheamar lifne Adonai ma sheamarti lahem vegomer, veefshar lomar ki hu divre Adonai, uferush amarti leshon maala, al derech amro (yeshaya 3:10) "imru tzaddik", vezehu perush kol haaretz vegomer asher romamti al kol haaratzot etten vegomer, vechen matzinu sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 11:12) "eretz asher vegomer ene Adonai elohecha" vegomer, vehakkavvana baze lehazekir maalatam lefanav.

rashi: Ufeter chamor. velo shear behema temea:
Tifde vese. noten se lakkohen vehu chullin beyad kohen, ufeter chamor muttar baavoda labbealim:
Vaarafto. orfo bekofitz; hu hifsid mamon kohen, lefichach yufsad mamono:
Kol bechor banecha tifde. chamishsha selaim pidyono katzuv, shenneemar ufeduyav mibben chodesh tifde (Bamidbar 18):

Velo yerau fanay rokem. lefi peshuto shel mikra davar bifne atzmo hu, veeno musav al habbechor – sheen bemitzvat bechor reiyyat panim – ella azhara acheret hi, ucheshettaalu laregel leraot lo yerau fanay rekam – mitzva alechem lehavi olat reiyyat panim. ulefi midrash barayta mikra yater hu, umufne ligzera shava, lelammed al haanakato shel eved ivri shehu chamishsha selaim mikkol min vamin, kefidyon bechor; bemassechet kiddushin (daf 17):
Hon yosif reim rabbim. ohavim rabbim. veyesh lefotro bemi shellamad tora:
targum: Mazala mosif chavre sagie umiskena faresh chavreh mineh:

rashi: Haddavar hara. sheen hashshechina shora umehallechet immam:
Ish edyo. ketarim shennittenu lahem bechorev kesheamru naase venishma (shabbat 88):
Vehishtachavu. lashshechina:

Malve Adonai chonen dal ugemulo yeshallem lo. kesheyyechele veyitte lamut, tzidkato melitza alav lifne middat haddin, lomar: heani hayta nafsho mefarkeset latzet baraav veze pirnesah vehechezirah legufah, af ani achazir lo nafsho:
targum: Man devae dinzif lelaha mitrechem al miskena ufureanuta tavta meshalem leh:

rashi: Me asa lecha haam. kamma yissurim savalta sheyyisserucha ad shello tavi alehem chet ze:
ohc: Me asa lecha vegomer. perush, letzad sheissur maase avoda zara laacherim eno ella belav (282 hilchot avoda zara 83) umalkut levad hu shechayyav, veen ze middevarim shenneemar bahem yehareg veal yaavor, vechol sheanasuhu hare ze patur, aval tzarich hekker ones sheanasuhu, veim lav hare ze chayyav malkut vaafillu lo hitru bo ki chaver eno tzarich hateraa (makkot 6:), velaze amar elav me asa lecha haam hazze mehaones ki heveta alav vegomer bema sheasita lahem avoda zara.

Veanahu aharon atta yadata et haam ki bera hu, perush vaazoram (vesuram) mochiach ki yareu veyashchitu. veod, vechi sover atta sheasiti beyadi haegel? lo chen hu, ella hishlachti hazzahav veyatza meatzmo al yede maase shehaya kemaamaram zichronam livracha (tanchuma ki tissa 19) sheasu yonus veyimberus. umeatta lu yehi shello haya ones bainyan, hare lo avar al hallav ki lo asa beyado lo tzura velo demut.

Od yirtze amro me asa vegomer, perush, lu yihye sheanasucha beones hammaspik laavor al hallav, af al pi chen haya lecha leshaer hachataa haggedola shettassigem, vehaya lecha lisbol hatztzaar leval teabbed am rav, veanahu ki lo asa davar kannizkar.
Veshamru vene yisrael vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hosif od shemira acheret. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro laasot et hashshabbat, verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu ma sheddarshu.

Veulay ki va letzauot sheyyishmeru leval yavou lide michshol taut hayyom, kede laasot et yom hashshabbat laamitto, vehu amro veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat kede laasot et hashshabbat hayyadua shello yavo lide taut, vahagam sheyyekaddesh yom shevii kannizkar besamuch, ze eno yom hashshabbat kefi haemet.

O yirmoz lefi ma shepperashnu bappasuk shellifne ze, sheyyetzav Adonai lemi sheavda lo yediat hayyom sheyyimne shishsha yamim umeshammer hashshevii, laze ba latet taam veamar veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat shehu yom shemmekaddesh leminyano, vehattaam hu laasot et hashshabbat haamitti kede shello yifka mizzichrono mitzvat yom hamekuddash. vetaam shehizkir yom shevii beshem shabbat, lo chash alecha litot mimma sheggamar omer "laasot et hashshabbat", hare ze mare baetzba ki shabbat rishon hu shabbat asher ose lecheshbono.

Od yirtze al derech amro (Bereshit 37:11) "veaviv shamar et haddavar", perush mamtin umetzappe matay yavo. vehakkavvana baze letzauot shello yihye hashshabbat kidvar torach letzad meniat melechet haratzon umetzo hachefetz, ella tzerichin lismoach bo bishlemut haratzon vechefetz baddavar, vetamid yihye mamtin umetzappe matay yavo. veamro laasot et hashshabbat, lishlol hakkavvana kechefetz mitzvat hashshabbat lemargoa hagguf uleoneg asher yitanneg, ella letzad asiyyat mitzvat hashshabbat velo letachlit hammuregashot.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (yoma 81,1) shetztzarich lehosif mechol al hakkodesh, velo limmana mimmelacha achar sheyyaggia veyitnotzetz yom hashshabbat, ella tzarich lehachin atzmo bikdushshat shabbat veyetze kechatan likrat kalla, veyihye yoshev umeshammer ad sheyyaggia hashshabbat laasoto, perush lekayyem maasim hatztzerichin bo. od yirtze beamro laasot et hashshabbat ki ma shemmosif mechol al hakkodesh yaskim Adonai likroto shabbat, venimtza ze haish ose shabbat mammash, ki shaot miyyom shishshi vegam shaot miyyom rishon shehem chol, bene yisrael osim otam shabbat.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 11,8): amra shabbat lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, "lechullam natatta ben zug veli lo natatta ben zug!" amar lah: "hare yisrael" vechulei ad kan. hinne ki hashshabbat chaser perat echad mipperate hashshelemut, vetikkuno hu al yede sheyyishmeruhu yisrael, vehu amro veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat. ma taam – laasot et hashshabbat, leshon tikkun, shebbaze yetukkan maasehu shel shabbat venimtza lo ben zug.

Od yirtze shetztzarich lishmor et hashshabbat leval yihye bo devar chol, ben mimmennu ben mehazzulat. velo yomar adam: "day li bema shennishmor atzmo mechallelo, veim yitchallel mehazzulat ma bechach", ella tzarich sheyyihye shomer oto leval yitchallel, kemo sheshshomer ganno ufardeso. uvichlal geder ze sheyyishtaddel lishmor leval yavo leyado devar shogeg sheyyitchallel bo shabbat, al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat 11,1) lo yikra leor hanner, vechol hasseyagim vehashshemirot leval yitchallel shabbat afillu bimtziut shehu patur alehem.

Od yirtze lomar, ki meshunnet shemira zo mikkol shear shemirot hammitzva, ki shemira zo nechshevet begeder asiyya, vehu amro veshamru vegomer laasot, hare shellecha lefanecha shekkore lashshemira asiyya. veulay ki hattaam hu al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (kiddushin lat:) yashav adam velo avar avera notnin lo sachar keose mitzva, veheemiduha baggemara bevaa avera leyado velo avar, ad kan. uchemo chen bayyom hammekuddash en lecha baa avera leyado shel melachot kaze, ki bechol et mizdammenim lefanav melachot harebe mehaarbaim vetoldotehem bifrate hamechubbar uvifrate habbishshul uvifrate mekach umimkar shehaadam ragil bahem kol hayyom umizdammenim been mispar, vehu nishmar mehem, laze yechashev lahem keose mitzva.

Od yirtze, leheyot shekkadam vetzivva al shemirat hashshabbat, tavo hassevara lomar shekkol hashshomer shabbat hinne hu notel sechar shabbat. laze tzivva Adonai veamar veshamru vene yisrael, perush davka bene yisrael hem sheyyeshnam bishmirat shabbat velo shum umma velashon. velaze lo amar "ushemartem", sheaz yihye nishma shebba letzauot al hashshemira, vehu ba lishlol chutz mibbene yisrael shello yishmeru shabbat. vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin noach,2) goy sheshshavat chayyav mita, shehare miatam hakkatuv veazharatam zo hi mitatam.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, perush – kesheyyishmeru afillu shabbat achat, velav davka im yishmeru, ella gam im yaskimu bedatam laasot mitzvat hashshabbat, vehu amro laasot et hashshabbat, maale alehem hakkatuv keillu asu ledorotam. uchefi ze, ish yisrael sheshshamar afillu shabbat achat vamet, en menakkin lo missachar haole lo im haya shomer ledorot olam (mechilta).

Od yirtze lefi ma shehikdamnu befasuk "ach et shabbetotay" ki tzivva Adonai lechallel shabbat bishvil pikkuach nefesh, kan beer hakkatuv ki lo nitmaet shabbat bishmira ella beerech bene yisrael, aval beerech zulatam lehachayot akkum, hagam sheyyihye ger toshav sheshshomer sheva mitzvot venistakken sakkanat mavet – lo yechallel yisrael shabbat bishvilo (282 hilchot shabbat 2:20). vehu amro veshamru vene yisrael leval yamut mehem, et hashshabbat perush letzad azharat shabbat ella yechalleluhu. o al ze hadderech: shabbat veyisrael lefanecha, ze lechallel veze lamut – tishmor yisrael veyitchallel hashshabbat, aval amamin lo. vehattaam laasot et hashshabbat, perush kelum ma taam ani mattir lecha lechallel shabbat alav, hu laasot et hashshabbat ledorotam – challel alav shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harebe, aval akkum sheenam bene shabbat – lo.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: ematay amarti lecha lishmor ish yisrael afillu beerech kevod shabbat? davka laasot, perush beadam sheyyeshno begeder amod laasot, aval mi shevvadday lo yakum velo yaggia leshabbat leshamro, hagam sherfuot ellu yoilu leshaot o leyamim, lo yechallel alav shabbat.

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (rosh hashshana lo.) sheolam habba nikra olam shekkullo shabbat, veamru od (Shemot Rabba 25,12) shakul shabbat keneged kol hattora kullah, laze amar veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat vehattaam laasot lahem et hashshabbat perush, haolam hammitkanne beshem shabbat sheyyihyu bo ledore dorot, vehu amro ledorotam lishlol olam hazze sheen haadam kayyam bah ledorot, berit olam perush berit keruta leshomer shabbat sheyyinchal olam elyon:

Od yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (betza 16.) sheamru shebbeyom shabbat baa neshama yetera leyisrael, karamuz beamro shavat vayyinnafash, vehu sod hannelam shello gillahu Adonai laummot, keamram zichronam livracha (sham) neshama yetera la odinhu. vehairoti bitzfuno shel davar bema shehikshu baggemara al hodaat shabbat laummot, sheim la odinhu la lianshu alah, veamru: shabbat odinhu, neshama yetera la odinhu, ad kan. vekashe, velamma lo yavou betaana gam ken veyomru im haya modiam neshama yetera hayu mekabbelin shabbat velo lianshu aleha? venire ki laze nitchakkemu rabbotenu zichronam livracha veamru (shabbat 10:) mattana tova vechulei, perush ki en davar ze ella begeder mattana asher nitratztza Adonai latet leammo, veenah sachar sheyyavou betaana haummot kannizkar, ki en derech lomar lamma lo natatta lanu mattana gam anachnu. od timtza ki kevar kibbelu yisrael alehem shemirat shabbat kodem netinat neshama yetera, umeatta anosh yeanshu kol haummot al hashshabbat veenenu root.

Veinyan neshama zo hayyetera ramzu mekomah rabbotenu beamram "mattana tova bevet genazay", veyadua hu makom hannikra ginze hammelech shehu bechinat olam elyon, uneshama zo machtzavah sham hu. velaze tikkare shabbat, keamram "veshabbat shemah" keshem haolam shemmimmennu hi, shennikra olam shekkullo shabbat (rosh hashshana lo.). veolam ze en bo itztzavon vealav lo ba kedivrehem bo ella oneg vesimcha. velaze tzivva Adonai leharechik beyom shabbat kol otam bechinot hachol, hammelacha vehainnuy, ki beachat mehenna tigal hanneshama mishshevet bekerev ish. velaze timtza sheikkar issur azharat melachot shabbat beer Adonai shehem bammachshava, keamram (betza 13.) "melechet machashevet asra tora", vaafillu dibbur shel chol asur (shabbat 113:), dichtiv (yeshaya noach,13) "mimmetzo cheftzecha vedabber davar". vehakkol letzad tosefet neshama haelyona laasot lefaneha keseder olam shebbaa mimmennu. vehu ma shetztzivva Adonai beamro veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, perush neshama hannikret shabbat, vetachlit shemira zo hi hassagat olam sheshshemo shabbat. vehu amro laasot et hashshabbat. veteda ki min hannimna hachelti sheyyassig adam alot leolam elyon zulat beemtzaut hassagat anaf mimmennu bihyoto baolam hazze, velaze im lo yassigu yisrael bechinat neshama zo en bahem yecholet laamod begeder elyon. vehu amro laasot et hashshabbat, perush, shebbeemtzauto taasu lachem et hashshabbat shettuchelu hasseg amod sham ulehitanneg nafsham beginze elyon. veamro ledorotam, ki sham yitkabbetzu kol dorot bene yisrael shehi bechinat olam habba.

Od yirtze leshon dira, velaze ketuva chasera belo vav, vehem devarenu sheyyirmoz el mekom dirat hanneshamot, vehu olam hamekuvve shekkarat Adonai berit latet lanu, vehu amro berit olam. veulay sheyyirmoz beamro berit olam letaryag mitzvot, shecheshbon berit ole taryav vechullam teluyim beshabbat hare taryag, velaze samach tevat "berit" leolam" lomar ki al yede shemirat shabbat hu mekayyem kol taryag mitzvot shehu shakul kenegdam vehinne olamo.

Veamro beni uven bene yisrael – perush, en zar ittanu baolam hallaz, veulay sheggam hammalachim lo yeshvu bimsibbatenu baolam hazze, ki hu lemala meolam hammalachim. veal derech amro (Bamidbar 23:23) "kaet yeamer leyaakov uleyisrael ma paal el", veamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20,20) shehammalachim yishalu leyisrael hakkerovim lael ma paal el.

Od yirtze beni uven bene yisrael – yihye sod haddevarim haamurim velo yedaem adam baolam, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (betza 16.) sheamru: neshama yetera lo odinhu, ki en chefetz laAdonai sheyyedu haummot sitre el chay, vehu amro (tehillim 147:19-20): "chukkav umishpatav leyisrael lo asa chen lechol goy", veamru zichronam livracha (chagiga 13:) vechulei. veamro ot hi leolam – perush, kevan shekkol ze yihye sod leyisrael velo yegallu haddavar, im ken habba lishol al mitzvat hayyom: "ma yom miyyamim? ma ot naasa bo laasot bo kol hashshinnuyim?" – ma tihye teshuvatenu elav? laze amar "ot hi leolam" – perush sheyyihye nigle levae olam ki sheshet yamim vegomer uvayyom hashshevii shavat vegomer. taam ze yihye nigle lezulatenu, veim bene yisrael taamam kamus immam chatum beotzrot hachayyim.

Bene levi. velo amar "kol", ki lo kullam bene chayil laasot haamur bainyan. vetzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lehazekiram velo samach al ma shebba zichronam besamuch. veulay shebba lemaet shello asa immahem haddavar zulatam. umippasuk rishon sheamar "vayyeasfu elav kol bene levi" en lishmoa shemmiet ish yisrael, ella ba lomar shekkol bene levi bau, veyesh makom lomar shebbau ketzat miyyisrael, laze amar vayyaasu vene levi lomar velo ish yisrael.
Kidvar moshe. perush, ki divre moshe levad yaspik lema sheasauhu, o yirtze shello nishtahu ella kechalloto ledabber, samuch ligmar devarav asu.

rashi: Velo yamutu. lechayyev mita al hameshammesh bammizbeach veeno rechutz yadayim veraglayim, shehammita harishona lo shamanu ella al hannichnas lahechol:
ohc: Chak olam. afillu ala mibbet hattevila shennithar mittuma chamura, chukka chakak Adonai, velaze hutzrach lomar paam sheniyya. velo yamutu – ha im lo rachatzu, hagam shealu mittevila, hare hem bemita velo toil tevila.

rashi: Vedibber el bene yisrael. verau karne hahod befanav; ucheshehu mistallek mehem …
Notzer chesed. shehaadam ose lefanav:
Laalafim. lishne alafim dorot:
Avon vafesha. avonot — ellu hazzedonot, peshaim — ellu hammeradim sheadam ose lehacheis:
Venakke lo yenakke. lefi feshuto mashma sheeno mevatter al heavon legamre, ella nifra mimmennu meat meat, verabbotenu darshu menakke hu lashshavim velo yenakke lesheenan shavim (yoma 86):
Poked avon avot al vanim. kesheochazim maase avotehem bidehem, shekkevar peresh bemikra acher lesonay (Shemot 20):
Veal ribbeim. dor revii; nimtzet midda tova merubba al middat puranut achat lachamesh meot, shebbemidda tova hu omer notzer chesed laalafim (tosefta sota 4):
Lehariach bah. aval ose atta bematkuntah mishshellecha, kede lemachrah latztzibbur (keritut Adonai):
Nataf. hu tzori, veal sheeno ella seraf hannotef meatze hakketaf karuy nataf, uvelaaz 50, vehatztzori korin lo tareyakah:
Ushechelet. shoresh boshem chalak umatzhir ketztzipporen, uvilshon hammishna karuy tzipporen, vezehu shettirgem unkelos vetufera:

Vechelbena. bosem sherecho ra, vekorin lo galbena, umenaah hakkatuv ben sammane hakketoret lelammedenu shello yekal beenenu letzaref immanu baaguddat taaniyyotenu utefillotenu et poshe yisrael sheyyihyu nimnin immanu:
Sammim. acherim:

Ulevona zakka. mikkan lamdu rabbotenu 11 sammanin neemru lo lemoshe besinay – miut sammim shenayim, nataf ushechelet vechelbena 3, hare chamishsha, sammim lerabbot od kemo ellu hare asara, ulevona hare 11; veellu hen hatztzori vehatztzipporen hachelbena vehallevona mor uketzia shibbolet nerd vecharkom hare 8 – shehashshibbolet venerd echad, shehannerd dome leshibbolet – hakkosht vehakkillufa vekinnamon hare 11; borit karshina eno niktar ella bo shafin et hatztzipporen lelabbenah shettehe naa (keritut 6):

Bad bevad yihye. ellu haarbaa hannizkarim kan yihyu shavin mishkal bemishkal – kemishkalo shel ze kach mishkalo shel ze – vechen shaninu: hatztzori vehatztzipporen hachelbena vehallevona mishkal shivim shivim mane (sham); uleshon bad nire veenay shehu leshon yachid, echad beechad yihyu – ze kemot ze:
Mot yumat. im yesh edim vehateraa:
Venichreta. belo hateraa (mechilta):
Mechalleha. hannoheg bah chol bikdushshatah:
ohc: Ushemartem et hashshabbat. tzarich ladaat lamma chazar letzauot al shemirat shabbat velatet taam chadash "ki kodesh". venire ki lefi shekkadam lehattir chillul shabbat lechole kemo shepperashnu befasuk shellifne ze, vechash sheyyite hattoe ki legabbe chole ze naasa shabbat chol veyesh lechallelo afillu lifrate harfua sheen bahem pikkuach nefesh, talmud lomar ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hiv, perush bikdushshatah omedet lechol shear happeratim sheen bahem pikkuach nefesh.

Od yitbaer al pi ma sheamru zichronam livracha (menachot sad.) amaduhu lishte gerogarot vechulei, vehayu shene uketzim, echad yesh bo shete gerogrot veechad yesh bo shalosh, lo yichretu ella oketz sheyyesh bo shetayim velo sheyyesh bo shalosh, ad kan. vehinne bivchinat hammaase asher yaase haadam echad hiv ben im yichrot baal shetayim o baal shalosh, aval beerech maase hannaase beshabbat yishtanne heyot keritat shetayim lichritat shalosh. vehu amro ushemartem et hashshabbat, perush, shello yihye naase bah devar melacha sheen tzorech bo leoto chole, ki kodesh hi, tala haddavar beshabbat, veim ken kesheyyichretu oketz sheyyesh bo shalosh veeno tzarich ella lishtayim, nimtzet shabbat mechullelet beerech hashshalosh, veze hi chillul kedushshatah, ki gam beerech chole ze sheyyesh bo sakkana omedet shabbat bikdushshatah.

Mechalleha mot yumat. amar mechalleha leshon rabbim vegamar omer bilshon yachid, yitbaer al pi ma shepperashnu ki yesh mechallel baofen hannizkar shehuttar lichrot oketz shel shete teenim lechole vecharat baal shalosh, veyesh shekkarat lelo tzorech, ushenehem nikraim mechallelim, aval eno chayyav mita ella echad mehem, aval hakkoret lirfuat mesukkan shekkarat bimkom shel shenayim shel shalosh, vehoil veikkar hammelacha birshut naaset eno ben mavet.

Ulefi peshat hakkatuv yirtze, mechalleha – ben ose bifne edim veachar hahatraa, ben ose beno leven atzmo. echad mehem shehu haose bifne edim vehutera hiv sheyyamut, aval hashsheni lo yumat ella venichreta vegomer bemishpat el elyon.

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (shabbat kav:) yashav haechad al happetach velo milleahu, veyashav hashsheni umilleahu – hashsheni chayyav. vehu amro mechalleha, perush, letzad shello hayta melacha zo naaset ella beemtzaut shenayim ellu, shehare zulat harishon lo haya nitztzod, venimtzeu shenayim chilleluha, vehu amro mechalleha mot yumat – echad mehem levad hiv shechayyav.

Od yitbaer al pi ma sheamru zichronam livracha (betza lod.) veze leshonam: echad mehem mevi et haur, veechad mevi et haetzim, veechad shofet et hakkedera, veechad mevi et hammayim. massik baggemara sheim mevi haur haya levassof hiv chayyav vechullan peturim, vehu amro mechalleha echad mehem hiv shechayyav mita vechullan peturim:

Mot yumat. kevar perashti befarashat mishpatim (Shemot 21:12) taam hakkefel, ki ze haish ben mavet hiv lashshamayim umarshe Adonai hattachtonim lehamit ben mavet ze, velishlol ben mavet acher shello yihye dino masur labberiyyot ella lashshamayim, vehu ma shehizkir besamuch kol haose vah melacha venichreta vegomer:

Ki kol haose. perush, taam shezzacharti lecha leshon yachid bimchalleha", lo yachshov hachoshev shehamechallel haacher sheeno beedim vechulei en lo onesh mita kol ikkar, ella hiv keover al lav vaase shel kedushshat shabbat – lo chen hiv, ella kol haose vah melacha venichreta hannefesh vaafillu belo edim vehateraa. umeatta ma shemmiet hakkatuv beamro leshon yachid eno ella leinyan asot mishpat bevet din shel matta. ulefi ma shepperashti befasuk mechalleha ki ma shemmiet hakkatuv beamro leshon yachid hiv mi shekkarat oketz sheyyesh bo shalosh lechole sheeno tzarich ella shetayim, sheafillu haya behateraa veedim patur, hutzrach lomar ki kol haose vegomer, shello tachshov bemashmaut hammiut shebba al haose bemezid belo edim kannizkar veen bo onesh, talmud lomar ki vegomer.

rashi: Umoshe. meoto avon vahala,
Yikkach et haohel. leshon hove hu – lokeach oholo venotehu michutz lammachane; amar menudde larav menudde lattalmid (tanchuma):
Harechek. alpayim amma, kainyan shenne ach rachok yihye benechem uvenav kealpayim amma bammidda (Yehoshua 3):
Vekara lo. vehaya kore lo ohel moed, hu bet vaad limvakkeshe tora:
Kol mevakkesh Adonai. mikkan limvakkesh pene zaken kimkabbel pene shechina (tanchuma):
Yetze el ohel moed. kemo yotze. davar acher vehaya kol mevakkesh Adonai – afillu malache hashsharet keshehayu shoalim mekom shechina, chavrehem omrim lahem hare hu veoholo shel moshe:
Vayyomer elav. bezo ani chafetz, ki al yede malach al taalenu mizze:
ohc: Im en panecha vegomer. lo nitratztza bemaamar Adonai veamar: vechi al davar ze ani mitpallel? im en panecha holchim meatta avudim hem veen tzorech baaliyyatam. uvamme yivvada efo ki matzati chen vegomer halo belechtecha immanu, perush, bechina haelyona shehi sod hammaor haggadol hammitkanne beshem havaya baruch hu, lo panecha levad shehu bechinat hakkisse. uma shehivtachtani shebbechina zo tihye li levaddi, keamro vahanichoti lach, ani shoel shettihye gam manheget kullanu yachad ani veammecha, vehu amro veniflinu ani veammecha bemiddat harachamim umaala elyona sheen lemala mimmenna. venitratztza el elyon veamar elav gam et haddavar hazze asher dibbarta eese, lehanehigam bivchinat shem shalem hammeyuchad baruch hu, ki matzata vegomer, perush, lo lizchut yisrael ella limtziat chinno.

rashi: Sechel adam heerich appo. kemo lehaarich, im asa ken sechel hu lo:
Vetifarto. hu sheyyaavor al middotav:
targum: Sichleh devar nasha negidut urecheh veshivhoreh denaavar al chova:

rashi: Veachalta mizzivcho. kassavur atta sheen onesh baachilato, vaani maale alecha kemode vaavodatam, shemmittoch kach atta va velokeach mibbenotav levanecha (avoda zara 8):
ohc: Pen tichrot vegomer. perush, hagam shebbishat keritat berit yekabbelu alehem sheva mitzvot, af al pi chen lo tichrot, vehattaam ki vezanu perush, yoshve haaretz achare elohehem, ki en emuna bahem kaggaluy leyodea nistarot, vezavchu lelohehem vekara lecha vegomer, veamru bemassechet avoda zara (77 8.) ki mishsheat keria maale alav hakkatuv keillu achal. veamro mizzivcho katav rambam behilchot shechita (84) shebba leesor shechitat goy, mimma shehizkiram beissure goyim, ha lamadta shebbechinat hazzevicha levad yetaev Adonai hagam sheen bah echad mippesule shechita:

rashi: Vayyomar panay yelechu. ketargumo – lo eshlach od malach, ani veatzmi elech, kemo ufanecha holchim bakkerav (Shmuel 2 17:11):
ohc: Vayyomar panay yelechu vegomer. harebe perushim neemru bifsukim ellu. venire lefaresh hakkatuv al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Tikkunim 18) ki shechinato yitbarach tikkare "pene Adonai" letzad shehi hanniret litzva hashshamayim, veeleha romez amro (Shemot 23:15) "velo yerau fanay rekam". vechan heshiv Adonai lemoshe al taanotav vehodio ki haholech immo hu pene Adonai shehu hashshechina, veal chashashat shemma lo yihye noach lemoshe metziut ze, amar vahanichoti lach.

Venitkavven od lomar lo sheyyanuach or elyon alav velo yifsok mimmennu ma shennach alav ad atta min haruach, ella shellivchinat yisrael tihye hashshechina holechet lifnehem, uvechina zo bechinat din hu, vehashshem yaggid aleha – adonay, veal ze heshiv moshe veamar im en vegomer (Shemot 33:15):

rashi: Ki vera hu. bederech ra hem holchin tamid, uvenisyonot lifne hammakom:
Umashachta vo. kol hammeshichot kemin chi, chutz mishshel melachim shehen kemin nezer (keritut Adonai):
Pesol lecha. herahu machtzav sanpirinon mittoch oholo veamar lo happesolet yihye shellecha; mishsham nitashsher moshe harebe (tanchuma):

Pesol lecha. atta shibbarta harishonot, atta pesal lecha acherot, mashal lemelech shehalach limdinat hayyam vehinniach arusato im hashshefachot, mittoch kilkul hashshefachot yatza aleha shem ra, amad shoshvinah vekara ketubbatah, amar im yomar hammelech lehargah, omar lo adayin enah ishtecha; badak hammelech umatza shello haya hakkilkul ella min hashshefachot, nitratztza lah, amar lo shoshvinah ketov lah ketubba acheret, shennikrea harishona, amar lo hammelech atta karata otah atta kene lah neyar acher vaani echtov lah bichtav yadi; ken hammelech ze hakkabba, hashshefachot ellu erev rav, vehashshoshvin ze moshe, arusato shel hakkabba yisrael, lechach neemar pesal lecha (sham):
Veatta im tissa chattatam. hare tov – eni omer lecha mecheni, veim ayin mecheni; veze mikra katzar, vechen harebe:
Missifrecha. mikkol hattora kullah, shello yomru alay shello hayiti cheday levakkesh alehem rachamim:
ohc: Veatta vegomer. yitbaer al derech amram (Bereshit Rabba 21,6): en "veatta" ella teshuva, vehu ma shettaan moshe lifne Adonai ki asu yisrael teshuva al haddavar hara.

Im tissa chattatam. perush, mutav. vetzarich ladaat lamma lo hishlim devarav, veulay sheshshiur devarav hem al ze hadderech, veatta perush, hinne yisrael chazru bitshuva, veze keneged ma shemmehem, aval keneged ma shemmimmennu yitbarach en yadua im Adonai yekabbel teshuvatam al chet haggadol im lo, laze gamar omer im tissa chattatam ki hatteshuva tzericha shav umekabbel.

Veim ayin mecheni vegomer. perush, letzad shebbeemtzaut kol ma sheavar ben yisrael uven Adonai baruch hu yizke hassarsur hanneeman bazzechut hammaggia lo bechol mitzva, uvifrat bemattan tora kamma zechut yaale lemoshe bigiato im yisrael, vehakkol katuv besefer zikkaron lefanav. umeatta im lo yissa lechattatam tzarich limchot missefer kol zechuyyotav shel moshe shennichtevu beemtzaut zechutam shel yisrael. veheshivo Adonai ki en devarav emet baze, ki davka hachote atzmo hu asher yimchennu Adonai missifro achar shennichtav bassefer, aval mi shezzacha beemtzauto lo yifka zechuto asher zacha bo letzad shechazar bo halla vehirshia.

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Zohar chelek 3 273.) sheamru ki chol nishmot dor hammidbar hayu anfe nishmat moshe, umeatta keshello yissa chattatam hinne hachissaron nogea lemoshe, laze amar mecheni vegomer. veheshiv Adonai ki lo yareu haanafim ella leatzman velo livchinat shoresh hanneshama, vehu amro mi asher chata li davka hu sheemchennu missifri, aval bechinat nishmat moshe lo.

Od yirtze, ki im lo yissa chattatam, hinne gam hu chata harebe peamim lefanav, kemo shemmatzinu lo sheamar (Shemot 5:22) "lama hareota" vechayyotze baze, veim ken gam cheto lo yissa vetzarich limchot vegomer chas veshalom. veheshiv habbore mi asher chata li, perush ki yishtanne cheto mechet avoda zara shekkafru belohe yisrael vechisseru haelohut kefi ma shennitztauu, ki maase haemtzai yihye beerech yisrael begeder akirat hakkol, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar chata li, ma sheen ken shear chataim sheyyimchol al yede teshuva belo onesh.

Vehinne kol hitvakkechut moshe im Adonai enah ella limchol miyyad veyihyu nichtavim besefer tzaddikim, aval lo leinyan sheyyesh lahem tikva achar tochachot al avon ki ze peshita sheyyitkapper, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar missifrecha asher katavta, perush ki shelosha sefarim ketuvim lemala: echad shel tzaddikim vechulei, veechad shel reshaim, veechad shel benonim, vehem hanniftachim berosh hashshana. sefer shehu shel tzaddikim hakkadosh baruch hu kotvo umannicho lefanav, vehu ma sheamar missifrecha, perush oto shekkatavta atta, lo otam shennichtavim al yede hazzulat, vehutzrach lefaresh asher katavta ki mikkinnuy missifrecha eno muvan shechozer al sefer hatztzaddikim ki hakkol hu shel hakkadosh baruch hu shehu adon hakkol.

Uvemassechet rosh hashshana (205 16:) darshu hakkatuv al ze hadderech: "missifrecha" – ze sifran shel tzaddikim, "asher katavta" – ze sifran shel benonim, ad kan. uledivrehem zichronam livracha yitbaer al pi amram zichronam livracha (kiddushin 40:) leolam yire adam atzmo keillu chetzyo zakkay vechetzyo chayyav, vechen amru bemakom acher (berachot 61:) sheen lehaarich adam atzmo ella bevenoni. umeatta yitbaaru divre moshe al ze hadderech, ki moshe haya maarich atzmo bevenoni kemishpat kol ish yisrael, velaze amar ki im lo yissa lefesha yisrael hinne nigra meerech zechuyyotav, velo mibbaya meerech tzaddik ella afillu mibbenoni, keamro "asher katavta".

O yirtze, ki beemtzaut yisrael im yatzdiku yaamod chay bemadregat tzaddik, ki rabbim zechuyyotav. veim lo yissa lefisham, lo millevad shello yarviach tosefet zechuyyot lehacheria zechuyyotav kede sheyyikkare tzaddik, ella adrabba yechashev lo zechut harishon ligriut kesheyyeanshu, ki tov haya im lo haya ma shekkadam mehattov, vehaven:

Od yechavven roe neeman lomar keneged ma shekkadam elav bemaamar Adonai "veeese otcha legoy gadol", veamar lefanav sheim lo yirtze Adonai lissa chattatam bocher hu sheyyimchehu missifro asher katav, perush ki beet asher amar elav "veeese otcha legoy gadol" halo hi ketuva besefer hayyashar meet sheyyatza mippi el elyon, uvehechreach lehitkayyem, sheafillu biklala amru zichronam livracha (makkot 11,1) killat chacham afillu al tenay, umikkol shekken davar tov sheyyetze mippi elyon hare hu katuv leed uleot. velaze mitpallel sheim lo yimchol leyisrael sheyyimchehu, umimmela en makom lekayyem shevuat haavot. veheshiv Adonai ki lo takum velo tihye sheyyimche ella vegomer, aval ma sheddibber tov al moshe yakum leolam. vechen haya, dichtiv (divrei hayamim 1 23:17) "uvene rechavya ravu lemala", veamru zichronam livracha (berachot 7,1) lemala mishshishshim ribbo.

rashi: Vayyomer lo tuchal vegomer. af kesheaavir kol tuvi al panecha eni noten lecha reshut lirot et panay:
ohc: Vayyomer lo tuchal vegomer. perush, lo sheani monea haddavar mimmecha, ella letzad sheen becha yecholet hammassig ki lo yirani haadam, veamro vachay perush veyishshaer chay, vaani choshesh lechayyecha, al derech amro (tehillim 84:11) "ki tov yom bachatzerecha mealef".

O yomar al ze hadderech: ki lo yirani haadam – perush beshum ofen, vaafillu chay – perush afillu yihye tzaddik sheyyikkare alav chay, al derech amro (Shmuel 2 23:20) "ben ish chay", veot vav teshammesh vav hammosif.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech, ki lo yirani haadam – afilu achar mita veatta mevakkesh lirot, veod vachay – perush bechayyim chayyutecha. kan ramaz sheachar mita yassig ma shello hissig adam baolam, shehare lo shalal ella letzad heyoto chay, vahagam shehatztzaddikim mistakkelim beoro yitbarach achar motam, lo yassigu ma sheshshaal moshe millifne Adonai. ashre yelud ishsha!

rashi: Kanna shemo. mekanne lippara veeno mevatter, vezehu kol leshon kina – ochez benitzchono uforea meoyvav:

Vayyashlech miyyadav vegomer. amar: ma pesach shehu echad min hammitzvot, amra tora kol ben nechar lo yochal bo (Shemot 12), hattora kullah kan vechol yisrael meshummadim veettenenna lahem? (shabbat 87):
Tachat hahar. leragle hahar:
ohc: Vayhi. amru zichronam livracha (Megila 10,1) leshon tzaar, yechavven al meora ra sheera balluchot shepparchu mehem haotiyyot kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 46,1), veze garam lanu kol ma shettaamu avotenu gam anachnu mikkosot hammarim, hammita atzmah umar mimmavet, ki im hayu halluchot harishonim paska tzara min haolam vecherut afillu mimmalach hammavet (Shemot Rabba 41,7), vehen atta paska tova, velaze yeot kerot vayhi. vichavven gam ken al tzaaro shel oto tzaddik, moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom, shennitztaer harebe al ma sheraa, vichavven gam ken al yisrael shennimtzeu kevoshet gannav ki yimmatze bevusha gedola kaasher karav moshe el hammachane, vichavven gam ken al bechinat hakkelippa shekkarav lah havay" lehumah uleabbedah domem veruchaniyyut ra shebbah, sheelav neemar "elle elohecha", sar elav mar hammavet, ken yovdu oyve Adonai.

Kaasher karav vegomer. ulay sheyyashmienu hakkatuv shennizdammen reot haegel lifne moshe kodem sheyyikkanes lammachane, vehattaam kede shello yikkansu halluchot ketuvim lammachane sheyyesh bo avoda zara, veze hu shiur hakkatuv vayhi kaasher karav vegomer techef umiyyad vayyar et haegel mezumman lefanav.

Vayyar et haegel umecholot. ulay ki beemtzaut hizdammenut moshe parcha lah bechinat hattuma shehayta medabberet bo veomeret "elle elohecha yisrael", gam ruach hattuma sheppaala tzurato mibbeli tzoref veumman techef yatza balo shel egel miyyirat moshe, ki hakkelippa takkir adonah vetifchad veterata, velaze amar vayyar et haegel umecholot, makkish egel limcholot ma mecholot domem gam egel domem, ki avra mimmennu ruach hammata.

O yomar bedikduk amro et haegel shello haya tzarich lomar ella "vayyar haegel", ella nitkavven lomar sheraa haegel veruach hattuma shebbo, ki hatztzaddikim yakkiru bechinat hara, umikkol shekken adam kemoshe alav hashshalom sheala vedarach al bomote kol haruchot baaloto el haelohim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Tikkunim 142) sheshshaal moshe laegel mi asao, veheshiv ki erev rav asauhu, yeuyyan sham devarav, vehaddavar pashut ki lo yedabber haddomem, vetimtza shebbammecholot lo amar "et" ki lo haya bahem ruach hattuma hammetzaftzefet kemo shehaya baegel kemaamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha hannizkar.

O yirtze lehodia, ki beet shekkarav moshe el hammachane lo nizdammen lefanav adam mippene habbusha, velo raa zulat haegel umecholot, aval mesibbato vetofse machol pinnu makom, velaze amar vayyar et haegel umecholot, lomar ki hu ze levad ma sheraa.

Vayyichar af moshe vayyashlech. tzarich ladaat taam shel moshe bishvirat halluchot, velo chash lehefsed muflag, ufeshita shello yaase devar kilkul im lo beomed gadol uvetzidde hammoil asher tzidded alav hashshalom. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (avot derabbi natan 2,3) lo shavar ad shenneemar lo mippi haggevura, vechen amar rabbi meir "vayyihyu sham kaasher tzivvani" (Devarim 10:5) shennitztavva veshavar halluchot ad kan. vetzarich latet taam leel elyon lamma mana hattov.

Venire ki kodem sheavdu avoda zara paska zuhamatan, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (shabbat kamu,1), velaze asa Adonai lahem mishpat katuv charut al halluchot, cherut mimmalach hammavet (Shemot Rabba 121), ki kelum mita zo lamma letzad haferadat hazzuhama illu kevar paska zohamatan. velaze kesheasu et haegel hare zuhamat hachet davka bahem, umeatta tzerichim lemalach hammavet. hagam shello chazra hazzuhama mammash al yede haegel lichmot shehayta kodem kabbalat hattora, af al pi chen shevaram, ki en din ze lahem od sheyyihyu bene chorin mimmalach hammavet umishshibud malchuyyot. uletaam ze lu yehi shennomar ki moshe middaat atzmo asa mittechilla, en kan kushya.

rashi: Shomer mitzva shomer nafsho boze derachav yamut. sheeno noten libbo leshaklan:
targum: Denater pukedana nater nafsheh udemeshit orchateh yemut:

rashi: En kol anot gevura. en kol hazze nire kol aniyyat gibborim hatztzoakim "nitztzachon" velo kol challashim shetztzoakim "vay anusa":
Kol anot. kol cherufin vegiddufin, hameannin et nefesh shoman keshenneemarin lo:
Asherav. hu ilan sheovdim oto:
Et haemori vegomer. 6 ummot yesh kan, ki haggirgashi amad ufana mippenehem:
ohc: Shemar lecha. tzarich ladaat ma yishmor baze, veim yishmor haddevarim kedivre rabbi avraham ibben ezra, lo haya tzarich lehazehiro al mitzva bifratut mikkol mitzvot hattora, ufeshita shello yichbosh hanneemar lo binvua. veulay ki letzad sheavdu yisrael et avoda zara, laze mitchakkem Adonai lerappe shivram bema sheyyetzorru et ovde avoda zara vikauu leabbedam uleharchikam bal kerov alehem, al yede ze yitkapper avonam vetitratztze teshuvatam. vahagam sheadayin lo higgiu laaretz, yoil hachefetz veharatzon baze lechappara al haddavar. vehu amro shemar lecha, perush al derech amro (Bereshit 37:11) "veaviv shamar et haddavar", sheyyihyu meshammerim matay yavo et laasot kol hakkatuv lehateiv oto davar shebbo nichshelu.

O yomar, ki mikkodem sheasu et haegel lo tzivva Adonai kol haharchaka mehaummot vehateavatam, uletzad shekkadam maase hara hosif Adonai lahem mitzva zo kedin harechakat hannichshal baavera shetztzarich lehagedir atzmo begader chadash, vehu amro shemar lecha, perush, mitzva zo lema sheelecha baa letzad ma sheasita et haegel.

O efshar ki kodem maase haegel lo haya Adonai metzavve al haddavar haamur bainyan, ki techef haya Adonai goresh mippenehem kol yoshve haaretz veen makom lemitzva, velo haya bet mechush lechayyat haaretz, o letzad ematam shel yisrael, shehaya nifsak mehem yetzer hara vechayyat hassade taavdem, o letzad ki yirbu ad meod umalu haaretz. veachar haegel batal hainyan vehutzrechu letzauot laze, vehu amro shemar lecha.

Uvederech remez efshar shettevat lecha chozeret el moshe, veramaz lo ki ma sheomer lo hinni goresh mippanecha vegomer, eno lizman hammizdammen ella lizman rachok, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 19,13) moshe sheggaal otanu hu yigal otanu leatid lavo, veal oto zeman hu omer shemar lecha, veteda ki lo nitkayyemu divre Adonai sheamar kan lemoshe "hinni goresh mippanecha" vegomer, laze amar shemar lecha leacharit hayyamim et asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom.

rashi: Vayyitten al panav masve. ketargumo bet appe, leshon arammi hu, battalmud (ketuvot 62) sevi libbah, veod bichtubbot (daf 60), hava ka masve leappah, leshon habbata – haya mistakkel bah, af kan masve beged hannittan keneged happartzuf uvet haenayim; velichvod karne hahod – shello yizzonu hakkol mehem – haya noten hammasve kenegdan, venotlo beshaa shehaya medabber im yisrael, uveshaa shehammakom nidbar immo ad tzeto, uvetzeto yatza belo masve:
Hannicha li. adayin lo shamanu shehitpallel moshe alehem vehu omer hannicha li? ella kan patach lo petach vehodio shehaddavar taluy bo – sheim yitpallel alehem lo yechallem (berachot 32):
ohc: Veatta hannicha li. amro veatta yirtze, letzad shehu meratztzehu beamro veeese otcha vegomer, uvaze yannichehu lechallotam, veyomar moshe belibbo: uma havetacha hu zot, vegam levanav yeera kemo chen vehayu kelo haya? laze amar shello yevakkesh mimmennu lehannicho ella atta, aval goy sheyyaase mimmoshe lo yomar Adonai od elav "hannicha li", o letzad sheyyihyu metivim darkam, o shemmavticho shello yomar lo od "hannicha", vetamid yevattel moshe gezera mealehem.

Uvederech remez ramaz shello tzivva alav hannicha ella beoto et velo tamid, umimmotza davar atta yodea sheyyaamod techef umiyyad bitfilla, ki yomar "veatta" afillu al shiur rega, vehinne avar bemeshech amro veatta, velaze techef umiyyad amad bitfilla velo hinnicho lacharot appo.

Od yirtze lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 21,6) sheamru, en "veatta" ella teshuva, ramaz lo sheyyaase teshuva al hassovev mimmennu, ki hattaut yatza middevarav sheamar lahem lesof arbaim ani ba, velo peresh lahem shehu levad meoto yom, shemmizze tau.

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 82) sheamru shekkabbalat erev rav hayta mitztzad moshe velo hiskim hashshem alehem venitratztza laasot retzon moshe, velaze amar lo shichet ammecha ellu erev rav, vehu ma sheramaz beamro veatta shealav laasot teshuva vacharata al maase bilti hagun, veulay ki hu metakken haddavar leatid lavo sheamru zichronam livracha (yevamot kad:) en mekabbelin gerim limot hammashiach umoshe hu sheyyihye goel vitakken haddavar.

Hannicha li veyichar appi. kashe, vechi moshe haya mono? veadrabba lo amad bitfilla ella achar kach! od kashe, ki meamro "veyichar appi" mashma ki adayin lo chara appo vehu rotze bacharot af, vahalo en zo middato yitbarach shehu mevakkesh tamid lichbosh kaaso, vetze ulemad mimmaase shehuva battalmud (berachot 7,1) sheamar rabbi yishmael kohen gadol shennitratztza Adonai bevirchato asher berach Adonai baruch hu sheyyichbeshu rachamav et kaaso. veulay ki zo hi taanat moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom beamro lama Adonai yechere appecha vegomer, leshon atid, perush kevan shello chara adayin, veal kol panim kusheya lelohenu.

Veyitbaer hainyan behasekil al davar, vehu ki davar yadua hu ki shoresh haaf yihye mehaelbon hannirgash ballev kefi hammaalivin vehaelbon, veachar sheyyaggia hahergesh livchinat hammargish yesovev haitztzavon vehayyagon, vetihye terufato beechad mishshene derachim: haechad binkom nakam mehassovev, hashsheni bedivre ritztzuy leshiur hammaspik lehergesh hakepadat haelbon.

Vehinne baasot yisrael maase hammechoar, en lecha elbon lael elyon gadol mizze, vehu amro "saru maher" – adayin kalla bechuppatah vehinne hara liznunim. vehinne hirgish elohenu yitalle shemo hergesh gadol, ad shemmechamat otzem hahakpada chashav ki lo yoil haritztzuy, shehu echad mehashshene hammarchikin daavon haelbon, zulat derech hannekama kemo shekkatavnu. vehinne gam ze hu meshullal mimmennu yitbarach al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 2,1) ki en hakkadosh baruch hu sovel lirot tzaar tzaddiko vidido, umime olam shemanuhu sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 32,7) shello hevi mabbul ad achar petirat metushelach, velo metushelach levad ella kol tzaddike haddor, karamuz befasuk (Bereshit 7,22) "kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav" kevar metu kodem havaat hammabbul kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Zohar 9 206.). vechen hu omer (Yeshayahu 57,1) "mippene haraa neesaf hatztzaddik". vehinne galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam et asher yitztaer neeman beto beavdan moladto, yitbarach yevatter benogea lo velo yevatter bedavar hannogea lididav. uviroto yitbarach ki en makom lehaniach daagato, bikkesh mimmoshe davar sheyyanniach lo, vehu leval yitztaer al haddavar, veaz yihye metziut lacharot appo veyihye lo nachat ruach, vechivyachol ritztzahu lemoshe al haddavar. veamar lo veeese otcha legoy gadol, dikdek lomar "legoy gadol" velo amar "veeese otcha goy gadol", lomar hagam sheencha hen atta bivchinat nishmatcha goy gadol, ani achonen otcha veashpia becha midda tova merubba hafelagat neshamot kedoshot. velaze lo amar "veyihye mimmecha goy gadol" ki tzarich maase binyan chadash beshoresh nishmato.
Od ramaz listor taanat "veayye havetachatcha shennishbata laavot", laze amar veeese otcha legoy gadol, perush, lekiyyum havetachat goy gadol shehivtachti laavot (Bereshit 12:2).

Uvaa hatteshuva shel moshe ki min hannimna sheyyanniach lo, veherahu tzaaro al haddavar beamro vaychal moshe. veamru zichronam livracha (berachot lev,1) achazattu achilu, vechamma inyanim shel merirut nefesh asa lifne kono. ze keneged "hannicha li", ucheneged amro veyichar appi shehi taana shealeha ba, ki zulat ze en lahem nachat ruach meitztzevon haelbon, laze amar lamma Adonai yechere appecha, perush, lamma lo matzata tikkun laddavar ella charon af? kallech lederech zo vehu bechinat haritztzuy shekkatavnu. taana rishona sheyyesh lecha lachush al kinyancha, vehu amro beammecha, veen aveda ella livaleha. 2, asher hotzeta veal yedehem nitparsema elohutecha. 3, lamma yomru mitzrayim. 4, zechor leavraham vegomer. uvaze yesh lecha devarim uteamim nechonim hammaspikim livchinat haritztzuy, vealta beyad moshe hattaana vayyinnachem Adonai vegomer. veyirmoz tevat vayyinnachem leshon nechama uleshon nachat, ki nach tokef harogez shehaya lo, umeemtzaut ze nicham al vegomer. veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze.

rashi: Vaasher yitten mimmennu. meoto shel moshe:
Al zar. sheeno tzorech kehunna umalchut:
Beozne neshechem. amar aharon belibbo: hannashim vehayeladim chasim al tachshitehen, shemma yitakkev haddavar uvetoch kach yavo moshe, vehem lo himtinu ufarku meal atzman:
Parku. leshon tziuuy, miggizrat parek leyachid, kemo barchu miggizrat barech:
ohc: Vayyomer. perush, alehem hu sheamar ken, ulevavo lo chen yachshov.
Parku. perush, attem velo hem.
Nizme hazzahav. velo zahav acher.

Asher beazne. im yeshnam velo munachim baargaz, velo sheyyilbeshu mechadash, veim lo davar ze meakkev. gam amar neshechem benechem uvenotechem shello lehanniach zahav al kullam, uveemtzaut kol ze yitakkevu zeman ma. gam amar vehaviu perush velo tishlechu al yede shaliach, elay velo lezulati velo al yedchem. vetamo sheddavar hannaase al yede rabbim en bo ikkuv veal yede yachid yitakkev ketzat, vehem lo nitakkevu veasu kol hattenaim zulat hannezamim, amru zichronam livracha (tanchuma) shello ratzu hannashim, veheviu et shellahem kede shello lehitakkev.

rashi: Hannesiim baeda. kemo nesie haeda:
Vaydabber moshe alehem. shelichuto shel makom, uleshon hove hu chol hainyan hazze:
Keshe oref. machazrin keshi arpam leneged mochichehem umemaanim lishmoa:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai el moshe vegomer. taam sheyyiched amira acheret beemtza inyan, lehatzedik ma shepperashti, ki maamar rishon sheamar saru vegomer asu vegomer lo ba ella latet taam liridat moshe mimmadregato, veachshav ba ledabber ma shennogea leyisrael al chattatam. laze amar vayyomer vegomer, vezulatah haya nishma sheal ze baa hodaat saru maher, vehaven.

Vayyomer Adonai vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma shinna lomar kan vayyomer. veraiti bammechilta sheamru "vayyomer Adonai lemoshe lemor" – lo al yede malach velo al yede shaliach. vetzarich ladaat ma nishtanna pasuk ze lidrosh bo chen, veyoter haya nachon lomar haddevarim bevaydabber" haamur rishon battora. veulay shehirgishu mikkusheyatenu veamru ki "vayyomer" leshon maala, al derech amro (Yeshayahu 3:10) "imru tzaddik ki tov", uma hi hammaala – sheamar Adonai elav belo emtzai, uvesamuch yitbaer hattaam beofen acher.

rashi: Milu yedchem. attem hahorgim otam – bedavar ze titchannechu lihyot kohanim lammakom:
Ki ish. mikkem yemalle yado bivno uveachiv:
ohc: Milu. lo noda milluim ellu ma yaggidu, veim al harigat hakkerovim halo kevar asu ma sheasu, vehamefarshim amru ki pasuk ze medabber ma sheamar kodem hammaase, vekashe lamma lo ketavo bimkomo.

Venire ki pasuk ze bimkomo munnach, vehakkavvana hi letzad sheasu bene levi maase haamur besamuch shehargu kishloshet alfe ish vehu maase asher eno naase kayyotze bo al yede bechinat hatztzaddikim kayyadua, vetze ulemad meamram zichronam livracha (makkot 7,1) sheamru, bet din shehayu horgim echad lesheva shanim veyesh omrim leshivim shanim hayta nikret bet din katlanit, uvene levi hargu beyom echad kishloshet alfe ish, veyesh lachush baze lechesron haosher vesiman haggeriut sheyyechseru orot nishmat haose kaze, lu yihyu sheyyaharog kefi haddin sof kol sof ze yaggid haachzariyyut shehi bechinat hara. laze ba ish haelohim veamar lahem milu yedchem en perushah leshon tziuuy ella perusho hodaa, ki hen hayyom yihyu milluachem yedchem, perush kochachem, laAdonai, veen bemaase ze hakkarat choser haosher ella adrabba milluy orot hannefesh, vehattaam hu ki ish bivno vegomer, veze hu maase hametzuyyan leavraham avinu shebbo haya lo hashshelemut, dichtiv (Bereshit 22:10) "vayyishlach avraham et yado" vegomer uchetiv "atta yadati vegomer ki varech avarechcha", vehu amro velatet alechem hayyom beracha, millevad shebbaze hissagtem shelemut yad hakkodesh od latet alechem beracha.

Od nitkavven lomar bedikduk tevat alechem velo amar lachem, sheyyechavven lomar gam ken shehachissaron shennechsar al yadam eno karuy chissaron, ella adrabba beracha garmu bemaasehem. vahare ze dome leilan shezzomrin oto lehatzelachato bahasarat anafim haraim, kemo chen beemtzaut harigat ose resha mibbene yisrael shennimshelu laggefen (tehillim 80:9). vehu amro velatet alechem, perush, al sibbatchem, hayyom beracha, perush, leyisrael, shebbahem haya hachissaron, shezzulat ze haya bet mechush lechol yisrael. uchefi ze, taam sheamru bet din hahoreget echad leshivim shana vechulei, hu bimtziut sheeno dome lammetziut shellefanenu mishshene teamim: haechad, ki kan hargu chavivehem, veze yaggid bechinat hafelagat ahavatam babbore, veod shehaya metziut shezzulat ze tidbak haraa lechol yisrael, uveemtzaut ze shav Adonai mecharon appo.

rashi: Veet haaron laedut. letzorech luchot haedut:
Karati veshem –. laasot melachti – et betzalel:
ohc: Ree karati veshem. ulay sheyyechavven lomar sheyyiru remez hainyan bishmo veshem avotav, betzalel sheasa tzel lael, ben uri sheasa makom laasher or lo, ben chur sheasa yisrael bene chorin meavon haegel, keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 51,4) befasuk "mishkan haedut" – edut lakkol shennimchal lahem avon haegel, hare shennirsham bo haddavar bishmo veshem avotav. uvaze yavo al nachon amro vaamalle betosefet vav, lomar millevad zo od ani mosif bo melay mehachachma. veamro bechachma velo amar chachma, veulay sheyyechavven al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (berachot noah,1) befasuk (Daniel 2:21) "yahev chachmeta lechakkimin", sheen hakkadosh baruch hu noten chachma ella lemi sheyyesh bo chachma vechulei, vehu amro vaamalle vegomer bechachma sheyyesh bo osif lemalleoto yoter, vechen bitvuna vegomer.

rashi: Vayyatzar oto bacheret. yesh letargemo vishne fanim, haechad vayyatzar – leshon keshira, bacheret – leshon sudar, kemo vehammitpachot vehacharitim (Yeshayahu 3), vayyatzar kikkerayim kesef bishne charitim (Melachim 2 Adonai), vehashsheni vayyatzar – leshon tzura, bacheret – kele ummanut hatztzorfin shechortzin vechortin bo tzurot bezahav, keet sofer hachoret otiyyot beluchot ufinkasin, kemo uchetov alav becheret enosh (Yeshayahu 8), vezehu shettirgem unkelos vetzar yateh bezifa, leshon ziyyuf, hu keli ummanut shechortzin bo bezahav otiyyot ushekedim, shekkorin belaaz 100, umezayyefin al yado chotamot:

Egel massecha. kevan shehishlicho laur bechur, bau mechashshefe erev rav shealu immahem mimmitzrayim vaasauhu vichshafim; veyesh omrim micha haya sham, sheyyatza mittoch dimmose binyan shennitmaech bo bemitzrayim, vehaya veyado shem vetas shekkatav bo moshe "ale shor" "ale shor" lehaalot arono shel yosef mittoch nilus – vehishlicho letoch hakkur veyatza haegel (tanchuma):
Massecha. leshon mattechet; davar acher 125 kanterin zahav hayu vo kegimatriyya shel massecha (sham):
Elle elohecha. velo neemar elle elohenu, mikkan sheerev rav shealu mimmitzrayim hem shennikhalu al aharon vehem sheasauhu, veachar kach hitu et yisrael acharav (sham):
ohc: Vayyaasehu egel. perush, baavur shennaasa al yado, lo sheasao hu, dichtiv (Shemot 32:24) "vayyetze haegel hazze". o letzad shellakach hazzahav miyyadam leyado, velo nitchakkem sheyyannichu hazzahav baaretz levattel keshafehem (Zohar 10 192.), heela alav hakkatuv hammaase.

Vayyomru elle elohecha yisrael asher vegomer. kashe, ech yeamen hattippeshut vehabbaarut ledor dea, rabbim venichbadim, lomar ledomem "elle elohecha" vegomer? velu yihye sheddibber haegel beemtzaut maase kishshuf kemaamaram zichronam livracha (tanchuma), af al pi chen ze yoil lachshov bo davar, aval lehaid edut sheker shezze hu hammotzi – lo.

Achen hannachon hu ki adrabba bedivrehem ellu gillu datam sheenam mishtachavim veosim eloah ella lehammotziam meeretz mitzrayim, venitkavvenu bedibbur ze lehachin bo bechinat haelohut shehu hammotzi, vetihye haavoda lachelek mehakkol vahare hem keovdim lakkol, vehachelek haya holech lifnehem vehu yaane lehannikkach mimmennu. velo haya beenehem lezarut ki halo yesh baadam chelek eloah mimmaal, ella ki letzad sheharekavato enah mimmin hammitkayyem haruach tashuv el haelohim, venitchakkemu laasot haddavar lehameshich koach elyon bedavar hammitkayyem veyihye matzuy tamid lifnehem, uleolam lo akru "anochi Adonai vegomer asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim" ella amru elle, veulay ki laze amar heelucha leshon rabbim lirmoz lechoach tachton kaelyon chas veshalom, uveemtzaut ze pagmu pegamim rabbim veasa Adonai bahem shefatim. veayyen beferush pasuk (Shemot 32:8) "saru maher min hadderech" vegomer.

Venire beenay ki lo kol yisrael hiskimu al hattaut, ella chelek mehem vechelek lo michu, ushekulim hayu baddavar, vechelek lo haya bahem koach limchot. vehinne middikduk amram elohecha velo amru chas veshalom elohenu vegomer hotzianu, ze yaggid ki ketzat mehem amru ze lechullam, veyesh shehitzdik veyesh shello hitzdik. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Shemot Rabba 42,6) sheerev rav shealu im yisrael hem haosim, uvehechreach lomar ki yisrael lo hiskimu bishat maase, sheim hiskimu hare gam hemma asu, shehammachshava poelet baavoda zara, vegam lo michu, veal ze neenshu kelalut yisrael zulat meatte hayyecholet shebbachan Adonai libbam shello nata achar hara, vehammefursamim baddavar hem bene levi. vehinne achar shennaasa haegel behechreach lomar shechelek miyyisrael tau acharav, dichtiv (Shemot 32,28) "vayyippol min haam kishloshet alfe ish", uvehechreach shemmiyyisrael naflu, kammuvan meamro (Shemot 32,27) "hirgu ish et achiv vegomer et kerovo", im ken behechreach lomar shechelek miyyisrael avdu avoda zara beedim vehateraa.

rashi: Vedelef tored. delef geshamim hayyored babbayit umatriach vetored leyoshve habbayit, kach midyene ishsha raa:
targum: Bar sachla kasheh hu laavuy hech kirse vehech dalfa dedalef tigre deitteta:

rashi: Vayyitparku. leshon perikat massa, keshentalum meaznehem nimtzeu hem meforakim minnizmehem, 834 belaaz:
Et nizme. kemo minnizme, kemo ketzeti et hair (Shemot 9) – min hair:
Vedibber Adonai el moshe panim el panim. umitmallel im moshe:

Veshav el hammachane. leachar shennidbar immo haya moshe shav el hammachane umelammed lazzekenim ma shellamad; vehaddavar hazze nahag moshe miyyom hakkippurim ad shehukam hammishkan, velo yoter, shehare veshiva asar betammuz nishtabberu halluchot, uveych saraf et haegel vedan et hachotim, uveyt ala shenneemar vayhi mimmochorat vayyomer moshe el haam vegomer (Shemot 32), veasa sham arbaim yom uvikkesh rachamim, shenne vaetnappal lifne Adonai vegomer (Devarim 9), uverosh chodesh elul neemar lo vealita vabboker el har sinay (Shemot 34), lekabbel luchot haacharonot – veasa sham 40 yom, shenneemar bahem veanochi amadti vahar kayyamim harishonim vegomer – ma harishonim beratzon af haacharonim beratzon, emor meatta emtzaiyyim hayu vechaas – beasara betishre nitratztza hakkabba leyisrael besimcha uvelev shalem, veamar lo lemoshe salachti, umasar lo luchot acharonot, veyarad vehitchil letzauotam al melechet hammishkan, vaasauhu ad echad benisan, umishshehukam lo nidbar immo od ella meohel moed (tanchuma):

Veshav el hammachane. targumo vetayev lemashrita, lefi shehu leshon hove, vechen kol hainyan, veraa kol haam – vechazan, venitztzevu – vekaymin, vehibbitu – umistakkelin, vehishtachavu – vesagdin. umidrasho: vedibber Adonai el moshe – sheyyashuv el hammachane, amar lo ani vechaas veatta vechaas, im ken mi yakrivem? (tanchuma):
ohc: Vedibber Adonai vegomer panim el panim. hakkavvana baze hu, kefi shiur hahachana shehaya ose moshe lehakebalat pene shechina, leoto shiur tihye hahassaga mippanim haelyonim, ki kefi asher yachin adam atzmo lehashepaat hakkedushsha yassig.

Veamro kaasher yedabber ish el reehu, yitbaer ledarkenu al derech amro (Mishlei 27:19) "kammayim happanim lappanim ken lev haadam laadam", perush ki hallevavot yaskilu bannelam im leehov im lisno, ki kefi asher yachin haadam libbo leehov chavero kemo chen yitbonen lev chavero leehov oto, vehu amro kaasher yedabber ish el reehu shello yohavehu im lo yachin libbo lihyot gam hu reehu, kemo chen dibber Adonai panim el panim. umeatta yavchin adam ma hu im kono – im levavo yitavve veyachshok baAdonai uvaavodato hinne ze siman ki Adonai ahevo.

rashi: Uvamme yivvada efo. yivvada metziat hachen, halo belechtecha immanu. veod davar ani shoel mimmecha, shello tashre shechinatcha od al ummot haolam.
Veniflinu ani veammecha. venihye muvdalim baddavar hazze mikkol haam (berachot 7), kemo vehifla Adonai ben mikne yisrael vegomer (Shemot 9):

Ki voshesh moshe. ketargumo, leshon ichur, vechen boshesh richbo (Shoftim Adonai), vayyachilu ad bosh (sham 3); ki kesheala moshe lahar amar lahem lesof arbaim yom ani va betoch shesh shaot, kisvurim hem sheoto yom sheala min hamminyan hu, vehu amar lahem shelemim – arbaim yom velelo immo – veyom aliyyato en lelo immo, shehare vez besivan ala, nimtza yom arbaim beshiva asar betammuz. beyv ba satan veirbev et haolam, vehera demut choshech vaafela veirbuveya, lomar vadday met moshe lechach ba irbuveya laolam, amar lahem met moshe, shekkevar bau shesh shaot velo ba vechulei kidita vemassechet shabbat (daf 89); vei efshar lomar shelo tau ella beyom hameunnan ben kodem chatzot ben leachar chatzot, shehare lo yarad moshe ad yom hammochorat, shenneemar vayyashkimu mimmochorat vayyaalu olot:
Asher yelchu lefanenu. elohot harebe iuu lahem (sanhedrin 63):
Ki ze moshe haish. kemin demut moshe hera lahem hassatan, shennosim oto baavir rekia hashshamayim (shabbat 89):
Asher heelanu meeretz mitzrayim. vehaya more lanu derech asher naale bah, atta tzerichin anu leelohot asher yelchu lefanenu:
ohc: Vayyar haam vegomer. perush beene hassechel, o al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat 89,1) shebba satan vehera lahem demut choshech vaafela vechulei udemut mittato shel moshe shemmet, laze amar vayyar haam inyanim hannizkarim vehitzdiku hainyan mittaam ki ba shesh, shehu zeman shehigbil lahem, vezulat ze lo hayu osim cheshbon middivre hassatan harammay.

Vayyikkahel haam al aharon. tzarich ladaat taam amro al aharon, veim ledabber elav haya lo lomar "vayyikkahel haam vayyomru el aharon". ulay yechavven lomar ki nikhalu alav lehargo, vayyomru kum vegomer veim lav vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sanhedrin 7,1) shehargu lechur, veze lecha haot lidvarenu. vetaam shello nirmaz battora harigat chur, kede shello yishshaer rishshumo nikkar battora ledorot olam, vehashshem chas al kevod am bene yisrael, velo nichtav maase haegel ella letaam sheim chata tzibbur omrim lahem kallech etzel tzibbur shennitkabbela teshuvatam al chetam, kaamur sham (avoda zara 5,1). veulay ki ramza hattora harigat chur mimma sheamar hakkatuv (Shemot 24,14) "vehinne aharon vechur immachem" velo hizkiro befasuk ze im aharon, hare ze maggid ki tarof toraf. umeforash haddavar bedivre kabbala dichtiv (yirmeya 2,34) "gam bichnafayich nimtzeu dam nafshot" vegomer, kaamur bevayyikra rabba (10,3). venire latet taam lema sheharaguhu, veulay ki keshello ratza laasot, maasav mochichot ki chafetz lihyot hu emtzai kemoshe, veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze. lachen haraguhu shello ratzu sheyyihye emtzai adam, lefi sheyyesh bo bechinat haratzon hattivi vechochotav nimshachim baartziyyut, vehaven.

Asher yelchu lefanenu. dikdek lomar lefanenu, perush, letzad ki Adonai hammotzi otam meeretz mitzrayim hu nelam vegavoah meod, veyiker lahem mikre ra been mashgiach alehem, laze yaasu koach mikkochot tzeva hashshamayim sheyyihye lematta lifnehem, uleolam lo mardu besibba rishona ella sheratzu beemtzai. veulay shechashvu shello tzivva Adonai al issur haemtzai ella kol od sheyyihye moshe, velaze amru ki ze moshe haish vegomer. veefshar ki taanat taut terufa befihem beamram "ki ze moshe haish asher heelanu" vegomer, perush, hare lecha reaya ki tzarich emtzai, shello hotzianu Adonai belo emtzaut shaliach, emor meatta ki yesh tzorech beemtzai. uma shekkerauhu elohim al derech amro (Shemot 7:1) "ree netatticha elohim lefaro", udevarim ellu taut gedola hem, veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat yitro (Shemot 20:4).

rashi: Atzla tappil tardema. haatzlut mevia lide shena, zo hi hammelitza. aval hammashal – al hammitatztzel betalmudo; sof sheshshoalin devar chachma mimmennu vehu nirdam:
Venefesh remiyya tirav. sof sheyyehe ani; vechen harammay betalmudo, laasot torato chavilot, sof shehu yishkach:
targum: Atluta yahave shinta venafsha remita tichfan:

rashi: El eretz zavat chalav udevash. ani omer lecha lehaalotam:
Ki lo eele bekirbecha. lechach ani omer lecha veshalachti lefanecha malach:
Ki am keshe oref atta. uchesheshshechinati vekirbechem veattem mamrim bi, marbe ani alechem zaam:
Achelcha. leshon killayon:
ohc: Pen achelcha vegomer. sheeno dome hammachis et rabbo befanav leshello befanav. veamro baddarech kan ramaz shello lechol hazzemannim hu omer ken ella lizman heyotam badderech, aval beir az lanu yaale bekirbenu (Yeshayahu 26:1).

O yirtze al pi maamar anshe emet ki hammidbar haya mekom moshavo shel 131 harasha, velaze haya kamma peamim mitgabber vehoreg mehem lesibba hammizdammenet lahem mehachet. veayyen bedivre hazzohar (10 157.) beferush pasuk "hammidbar haggadol vehannora" (Devarim 1:17). velaze amar pen achelcha baddarech, perush beemtzaut hammizdammen badderech, vehaven:

rashi: Ki tissa. leshon kabbala, ketargumo; keshettachpotz lekabbel sechum minyanam ladaat kamma hem, al timnem laggulgolet, ella yittenu kol echad machatzit hashshekel vetimne et hashshekalim veteda minyanam:
Velo yihye vahem negef. shehamminyan sholet bo ayin hara, vehaddever ba alehem, kemo shemmatzinu vime david (Shmuel 2 24):
ohc: Ki tissa et rosh vegomer. tzarich ladaat taam amro tissa velo amar tifkod keamro bematte levi (Bamidbar 3:15). 2 amro et rosh velo hispik lomar "ki tissa et bene yisrael", sheen lomar shello yetzav Adonai limnot ella lerashim ki hainyan yachchish ze, 3 tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro lifkudehem.

Veyitbaer hakkatuv al pi divrehem zichronam livracha, ki hachote gorem becheto kefifat rosho, ki bechinat hara mahutah hi el eretz tabbit ki shefela hi, uvechinat hakkedushsha hi nesiat rosh vaharamat hammahut vehaechut. vetimtza sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 23:17) "vayyakam sede efron", vedarshu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 58:8) kima hayta lo. vehinne leheyot shemmitzva zo baa achar maase haegel, uchemo sheddiyyek hakkatuv beamro venatatta oto al avodat ohel moed, veamru zichronam livracha (Rashi) mikkan shennitztavva limnotam achar maase haegel, vehu ma sheamar ki tissa leshon nesiut rosh, al derech amro (Bereshit 40:13) "yissa faro et roshecha" shehu leshon maala, shettissa rosh bene yisrael sherosham namuch letzad chesronam bemaase haegel. vehu amro lifkudehem al derech amro (Bamidbar 31:49) "velo nifkad mimmennu ish", veamru zichronam livracha (shabbat sad.) shello nimtza bahem adam shechata. venatnu ish kofer nafsho laAdonai asher chata al hannefesh, bifkod otam perush kemashmao.
Vetaam amro venatnu betosefet vav, letzad shetztzarich kodem hakkarat hachet ki lo tov asa vechata bannefesh, veachar kach yitten kofer nafsho laAdonai.

Od yirtze beamro lifkudehem vegomer, sheen lecha reshut limnotam ella lesibbat pekudehem, perush, letzad chesronam im nechseru mehem vetirtze laamod al hannisharim, o shennichnesu begeder hachanat hachoser, keamro (Bamidbar 31:49) "avadecha nasu et rosh" vegomer letzad sheyyardu lammilchama, o lesibbat tzorech hammispar laaroch milchama im oyev vechaddome, uva lishlol sheen limnotam belo sibba kelal. veamro venatnu betosefet vav lihyot haddavar tenay nosaf al tenay rishon, shetztzarich lifkudehem od tzarich latet ish kofer vegomer. vedavar ze eno noheg ella leoto zeman shehayu yisrael chayyavim al haegel, aval ledorot en tzorech bintina, veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze.

Velo yihye vahem negef bifkod otam. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar paam sheniyya bifkod otam. venire ki letzad shebbaa hammitzva al zeman shehayu chayyavim lashshamayim lesibbat avon haegel, yomar haomer shebbizman acher kesheyyirtze limnot en kefeda baddavar veyachol limnotam echad echad, laze amar velo yihye vahem negef bifkod otam ribba minyan acher zulat harishon sheggam alav baa haazhara sheim yifkod yihye vahem negef.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech, ki millevad shebbannetina hem mechapperim al nafsham, od "velo yihye vahem negef" besibbat pekod otam, umimmotza davar atta yodea ki hamminyan mitztzad atzmo yesovev hannegef.

Od yirtze ki yetzav Adonai shene devarim: haechad sheyyihye hammispar al yede netinat davar, keamro venatnu vegomer, uchemo shebbeer beamro ze yittenu, vehu letaam kapparat nafsham. vehashsheni shello yimnu otam echad echad ella al yede davar acher, vehu amro velo yihye vahem negef bifkod otam echad echad, ella al yede davar acher. vederech mispar ze en bo hakeravat hattoelet ella harechakat hannezek hannimshach mehammispar, vehu ma shemmatzinu leshaul dichtiv (Shmuel 1 11:8) "vayyifkedem bevazek", perush, becharsit. vezulat perushenu ze tikshe mi hittir leshaul lifkod yisrael becharsit, vehattora amra "ze yittenu kol haover al happekudim machatzit hashshekel"? velidvarenu timtza nachat ruach bainyan.

Venatatti libbi lehasekil bemaase david (Shmuel 2 24), ki lefi hannishma mehakketuvim ki mana yisrael echad echad belo emtzai, nosaf al shemmenaam lelo davar, vehem devarim temuhim sheyyaase david hammelech alav hashshalom davar zar kaze. umatzinu sherabbotenu zichronam livracha (berachot sav:) amru ki min hashshamayim hichshiluhu bedavar sheafillu tinokot shel bet rabban vechulei, letaam amro (Shmuel 1 26:19) "im Adonai hesitcha bi" yeuyyan sham divrehem. perush divrehem, ki letzad shekkara laAdonai chas veshalom mesit nivra malach ra, lefi ma shekkadam middivrehem (avot 4,11) "haover avera achat kone lo kategor echad", vehu min heavon mammash kemaasehu, velaze nivra malach ra mesit shemo, vehesito vehitahu laasot ken besod amram (sham) "avera goreret avera". vetimtza ki heavon asa dugemato, shekkeshem sheddivre david sheamar "hesitcha" kishgaga hayta mimmennu, vechas veshalom shennitkavven ledabber millin letzad illaa chalila, umi eved yare meelohim kedavid, ella shegaga hi, kemo chen lo husat mehammesit laasot davar bilti hagun kemezid.

Vaadayin kashe, tenach legabbe david amrinan shettaa, ma naane beyoav? mimma nafshach tikshe: im divre david bau elav setam "pekod bene yisrael", mi amar lo sheen kavvanat david lomar lo sheyyifkedem al pi hattora, umin hassetam lo yutzerach lomar elav davar shettinokot yodim oto. veim nomar ki david tzivva elav beferush sheyyimne otam echad echad velo al yede machatzit hashshekel, kashe ech kibbel devarav kesheamar lo chen, shehaya lo lemaen ki "divre harav vedivre hattalmid divre mi shomin", vaafillu bemitzvat melech, veze halacha rovachat (282 hilchot Melachim 83). velu yehi sheyyoav neelma mimmennu umikre echad kara ledavid veyoav, ma naane bassanhedrin? ma naane bechol ish kesherau shebbau limnotam? haya lahem lacharod charada gedola veemot mavet yippelu alehem, veyitzaku al haddavar lifne yoav velifne hammelech. gam ken yecholin lavo betaana hannishmaat "velo yihye vahem negef bifkod otam". veim chasu al machatzit hashshekel yoter miggufan, haya lahem liton sheyyimmanu becharsit kemaase shaul hammelech, veech lo chasu al nafsham kol bene el chay?

Vehannachon beenay ki david amar devarav setam leyoav, vehaddavar pashut ki yoav yodea sefer haya velo menaam ella al yede davar acher bevezek vechaddome lo. vetimtza sheddiyyek hattalmud bilshono (berachot sav:) "lo shakal minnayyhu kofer", mashma kofer hu delo shakal aval hamminyan haya al yede davar acher. vehinne diyyaknu shello lechol mispar yitchayyev hannetina, vehattaut shettaa hayta shehaya hammispar lelo davar, uchevar perashnu middikduk hakkatuv ki lo yifkedu otam ella lesibbat davar kemo shekkatavnu lemala, aval lelo davar lo. vehi taana shettimtza shettaan yoav ledavid sheen tzorech baddavar limnot yisrael. veulay sheim haya mone otam al yede machatzit hashshekel lu yihye sheyyitchayyevu yisrael bemita hinne hu kofer nefesh shel kol echad. vehu amram zichronam livracha sheim haya david mone otam al yede hashshekalim lo haya bahem negef. vetimtza sheamar hakkatuv (Shmuel 2 24:1) "vayyosef Adonai lacharot beyisrael vayyaset et david bahem", hareta ladaat ki yisrael hayu chayyavin al hakkodem, velaze keshebba hammispar bahem lelo tzorech been rishyon meadon hakkol shalat bahem haddin venifra mehem avonam.

Od efshar lomar, ki kevan shehuzekar bitnae hamminyan shetztzarich lesibbat davar, kol shechaser tenay echad hare hem nichlalim begeder hannegef bar minnan, vezo hayta tauto shel david shettaa. velaze timtza bitshuvat yoav elav "vadoni hammelech lamma chafetz baddavar hazze" (Shmuel 2 24:3), perush, minyan lelo tzorech, aval im haya tzorech baddavar yaskim gam hu. veim hamminyan haya echad echad, hagam sheyyihye tzorech bamminyan, lo yifkedem bederech ze, vehaya tzarich lomar lo ech yachol laasot davar ze. ulefi sheen inyan ze meforash bakkatuv ella middiyyuk hakkatuv, lo matza yoav lachalok im david. o efshar shechashav kesheraa devar melech chazak alav, amar ulay sheyyesh lo taam nichmas, vechash al atzmo mimmerod bammalchut, uleolam lo menaam echad echad. uvaze en kushya gam ken al kol ish yisrael shello pikkechu al nafsham, ki hem lo nimnu echad echad, vedavar ze shetztzarich limnotam al yede sibba en alehem muttal ladaat im yesh sibba lammelech, velo badku acharav lechezkat kashruto.

Nimtzenu omrim kelalo shel davar: mispar bene yisrael nechlak lishlosha dinim. haechad hu mispar shehaya achar haegel, ze haya letzorech, gam hutzrach latet machatzit hashshekel letzad shehayu chayyavim kannizkar. sheni, kol sheyyesh tzorech bemisparam en tzarich limnotam al yede shekalim ella afillu becharsit adama, veze maase shaul. shelishi, kol sheen tzorech limnotam en limnotam afillu al yede charsit, vezo hayta tauto shel david shehitahu Adonai al shigyono, veal yede netinat machatzit hashshekel muttar ki ze monea hannegef habbaa mehammispar. veim tomar lamma hutzrach david lemispar velo hispik lo minyan shikle bene yisrael hammeviim midde shana beshana, yesh lomar sheen hochacha mehashshekalim ki yoav lo hevi ella mispar haanashim sholfe cherev (Shmuel 2 24:9), vehashshekalim meviim hakkol vaafillu hakketannim, keamram (shekalim 1,3) adam shokel al yede beno uvitto hakketannim veal yede ishto vechulei, velaze ratza ladaat mispar anshe hammilchama, vedavar ze lo yadanu mimmachatzit hashshekel hammuva bet Adonai.

rashi: Orish. ketargumo atarich, vechen hachel rash (Devarim 2), vechen vayyoresh et haemori (Bamidbar 21) – leshon gerushin:
Vehirchavti et gevulecha. veatta rachok mibbet habbechira, veencha yachol leraot lefanay tamid, lechach ani kovea lecha shalosh regalim hallalu:
ohc: Orish goyim mippanecha. dikdek lomar mippanecha, perush leval titztaer biriyyatam, al derech maamaram zichronam livracha (gittin 56:) bemaase rabbi yochanan ben zakkay im aspasyanus, hivtiach Adonai ki lo yerau lefanenu kol ikkar.
Vehirchavti vegomer. al derech amro (yirmeya 3:19) "eretz tzevi", veamru zichronam livracha (gittin 57:) keor shel tzevi ze vechulei:

rashi: Vayyiru miggeshet elav. bo uree kamma gadol kochah shel avera shead shello fashtu yedehem baavera mahu omer? umare kevod Adonai keesh ochelet berosh hahar leene bene yisrael (Shemot 24) – velo yereim velo mizdazeim, umishsheasu et haegel af mikkarne hodo shel moshe hayu martiim umizdazeim (sifre):
Lech ale mizze. eretz yisrael gevoha mikkol haaratzot, lechach neemar ale; davar acher, kelappe sheamar lo bishat hakkaas "lech red" amar lo bishat ratzon "lech ale" (tanchuma):
Atta vehaam. kan lo neemar veammecha:
ohc: Lech ale mizze. hizkir leshon aliyya, ulay sheyyirmoz lema sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat pach,1) shehaadi shehitnatztzelu yisrael natal moshe, vehu haaliyya sheramaz lo beamro ale mizze, perush mizze sheavar, velaze dikdek lomar gam ken tevat atta shello haya tzarich lomar kevan sheimmo haya medabber, ella lomar atta taale velo zulatcha sheadrabba yerida hayta lahem, veamro vehaam perush yelech immach.

Lemor. taam amro lemor, ki lashon ze haamur bedivre Adonai, lo haya shave lechullam. yesh mehem sheamar lo belashon ze, veyesh mehaavot sheamar lo belashon acher kamvoar min hakketuvim, laze amar lemor, perush, shekkavvanat haamira lechullam hu "lezaracha" vegomer:

rashi: Bematkuntah. beminyan sammaneha:
Kodesh tihye lecha laAdonai. shello taasenna ella lishmi:
