ohc: Vehakketoret asher taase. yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (keritut 6.) sheamru chachamim: kol yom metakken bematkuntah vehaya machnis, vehu amro vehakketoret asher taase, perush, kol ma sheyyeshno behechsher maase bet Adonai – bematkuntah lo taasu, ha lamadta hammefattem chatzi mane chayyav karet.
Lo taasu. perush, afillu shello lehariach asur belav, aval becharet davka lehariach, velaze lo rasham tenay lehariach befasuk ze ella bappasuk shehizkir bo onesh karet (Shemot 30:38).

rashi: Chodesh haaviv. chodesh habbikkur, shehattevua mitbakkeret bevishshulah:
ohc: Et chag hammatztzot tishmor. taam mitzva zo kan letziyyun ki hen elle tikkune hachet shekkodem, keamram zichronam livracha (Zohar 10 40.) ki hechametz hu bechinat el acher, velaze tzivva Adonai beyeter seet lishmor et haddavar, vetzivva kan al kelalut hammoadim. ulay ki letzad shenneemar baegel (Shemot 32:4) "elle elohecha asher heelucha" vegomer, vechol hammoadim teluyim bitziat mitzrayim, laze chazar Adonai al haddevarim kede sheyyekabbelu alehem happeratim sheyyesh negdiyyut lahem bemashmaut maamar hakkefira, veze echad mipperate hatteshuva hatztzerichin. vehizkir shemirat shabbat lefi shehem avdu avoda zara shehi shekula keneged kol hattora kullah, laze amar Adonai mitzvat shabbat shehi gam ken shakul keneged kol hattora, shebbaze yetukkan hammeuvvat. veayyen ma shekkatavti bitchillat parashat vayyakhel.

rashi: Kol ache rash. kerovav:
Af ki mereehu rachaku. vechol shekken mereav veshoshvinav veohavav:
Meraddef amarim. lo hemma omer: peloni ufeloni kerovay, ufeloni ufeloni mereay, vehakkol divre hevel. veyesh lefotro bemi shehu rash battora uvemaasim tovim:

Meraddef amarim lo hemma. mechazzer lehorot halacha velav beyado, vehammidrash potro beyosef shehaya motzi al echav dibba, veamar leaviv shehen chashudin al ever min hachay, lechach seneuhu venikra rash lefi shehaya motzi dibbat sheker alehem. umechazzer achar amarim lo hemma. lo kerinan umeraddef amarim lahanaato, uleinyan yosef lo hemma, ki alav chazru dibbato hu haya omer shehayu ochlim ever min hachay vehakkatuv meid alehem afillu bishat hakkalkala hayu shochatin seir izzim shenneemar "vayyishchatu seir izzim" (Bereshit 37:31). hu amar shehayu mezalzelin bivne hashshefachot lechach "leeved nimkar yosef" (tehillim 105:17), hu amar shehayu notnim enehem bivnot haaretz amar hakkadosh baruch hu chayyecha sheani megare becha et haddov lechach "vattissa eshet adonav vegomer" (Bereshit 39:7) (Bereshit Rabba 84:7):
targum: Kulehon rachamoy demiskena sanyan leh veaf chavroy rachakin mineh ikka detarech bemiloy la sherir:

rashi: Achappera bead chattatchem. asim kofer vekinnuach usetima leneged chattatchem, lehavedil benechem uven hachet:

Elohe zahav. atta hu sheggaramta lahem, shehishpata lahem zahav vechol cheftzam, ma yaasu shello yechetu? mashal lemelech shehaya maachil umashke et beno umekashsheto vetole lo kis betzavvaro umaamido befetach bet zonot, ma yaase habben shello yecheta:
ohc: Chata haam vegomer. ulay sheyyechavven lomar al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota 3,1) en adam over avera ella im ken nichnesa bo ruach shetut, veze hu chesron hannefesh, vehu amro chata, perush, nechsar mehearat nafsho, uvaze "asu lahem" vegomer, veze hu echad mitteanot shebbahem yizke haadam leyom haddin, ki baasoto hachet lo haya dato shalem, vahagam sheyyeanesh al asher garam leatzmo hachissaron bemachshevot hakkiur, af al pi chen lo yidme leim yihye niddon al maase hara bedato hashshelema.

Od yirtze al pi ma shekkadam lanu (kiddushin 40,1) ki baavoda zara yeanesh haadam gam al hammachshava levad, vehu amro keneged hammachshava chata haam hazze, ucheneged hammaase amar vayyaasu lahem vegomer:

rashi: Kol peter rechem li. baadam:
Vechol miknecha vegomer. vechol miknecha asher tizzachar befeter shor vase – asher yiftor zachar et rachmah:
Peter. leshon peticha, vechen poter mayim reshit madon (Mishlei 17); 416 shel tizzachar leshon nekeva hi, musav al hayyoledet:

Veet bigde hasserad. omer ani – lefi peshuto shel mikra – shei efshar lomar shebbevigde chehunna medabber, lefi shenne etzlam veet bigde hakkodesh leaharon hakkohen veet bigde vanav lechahen, ella ellu bigde hasserad hem bigde hattechelet vehaargaman vetolaat shani haamurin befarashat massaot, venatnu el beged techelet ufarsu alav beged argaman ufarsu alehem beged tolaat shani (Bamidbar 4); venirin devaray, shenne umin hattechelet vehaargaman vetolaat hashshani asu vigde serad lesharet bakkodesh (Shemot 39), velo huzkar shesh immahem, veim bevigde chehunna medabber, lo matzinu veechad mehem argaman o tolaat shani belo shesh:

Bigde hasserad. yesh mefarshim leshon avoda vesherut, ketargumo levushe shimmusha, veen lo dimyon bammikra; vaani omer shehu leshon arammi, ketargum shel kelaim vetargum shel michbar, shehayu arugim bemachat asuyim nekavim nekavim latzeydetz belaaz:
Vayyashkimu. hassatan zerzam, kede sheyyechetu:

Letzachek. yesh bemashma hazze gilluy arayot, kemo shenne letzachek bi (Bereshit 39), ushefichut damim, kemo shenne yakumu na hannearim visachaku lefanenu (Shmuel 2 2), af kan neherag chur (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Vayyashkimu mimmochorat vegomer. kashe lamma lo asa Adonai baruch hu haregasha bishat maase haegel techef umiyyad lomar lemoshe red ki shichet ammecha, ad achar sheavar yom hammaase ulemochorat achar sheheelu olot ushelamim? veod, sheim haya makpid al haddavar techef umiyyad lomar lemoshe red vegomer, lo hayu baim lide zevicha lelohim acherim. veen lomar shekkodem amar elav ella shemmoshe nitakkev lehashiv charon af, shehare bedivre Adonai neemar "vayyishtachavu lo vayyizbechu lo", ha lamadta sheddevarav hayu achar shezzavchu lemochorat hammaase. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (avoda zara 4,2) lo hayu yisrael reuyim leoto maase vechulei ella sheim chata tzibbur vechulei, af al pi chen yeshno lelimmud ze gam im lo hayu zovchim, shebbedibbur rishon sheamru "elle elohecha" hare kibbeluha alehem leeloah. vahagam sheamarnu ketzat mehem amru chen velo chullam, ulehaomrim erev rav hem amru, al kol panim shamu veshatku kullam. uvehechreach lomar shehammuatim hu shello hiskimu, sheim hayu hamerubbim hayu omdim alehem vehorgim et haomrim ken, veim ken hare hamerubbim mitchayyevim middin arev.

Venire lomar, ki letzad shekkadam veamar Adonai lemoshe ki sham yeshev arbaim yom, veachar haarbaim yitten lo halluchot, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (shabbat 89,1) befasuk "ki voshesh moshe" shebbau shesh shaot beyom haggevul shel arbaim, ha lamadta ki neemar lo meAdonai sheshsham yeshev arbaim, asher al ken lo amar lo Adonai lemoshe laredet min hahar kodem haarbaim yom ad sofam, veaz amar elav "lech min hahar", veamro "red" afarshennu bimkomo. uchefi ze, hagam shehirgish Adonai bemaase yisrael hara meet hikkahalam al aharon, im kol ze devar elohenu sheamar arbaim yom yakum leolam.

Veim tomar lamma lo chashav Adonai machashavot leval yikkashelu, zo chakira kelalit behanehagot habbore im beruav, uchevar katavnu befarashat bereshit (Bereshit 6:5) ketzat mehatteamim hammussagim etzlenu, uvema shellefanenu en anu tzerichin latteamim ki tamo betziddo, ki behechreach sheyyihye sham moshe arbaim yom lekabbalat halluchot veyesh teamim nistarot laAdonai vehanniglot lanu keneged yetzirat havvalad, gam lehodia haderagot shel hattora mikkol haolam, shekkol haolam nivra beshishsha yamim vehalluchot beriatam learbaim yom, uchemaamar rabbi yochanan lerabbi chiyyay (Shemot Rabba 47:5) al ma shezzavan sadot ucheramim vezetim ki machar davar hannittan leshishsha vekana davar hannittan learbaim.

Od yerae li taam acher, ki letzad shehattora yesh bah arba derachim kelaliyyim, vehen minyan pardes, veyesh lecha ladaat shehem mearbaa haderagot orot elyonim hammitkannim beshem atzilut beria yetzira asiyya. happeshat oro meir beolam haasiyya, remez beolam hayyetzira, derash beolam habberia, sod beolam haatzilut. uchevar hikdamnu peamim rabbot sheen lecha haderaga bikdushsha sheen gavhah asara, vahare lefanecha arbaim, velaze haya sham arbaim yom shelemim, veim haya chaser yom echad hayta tora chasera otah bechina, visharim darche Adonai. veod yesh teamim rabbim, uvaze en kushya lelohenu. veayyen befasuk "lech red" sheachar ze beofen acher.

rashi: Baavor kevodi. kesheeevor lefanecha:

Benikrat hatztzur. kemo haene haanashim hahem tenakker (Bamidbar 16), yikkeruha orve nachal (Mishlei 30), ani karti veshatiti mayim (Melachim 2 19, 24; yeshaya 37, 25), gizra achat lahem, nikrat hatztzur: keriyyat hatztzur:
Vesakkoti chappi. mikkan shennittena reshut lamchabbelim lechabbel, vetargumo "veagen bememri" kinnuy hu lederech kavod shel mala, sheeno tzarich lesochech alav bechaf mammash:
Reshit bikkure admatcha. mishshivat hamminin haamurim beshevach artzecha, eretz chitta useora vegefen vegomer (Devarim 8) – udevash hu devash temarim:
Lo tevashshel gedi. azhara levasar vechalav, veshalosh feamim katuv battora, echad laachila veechad lahanaa veechad leissur bishshul (chullin 115):
Gedi. kol valad rach bemashma, veaf egel vacheves; mimma shehutzrach lefaresh bechamma mekomot "gedi izzim" lamadta sheggedi setam kol yonkim bemashma (sham 113):
Bachalev immo. perat laof sheen lo chalav, sheen issuro min hattora ella middivre sofrim (sham):

Rokach mirkachat. rokach shem davar hu, vehattaam mochiach, shehu lemala, vahare hu kemo rekach, rega; veeno kemo roga hayyam (Yeshayahu nusach acher), uchemo roka haaretz (sham Melachim 2), shehattaam lematta; vechol davar hameorav bachavero ad shezze kofeach mizze o reach o taam karuy mirkachat:
Rokach mirkachat. rokach heasuy ay ammanut vetaarovot:
Maase rokach. shem haumman baddavar:
Gam belo daat nefesh lo tov. en tov laadam shehu belo tora:
Veatz beraglayim chote. hachote rofes vedash haavonot baakevav, veomer: kal hu ze, eevor alav. verabbotenu pershu (eruvin 100:): gam belo daat, bechofe et ishto letashmish hammitta beal karchah:
Veatz beraglayim chote. ze habboel veshone. davar acher: ze hamehallech al gabbe asavim beshabbat (shabbat 95.):
targum: Man dela yadia nafsheh la shappir leh udekalil beragloy levishta chatya hu:

rashi: Lachshov machashavot. arigat maase choshev:
Bereo. bahario, shehayu meriim usemechim vetzochakim:
ohc: Vayyishma yehoshua vegomer bereo vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hu kavvanat amro bereo, uma kol ze sheshshama, gam teshuvat moshe tzericha navi lehaggid mashmaut haddevarim.

Veyitbaaru hakketuvim al pi maamaram zichronam livracha (yerushalmi taanit 84 10) ki hatztzaddikim yavchinu bakkol im letzedek im lehofcho, vehassaga ze hu hassaga elohit asher hinchil Adonai ligdole olam, vehu ma sheheriach yehoshua sheamar hakkatuv vayyishma yehoshua et kol haam, perush havarat kol shehayta nishmaat min hammachane shel yisrael shama bo bechinat hara, vehu amro bereo, vayyomer el moshe kol milchama bammachane amar lo ki kol ze sheshshomea hu kol milchama, uvechina ze hu bechinat hara shehikkir bakkol, o ramaz beamro kol milchama al milchemet hatztzar shehu 131 hammatzuy tamid bemaarechet hammilchama im haadam. veheshiv moshe en kol anot gevura, perush shello nitgabberu al yitzram, veen kol anot chalusha, perush lo bechinat chulesha levad, ella kol annot ki shavar matte oz tifara, vehakkavvana shello hereu maasehem bifrat echad mipperate hattora sheyyachalish adam velo yigva, ella akru hakkol, sheshshekula avoda zara keneged kol hattora kullah (chullin 5,1).

Veulay sheramaz beamro samuch lannot tevat anochi al hashshechina besod (Devarim 32:18) "tzur yeladcha teshi", veze hu shiurah: "kol annot shel anochi shomea", vetevat shomea chozeret al yehoshua sheamar "kol milchama bammachane". amar lomar ki kol ze sheshshomea hu kol sheyyaggid shivron hashshechina, besod (Mishlei 10:1) "uven kesil tugat immo". achar shekkatavti ze matzati maamar hazzohar (Zohar chelek 2, 195.) veze leshono: mahu "bereo" vegomer, dehahu kala desitra ochora hu, vihoshua istakkal behahu kala dehu sitra deraa, miyyad "vayyomer el moshe", ad kan, vehu kechol hakkatuv lachayyim.

rashi: Bevoam el ohel moed. lehaketir shacharit uven haarbayim ketoret, o lehazzot middam par kohen hammashiach useire aza:
Velo yamutu. ha im lo yirchatzu yamutu, shebbattora neemru chelalot, umichlal lav atta shomea hen:
El hammizbeach. hachitzon, sheen kan biat ohel moed ella bechatzer:
Et edyam mehar chorev. et haadi shehaya veyadam mehar chorev:
Hattehora. al shem zahav tahor:
Lo yisach. bishne yodin, leshon lo yifal, kemo (Devarim 5 15) lemaan yitav lach:
Al besar adam lo yisach. min hashshemen hazze atzmo:

Uvematkunto lo taasu kamohu. bischum sammanav lo taasu acher kamohu bemishkal sammanin hallalu lefi middat hin shemen, aval im pachat o ribba sammanin lefi middat hin shemen muttar, veaf heasuy bematkunto shel ze, en hassach mimmennu chayyav ella harokcho:
Uvematkunto. leshon cheshbon, kemo (Shemot 5 8) matkonet hallevenim, vechen bematkuntah shel ketoret:
ohc: Kodesh hu. perush techunato, vaafillu yaasehu mechullin, vehaose bematkunto kemaale ola vechattat leatzmo, veim asao lehitlammed bo o al menat litteno latztzibbur muttar, ken amru bichretot (5.).

Od nire amro kodesh hu kodesh yihye al ze hadderech: "kodesh hu" – ze shemen sheasa moshe shekkedushshato yetera, shehassach mimmennu chayyav karet, uchemo sheamar besamuch "vaasher yitten mimmennu", veamru bichretot (6,1) "mimmennu" – perush mishshemen sheasa moshe velo mishshemen hammishcha zulato. veamro kodesh yihye lachem – ze shemen dorot sheeno shave likdushshato shel shemen moshe, veen chayyav ella harokeach kamohu. vetevat "mimmennu" levad lo taspik, shezzulatah hayiti omer ad sheyyimshechennu kullo.

Verazal (keritut 6,1) darshu mippasuk ze shetztzarich laasotah bimkom kodesh. uledivrehem haya lo lomar ken bemitzvato, lo beazharat "lo taasu kamohu". vedivrehem zichronam livracha enam ella asmachta lahalachot shebbeyadam, udevarenu hem peshat hakkatuv.

rashi: Mi laAdonai elay. yavo elay:
Kol bene levi. mikkan shekkol hashshevet kasher (yoma 66):

Gam et haddavar hazze. shello tishre shechinati od al ummot haolam eese, veen devarav shel bilam al yede sheriyyat hashshechina, ella "nofel ugeluy enayim" kegon veelay davar yegunnav (Iyov 4) – shomin ay shaliach:
ohc: Ki matzata chen vegomer. umoshe hikdim lomar yedaticha veshem veachar kach amar vegam matzata chen, kan hodio hakkatuv ki maalat hodaa beshem hu elyona mibbechinat hassagat hachen, ki halo noach matza chen beene Adonai (Bereshit 6:8) velo yedao beshem. laze amar bitchilla matzata chen beenay velo zo bilvad ella vaedaacha beshem.

Od nitkavven lomar lo ki ma shehodio bashshem gam ken haya letzad ma shemmatza chen beenav, laze hikdim lomar matzata chen beenay veachar kach vaedaacha beshem, lomar shezze yatza mizze, ma sheen ken nishma middivre moshe shehikdim "yedaticha veshem" kodem metziut chen, shezze yaggid shehissig haddavar letzad ma shezzacha.

rashi: Vayyinnafash. ketargumo venach, vechol leshon nofesh hiv leshon nefesh, shemmeshiv nafsho uneshimato beharegio mittorach hammelacha; umi shekkatuv bo lo yiaf velo yiga (yeshaya 40), vechol poolo vemaamar, hichtiv menucha beatzmo? lesabber haozen ma shehi yechola lishmoa:
Vaomar lahem. davar echad – "lemi zahav" levad – vehem miharu vehitparku vayyittenu li:
Vaashlichehu vaesh. velo yadati sheyyetze haegel hazze, veyatza:
Besamim rosh. chashuvim:
Vekinnemon besem. lefi shehakkinnamon kelippat etz hu, yesh shehu tov veyesh bo reach tov vetaam, veyesh sheeno ella keetz, lechach hutzrach lomar kinneman besem – min hattov:

Machatzito chamishshim umatayim. machatzit havaato tehe chamishshim umatayim, nimtza chullo chamesh meot, kemo shiur mar deror, im ken lamma neemar bo chatzain, gezerat hakkatuv hi lahavio lachatzain, leharebot bo 2 hacheraot, sheen shoklin ayin beayin; vechach shenuya vecharetot:
Ukene besem. kane shel bosem; lefi sheyyesh kanim sheenan shel bosem hutzrach lomar kene vosem:
Chamishshim umatayim. sach mishkal kullo:
ohc: Veatta kach lecha. peshat hakkatuv hu sheyyikkach hu mishshello shemen hammishcha, laze amar veatta perush, ki mitzva zo atta taasenna veeno kishar mitzvot sheani metzavvecha lenocheach vechavvanati shehazzulat yaase. vahagam shekkalal hakkatuv hashshemen vehassammanim benidvat rabbim, dichtiv (Shemot 25:3) "vezot hatteruma vegomer besamim leshemen hammishcha" vegomer, kan gilla lo Adonai ki yachpotz beshel moshe bifratim ellu.

Od yitbaer al pi ma detanya bichretot (keritut 5,1) shemen sheasa moshe bo shalku vechulei, bo nimshechu kohanim shivat yamim vechulei, vechullo kayyam leatid, ad kan. ha lamadta shello naasa shemen hammishcha zulato. vechen katav rambam beferek 1 mehilchot kele hammikdash shemmeolam lo naasa shemen acher zulat ma sheasa moshe, vehu amro veatta kach lecha – atta taase velo zulatcha. veramaz beamro kach lecha al pi divrehem sheamru (yalkut shemauni 764) sheatid moshe laamod lesharet leatid lavo. vahagam shebbefarashat hakketoret neemar (Shemot 30:34) "kach lecha", sham lo neemar "veatta".

Vekinneman besem machatzito. razal amru (keritut 5,1) machatzit havaato, nimtzeta omer shetztzarich lehavi chamesh meot, vehikshu baggemara vedilma kinneman besem matayim vachamishshim kikne vosem, umetaretz im ken lichtov kera "kinneman besem ukene vosem mechetza umechetza matayim vachamishshim", ad kan.

Veefshar lanu letaretz od, sheim ken lo haya tzarich lomar "machatzito", ki ani yodea shemmatayim vachamishshim hem machatzit hachamesh meot, aval i amrinan machatzito shel kinneman ba lomar sheshshoklim oto shete peamim.

Uma sheraiti lerabbi avraham ibben ezra shekkatav sheen minhag hayyishmeeli lehosif afillu kegargir chardal bammishkal, en ze emet, sheal kol panim tzarich hakkarat hahachraa, veaf bemishkele hazzahav hagam shemmitchakkemin lishkol beiyyun kaf keneged chavertah belo hacheraa, af al pi chen kesheyyitztaref shene mishkalim yukkar hahechrea beyoter. vetaam shehashshas lo bachar letaretz kidvarenu, ki yesh lomar leolam matayim vachamishshim levad hu omer, veamro machatzito sheyyavi mea esrim vechamesh levad umea esrim vechamesh levad.

rashi: Ivvelet adam tesallef darko. baavono ba lo hara, ki beivvalto tesallef darko veavar averot venifrain mimmennu, uvevo lo hatztzara zoef libbo al hakkadosh baruch hu umemaher achar middat haddin, kegon ache yosef sheamru "ma zot asa elohim lanu" (Bereshit 42:28):
targum: Shatyuta devar nasha metaltela archateh veal elaha mitreem libbeh:

rashi: Vahasiroti et kappi. veaade yat divrat yekari – kesheasallek hanehagat kevodi minneged panecha, lalechet mishsham ulehallan:
Veraita et achoray. herahu kesher shel tefillin (berachot 7):
ohc: Veraita et achoray vegomer. hinne beel elyon lo yityaches elav panim veachor, ella kavvanato yitbarach hu letzad ki chayyut haolamot omed becheshek histakkelut oro yitbarach vekiyyumo hu haadon chay haolamim, vedavar ze hu min hannimna sheyyachol shum nivra lehabbit el oro yitbarach, laze hechin Adonai veasa masve asher derech sham yabbit, vehu shekkara achorayim, kemo sheasa bechachmato et haadam hagguf achorayim vehannefesh panim lo, veharuach panim lannefesh, vehanneshama panim laruach, kemo chen hechin or mimmennu yitbarach asher derech sham yashkifu veyechezu et haelohim velo kara achorayim, veor elyon shehu mushlal mehassagat nefesh kol chay yikkare panim, vehu amro veraita et achoray ufanay lo yerau.
Veefshar sheramaz lo beamro samuch laachoray tevat ufanay, lomar ki gam sham hem panim, ella shehechin Adonai achorayim kede sheyyihyu bammussag lanneviim kemo shekkatavnu.

Veulay sheddikdek beamro achoray lomar sheen harebe pargodim umesachim mafsikim kaasher hem beerech hanneviim asher nochach Adonai yabbitu, ella echad davka, vehu amro achoray velo achore achoray, vehammaskil al devar emet yikkod veyishtachave lael haggadol vimaet beenav kol avodato asher yaavod kefi shiur hammussag hamekuvve lenefesh chayya leminah.

rashi: Vegerashti et hakkenaani vegomer. 6 ummot hem vehaggirgashi amad ufana mippenehem meelav (talmud yerushalmi sheviit 6):
ohc: Veshalachti lefanecha malach. mikkan muchach ki ad atta hinne daat kadosh maskemet lichnisat moshe laaretz ulehanchilah leyisrael, vahagam sheamar (Shemot 6:1) "atta tire", shehare hu omer "ale" vegomer veshalachti lefanecha malach legaresh hashsheva ummot. veulay ki bishvil shennatan nafsho al yisrael bemaase haegel nitbattel gezerat "atta tire" vegomer:

rashi: Kol zechurecha. kol hazzecharim shebbecha; harebe mitzvot battora neemru venichpelu – veyesh mehem shalosh peamim vearba – lechayyev velaanosh al minyan lavin shebbahem veal minyan ase shebbahem:
Bikkure ketzir chittim. sheatta mevi vo shete hallechem min hachittim:
Bikkure. shehi mincha rishona habbaa min hechadash shel chittim lammikdash, ki minchat haomer habbaa vappesach, min hasseorim hi (menachot 84):
Vechag haasif. bizman sheatta osef tevuatcha min hassade labbayit; asifa zo leshon hachenasa labbayit, kemo vaasafto el toch betecha (Devarim 22):
Tekufat hashshana. shehi vachazarat hashshana – bitchillat hashshana habbaa:
Tekufat. leshon mesibba vehakkafa:
Veet ketoret hassammim lakkodesh. letzorech haketarat hahechol shehu kodesh:
ohc: Lakkodesh. perush, lefi shekkol hammaasim harshumim bapparasha lo neesar maasehem lahedyot, zulat shene devarim ellu shehem shemen hammishcha uketoret hassammim, laze dikdek lomar bahem lakkodesh, lomar otam shettechunat maasehem meyuchadim lakkodesh, vehakkedushsha chala al matkonet haddavar letzad techunato levad, ma sheen ken bechol hammaasim shebbaolam shekkol shello kara alav kodesh eno kodesh.

rashi: Kiyyor. kemin dud gedola velah daddim hammerikim befihem mayim:
Vechanno. ketargumo besise, moshav metukkan lakkiyyor:
Lerochtza. musav al hakkiyyor:

Uven hammizbeach. mizbach haola, shekkatuv bo shehu lifne petach mishkan ohel moed, vehaya hakkiyyor mashuch kima, veomed keneged avir shebben hammizbeach vehammishkan, veeno mafsik kelal bentayim, mishshum shenneemar veet mizbach haola sam petach mishkan ohel moed (Shemot 40), – kelomar mizbeach lifne ohel moed veen kiyyor lifne ohel moed, ha chetzad? mashuch kima kelappe haddarom; kach shenuya vizvachim:
ohc: Venatatta shamma mayim. nire sheen chiyyuv laasot haddavar al yede moshe, ella hu haddin zar yachol latet mayim bakkiyyor, ucheshem sheamar bitchillat happasuk "veasita kiyyor" vegomer sheen hakkavvana sheyyaase hu.

rashi: Shabbat shabbaton. menuchat margoa velo menuchat arai:
Kodesh laAdonai. shemirat kedushshatah lishmi uvemitzvati:
ohc: Sheshet yamim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach letzauot od laze. od lamma amar yease velo amar taase keseder sheddibber bo peamim rabbot. od lamma shinna kan lehazekiro beshem yom hashshevii vead atta lo hizkiro ella beshem shabbat, veod roani sheggamar omer lehazekiro beshinnuy hashshem kol haose melacha beyom hashshabbat. gam lo haya tzarich lomar ella "ki kol haose vo".

Veulay sheramaz hakkatuv kan ma sheamru bemassechet shabbat (shabbat 69,1): tanu rabbanan, haya mehallech badderech o vammidbar veeno yodea ematay shabbat, mone shishsha yamim umeshammer yom echad, veheemiduha bashshas shebbechol yom ose parnasat oto yom vaafillu beshabbat, vehikshu im ken bamme minkar? vetertzu bekiddusha veavdalta, vechatvu hattosafot shello yehallech beyom shabbat, vetaam shello amar beshas minkar bahalicha mishshum sheen ze hekker beshabbat, i nammi sheafillu beyom shemmeshammer holech.

Vehinne lederech harishon yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: sheshet yamim vegomer, hakkatuv medabber bemi shehaya bammidbar o bayyam veeno yodea ma yom miyyamim, veamar sheshet yamim yease vegomer, perush yease bahem hetter melacha laasot davar hammuchrach shehu parnasat oto yom, velaze lo amar tease ella yease, perush yachol hu laasot lechayyot nefesh, uvayyom hashshevii perush lecheshbono, shabbat shabbaton perush eno kefi haemet shabbat ella leinyan shabbaton kaamur bemitzvat hashshemita, dichtiv (Vayikra 25:4) "shabbat shabbaton yihye laaretz", shello yaase melacha baaretz, gam bayyom hashshevii lecheshbono yaase bo shevita shello tihye bo halicha, veamro kodesh laAdonai shetztzarich lekaddesho bekiddush vehavedala keillu hu yom shabbat.

Ulederech sheppershu sheen hefresh ben yom hashshevii lishar sheshet yamim ella leinyan kiddush vehavedala, yitbaer al ze hadderech shabbat shabbaton leinyan kodesh laAdonai, perush lekaddesho vegomer, veamro kol haose melacha beyom hashshabbat mot yumat dikdek lomar beyom hashshabbat lishlol yom hashshevii shebbo medabber hakkatuv shehu shevii lecheshbon yom zichrono, sheim avar al ma shetztzarich lehizzaher bo eno chayyav, hagam sheyyaase bo melacha sheenah tzericha hare ze patur, hagam shemmekaddesho bechezkat yom shabbat.

targum: Unefalat eshta min kodam Adonai vaachalat yat alata veyat aaya veyat avnaya veyat afra veyat maya demivzikata lechechat:
Vesader yat aaya vahadem yat tora veshave al aaya:
Vetikrun beshum taavatchon vela titanun min kodam delet beh tzeroch beram ana atzale vishma dayya vishalach memreh vichot eshta are Adonai hu elohim vaatev kol ama vaamaru takin pitgama:
Uselek achav lemechal ulemishte veeliyahu selik leresh tura decharmela unechin leara veshave appohi ben birchohi:
Vahava kemebar tihara veishtatiu ad lemisak minchata velet kal velet deane velet dematzit:
Ukeriv eliyahu levat kol ama vaamar ad ematay attun peligin litren palgevan hala Adonai elohim felachu kodamohi bilchodohi ulema attun taan batar baala delet beh tzeroch vela ativu ama yateh pitgam:
Vahava bezimna shevieta vaamar ha anana selik zeera kefisat yad gevar salek mimarva vaamar sak emar leachav izdaraz vechut vela yeakkevinach matra:
Tav miskena dimhalech bitmimuta min hu dimakman archateh vehu sachel:
Vahava ad demizdaraz venachit ushemaya itchappiu anana verucha vahava metar sagi urechiv achav vaazal leyizreel:
Kane libba tava rachem nafsheh nater beyuna mashkach tavta:
Vaazalu maya sechor sechor lemadbecha veaf yat mezekata mele maya:
Unesivu yat tora dihav lehon vaavadu ukero beshum baala mitzafra vead idan tihara lememar baala anena velet kal velet daane veishtatu al egora daavad:
Vaamar eliyahu linviye vaala vecharu lechon tora chad vaavidu kodameta are attun sagiin ukero beshum taavatchon veeshta la teshavun:
Vaamar eliyahu leama ana ishtaarit neviya kodam Adonai bilchodi uneviye vaala arba mea vechamshin gavra:

Kabbel tzeloti Adonai beeshta kabbel tzeloti Adonai bemitra veyedun ama haden bemebedach lehon nisa are at Adonai elohim veat birchemtach yathon mishteel lehon bememrach laatavutehon lidchaltach veinun yehavu yat libbehon pelig:
Sahada deshikra la nizdecha udemavi chadvuta nevad:
Vaamar eliyahu lehon achudu yat neviye vaala gevar al yishtezev minhon veachdunun vaachatinun eliyahu lenachla dekishon venachsinun taman:
Shema etzta vekabbel marduta metul detitchakkam besofach:
Sagian machshevata belibbeh degavra veetzata delaha hi tekum:
Vaamar melu arba kadin maya vaariku al alata veal aaya vaamar teno uteno vaamar talitu utelitu:
Ukero bekal rav veitchamamu kenimusehon besayfin uveromchin ad deishtafich dema alehon:

Vahava bemisak minchata ukeriv eliyahu neviya vaamar Adonai elaheh deavraham yitzchak veyisrael yoma den yityeda are at Adonai dishchintach sharya veyisrael vaana avdach uvefitgamach avadit yat kol pitgamaya hailen:
Vahava beidan tihara vechayach behon eliyahu vaamar kero vekal rav are attun amrin dachala hu dilma shui leh o ishtedafa ishtedif o orach havat leh o dilma demuch hu veyitar:
Uvena yat avnaya madbecha bishma dayya vaavad mezikata kevet satan zara sechor sechor lemadbecha:
Vachazo chol ama unefalu al appehon vaamaru Adonai hu elohim Adonai hu elohim:
Vaamar eliyahu lechol ama itkerivu levati ukerivu chol ama levateh uvena yat madbecha dayya dahava mefagar:
Veyityahavun lana teren torin veyivcharun lehon tora chad vihadmuneh vishavun al aaya veeshta la yeshavun vaana aber yat tora chad veetten al aaya veeshta la ashave:
Ushelach achav bechol bene yisrael uchenash yat neviye shikra letur karmela:
Vaamar eliyahu leachav sak echol ushete are kal itregushat mitra:
Beta umazala viruteta hu daavahan umin elaha mitmasra itteta legavra:
Vaamar leulemeh sak kean sechi leorach maarava uselik usecha vaamar let midaam vaamar tuv sheva zimnin:
Sahada deshikra la nizdeche udemave chadvuta la nitmelet:
Unesiv eliyahu tarta asre avnaya leminyan shivte vene yaakov di hava fitgama dayya imeh lememar yisrael yehe shemach:

bart: Shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel nachri patur. dichtiv (Chavakuk 3) amad vaymoded eretz raa vayyatter goyim, raa sheva mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach, kevan shello kiyyemu otan, amad vehittir mamonan leyisrael. veomer (Devarim 33) hofia mehar paran, gilla mamonan shel ovde kochavim vehittiran. mehar paran, mishshaa shessibbev vehechzir et hattora al haovde kochavim velo kibbeluha:
Tefilla. bitfillin shel rosh shennagu vemet ayre, sheyyesh bahen arbaa vattim, vechol bayit nikret ketzitza:
Hittir ketzitza. heevir bayit echad vehevi acher tachtav:
Temea teme met. dechibburan meshavve lehu guf echad:

Vechen sheniyya vechen shelishit. kol zeman sheharviit kayyemet, mechamat shemmechubberet larviit. aval kesheheevir gam harviit vehechlifah beacheret, parcha minnayhu tumat met, venishtayyer bashshalosh ketzitzot tumat magga teme met, shehare nagu varviit keshechibberan vehi adayin kayyemet. aval reviit keshehuchlefa, en begufah tuma chelal, dei mishshum denaga vashshalosh, en magga ose magga, shehashshalosh rishonot chadashot ninhu shennagu vitme met, veen harviit hachadasha mekabbelet mehen tuma, veen tuma varviit hachadasha ella mechamat shemmechubberet lashshalosh hattemeot magga. hilkach keshechazar vehechlif hashshalosh paam sheniyya, taharu chullan vaafillu magga let behu:
Shor shennagach arbaa vachamishsha. uvechullam haya tam demishtallem miggufo:

Yeshallem. chatzi nezek laacharon techilla. baggemara moke lematnitin kegon shettefaso nizzak lashshor hammazzik ligbot mimmennu venaasa alav shomer sachar. uchesheyyatza mittachat yado vehizzik, hannizzak harishon chayyav binzakav, lefichach haacharon mishtallem chatzi nizko mashlam:

Veim yesh bo motar yachazir leshellefanav. hachi kaamar, im yesh bo motar binzakav, yachazir leshellefanav. kegon shechatzi nizko shel harishon haya mane, vachatzi nezek haacharon haya chamishshim, vehashshor shave matayim. mittechilla keshennagach shor ze shoro shel hannizzak harishon shechatzi nizko mane, haya lannizzak beshor ze mane, velabbealim mane. ucheshettefaso hannizzak venagach tachat yado, en labbealim lehafesid mane shehaya lahem bo, shehare lo hayta shemirato alehen ella al hannizzak shettefaso. ucheshehizzik lashsheni vehaya chatzi nizko chamishshim, ibbed hannizzak harishon min hammane shello chamishshim venoten laze hannizzak hashsheni, vehammotar ad hammane chozer lo. vehabbealim notlim hammane shellahem:
Rabbi shimon omer vechulei. rabbi shimon savar shuttefe ninhu habbealim vehannizzak bashshor hammazzik, ushenehem mitchayyevim binzakav. ketzad, shor shave matayim shennagach vechulei:
Veshellefanav. zehu nizzak rishon. notel chamishshim zuz, vehabbealim chamishshim zuz. deyesh lenizzak rishon bo hachetzi, hilkach meshallem chatzi tashlume nizko:

Chazar venagach shor shave matayim. haacharon notel mane hachetzi mikkol ma shehu, demiggufo mishtallem. venimtza oto shellefanav shehaya hachetzi shello, meshallem mechelko chatzi mane shennotel haacharon:
Ushenayim harishonim. nizzak rishon vehabbealim shehaya lahem lechol echad revia, meshallemin kol echad reviit shel nizko:
Dinar zahav. shehem esrim vachamishsha dinarim shel kesef:
Harishon chayyav benizke sheni. uchegon shehaya yachol laamod velo amad, defoshea hu. aval lo haya yachol laamod, patur, deha kayma lan nitkal lav poshea hu:

Yesh bema shennivra vayyom harishon tuma. hachi kaamar, yesh devarim shennivreu veyom rishon shehaose cheli mehem yesh bahem tuma, kegon haaretz shennivret beyom rishon, uchele cheres hannaasim mimmenna temeim:
Bashsheni en bo tuma. shebbo nivra rakia veen bo tuma:
Bashshelishi. nivreu ilanot, uchele etz hannaasim mehem mekabbelim tuma:
Barvii. nitlu hammeorot, veen bahem tuma:
Bachamishi. ofot vedagim, veim asa mehen kelim en mekabbelim tuma:
Chutz mikkenaf haoz. kenaf haazniyya. derabbanan gazru tuma vechelim hannaasim mimmenna, deate leachlufe vishar kelim:

Uvetzat hannaamit hametzuppa. bat hayyaana metargeminan naamita. verabbanan gazru tuma vevetzatah keshehi metzuppa, kevan divlo tzippuy nammi omedet. aval bishar betzim, afillu vimtzuppa lo gazru, kevan divenah metzuppa lo kayma chelal:
Kol shennivra vayyom hashshishshi tame. chayyot uvehemot usheratzim veadam. im asa chelim meatzmotehen o meorotehen, mekabbelim tuma:
Mi shehayu ferotav rechokim mimmennu. uchevar nitkenu vehiggia zeman habbiur:
Tzarich likrot lahem shem. lezakkot otan labbealim, kehach uvda derabban gamliel uzekenim:
Issur sheani atid lamod. maaser rishon sheani atid litten mipperot sheyyesh li babbayit:

Natun lihoshua. levi haya. uteruma gedola lo natan atta mishshum ditruma mafrishin otah baggoren, [kidtanya] shei efshar laggoren shetteaker ella im ken nitrema teruma gedola, uchevar hifrish otah baggoren:
Umekomo muskar lo. umekom hammaaser muskar lo, veyikne hammaaser aggav karka:
Issur acher. maasar ani:
Natun laakiva ven yosef. gabbay shel aniyyim haya:
Issur sheani atid lamod. maaser min hammaaser, sheani tzarich litten lakkohen min hammaaser shennatan li rabban gamliel:
Natun leelazar ben azarya. kohen haya, vehu asiri leezra:

Venitkabbelu sachar ze mizze. rabban gamliel kibbel sechar mekomo shel maaser rishon merabbi yehoshua, usechar mekomo shel maasar ani merabbi akiva. verabbi yehoshua kibbel sechar mekom maaser min hammaaser merabbi elazar ben azarya, venikna lechol echad mekom hammaaser harauy lo bakkesef shennatan lammaskir, shessechirut karka niknet bechesef:

Erev yom tov harishon shel pesach vechulei. dichtiv (Devarim 14) mikketze shalosh shanim totzi et kol masar tevuatcha, veneemar lehallan (sham lo) mikketz sheva shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot, ma lehallan regel af kan regel. i ma lehallan chag hassukkot af kan chag hassukkot, talmud lomar (sham 26) ki techalle leasser, regel shekkol maasrot kalin bo, heve omer ze pesach, sheen perot shel shana shelishit nigmarim lihyot nilkatim kullan ad sheyyavo fesach shel shana harviit, vechen shel shana shishshit ad sheyyavo fesach shel shana sheviit:
Teruma uterumat maaser labbealim. lakkohanim, shehatteruma shellahem:
Umaaser rishon livalav. lalleviyyim:
Umaasar ani livalav. laaniyyim:
Mitbaarim bechol makom. tzarich levaaram uleabbedam min haolam:

Habbikkurim nittanim lakkohanim katteruma. veen tzarich levaaram min haolam, mishshum ditruma [karinhu] rachamana, deamar mar uterumat yadecha ellu habbikkurim dichtiv behu (Devarim 26) velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hattavshil. sheyyesh bo mipperot sheviit o maaser sheni bishat habbiur:
Hare hu kimvoar. kevan deen mammashan nikkar:
Haya vaal kora rishon vechulei‏ patur. shezze mehallech kedarko veze miher lalechet:
Ketzad haregel muedet. kelomar, beeze davar haregel muedet. umeshane, leshabber bederech hilluchah. bechach hi muedet, shemmeshabberet kelim derech hilluchah:
Habbehema muedet. resha tana avot, regel mammash, sheddarsa beragleha. vesefa tana toladot, shebbehema muedet lehallech kedarkah uleshabber begufah uvisarah uvashshelif shealeha derech hilluchah:
Hayta mevaetet. shinnuy hu ze, vetolada dekeren, hilkach chatzi nezek vetu lo:

O shehayu tzerorot menattezin. af al gav delav shinnuy hu ella orcheh hu, af al pi chen chatzi nezek vetu lo, dehilchata gemira la. uvirshut hannizzak kaamar, devirshut harabbim patur, ditzrorot tolada deregel ninhu lefatram birshut harabbim:
Venafal al keli acher. rishon nizke regel hen umeshallemet nezek shalem. vehaacharon al yede tzerorot nishbar, hilkach chatzi nezek:
Delil kashur beraglo. kol davar hannikshar beregel hattarnegolet karuy delil. veit degarse deli:
Mehaddes. merakked. veit dimfarshe chofer beraglav baaretz, kederech hattarnegolim:
Meshallem chatzi nezek. didlil hayenu tzerorot, divoto delil addeyinhu latztzerorot al hakkelim. vehiddus nammi kegon shehittiz veotan tzerorot shavru hakkelim:

Lo achalti veoni. kol yom hammita haveya aninut deorayta, vaafillu leachar kevura. velayla shelleachar yom hammita haveya aninut derabbanan, vechen yom kevura sheeno yom hammita haveya aninut derabbanan:

Lo lakachti mimmennu aron vetachrichin lemet. uchehay gavna afillu lechay asur, shehare asur liknot malbush vechayyotze vaze mimmaaser sheni, keditnan leel sof perek kamma kol shehu chutz laachila ushetiyya vesicha im lakach yochal kenegdo. velo nakat hacha aron vetachrichim ella leashmuinan delo mibbaya im sach mimmennu lemet sheeno yachol lehitvaddot, dichtiv mimmennu, miggufo shel maaser, ella afillu kana aron vetachrichim, delo natan miggufo shel maaser al met, eno yachol lehitvaddot:
Kabbetza sheamru. gabbe tumat ochalim, sheen metammein befachot mikkabbetza:
Noten letoch hammayim. memalle chos mayim, venoten letocho gedola shebbaggedolot uketanna shebbakketannot, vecholek hammayim hayyotzin lishne chalakim, vehachelek haechad hu shiur betza:
Vechi mi modieni. kelomar keshellokeach gedola shebbaggedolot shemma yesh yoter gedola hemenna. vechen ketanna shebbakketannot shemma yesh yoter ketanna mimmenna:
Hakkol lefi dato shel roe. lefi omed dato shehi benonit lemare enav. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Hammanniach et hakkad vechulei‏ ushevarah patur. lefi sheen derech bene adam lehitbonen badderachim:
Veim huzzak bah baal hechavit chayyav. vaafillu hifkirah, shekkol hammafkir nezakav shello haya lo reshut mittechilla laasotan, keillu lo hifkiran:
O shellaka vacharaseha chayyav. desavar nitkal poshea hu velav ones hu, ulechach chayyav:

Bemitkavven chayyav. im nitkavven lizkot bacharaseha uvammayim achar shennishbera chaddo, chayyav behezzekan, dahave leh boro shehizzik. veim lo nitkavven lizkot bahen, hoil veikkaro anus hu, desavar nitkal lav poshea hu, hare hacharasim vehammayim hefker leachar shenneenas, ulefichach patur. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda denitkal lav poshea hu. umeachar deanus hu velo nitkavven lizkot bacharasim uvammayim, have keillu lo hayu meolam shello ufatur al nizkehem:
Kol shechavti vishmirato vechulei. kol davar shennitchayyavti leshamro:

Hichsharti et nizko. im lo shemartiv karauy vehizzik, ani hu shehichsharti vezimmanti oto hezzek, vaani chayyav alav. kegon hammoser shoro lecheresh shote vekatan, chayyav, shealav haya muttal shemirat shoro vahare lo shemaro karauy lo:

Hichsharti vemiktzat nizko vechulei. veim tikkanti vezimmanti miktzat hannezek, af al pi shello zimmanti vetikkanti et kullo, nitchayyavti alav keillu zimmantiv kullo. kegon hachofer bor tisha birshut harabbim uva acher vehishlimo laasara, venafal shamma shor o chamor vamet, haacharon chayyav, af al pi shello tikken ella miktzat hannezek, keillu asa kol hannezek, kevan divtisha lekka mita:

Nechasim sheen bahem meila. veal eze nechasim ani chayyav leshallem im hizzakti, al nechasim sheen bahem meila, kegon nechasim sheenan hekdesh. sheim hizzakti nechasim shel hekdesh eni chayyav leshallem, dichtiv shor reehu velo shor shel hekdesh. vehu haddin lechol shear nezakim:
Nechasim shehem shel bene verit. sheim hizzik nechasim shel nachri, patur:
Nechasim hameyuchadim. sheyyesh lahem bealim meyuchadim, sheim hizzik nechasim shel hefker, patur:

Chutz mershut hameyuchedet lammazzik. bechol makom shehizziku nechasav et nichse chavero, chayyav hammazzik, chutz mershut hameyuchedet lammazzik. sheim nichnas shor nizzak birshut hammazzik vehizziko shor hammazzik, patur, deamar leh torcha birshuti may bae. vedavka keshehizziku nechasav, aval hammazzik atzmo shechaval bachavero, af al pi shehu omed birshuto, chayyav, deamar leh hannechbal nehi deit lach reshuta leappoke, leazzoke let lach reshuta:

Ureshut hannizzak vehammazzik. ureshut hameyuchedet lannizzak velammazzik, kegon chatzer shel shenehem, vehizzik shoro shel echad mehem beotah chatzer beshen varegel, patur. vehu shettihye otah chatzer meyuchedet lishvarim gam ken. aval im hayta meyuchedet leferot velo lishvarim, vehizzik beshen varegel, chayyav. veim hizzik bekeren, bechol inyan chayyav:
Leavdo uleshifchato haivrim. sheen gufan kanuy:
Ufede lach. bahen maaser sheni leatzmecha:
Mippene sheyyadan keyado. dema shekkana eved kana rabbo. uveno katan nammi zechiyyato leaviv, dimtziat katan leaviv:
Hamevakkea. etzim:
Vehizzik birshut hayyachid. shel acherim:
Birshut hayyachid. shello:
Vehizzik birshut hayyachid acher. shel acherim:
Chayyav. veaf al gav devirshuteh kaaved velo shechiche rabbim sham denema hava leh leayyone, afillu hachi chayyav:
Mikkan amru. middichtiv veet haadama asher natatta lanu:
Yesh lahem are migrash. vicholim lehitvaddot al hammaasrot shemmeviin mimmigrash hearim shellahen. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Veshel cheresh shote vekatan shennagach shor shel pikkeach patur. sheen maamidin appotroppos letam ligbot miggufo, demittaltele hu, veamrinan beferek kamma [daf yad] shave kesef melammed sheen bet din nizkakim ella linchasim sheyyesh lahen acharayut, veokimna beyatme:

Maamidin lahen appotroppos vechulei. im huchzeku naggechanim, maamidin lahem appotroppos, velo leshallem chatzi nezek ella leshavveye muad, dechi hadar nagach meshallem min haaliyya veyigbu hannezek mikkarka shel yetomim:
Chazar letammuto. dekasavar muad sheyyatza mershut bealav venichnas lirshut bealim acherim chozer letammuto. dirshut meshunna meshanna et din hateraato:
Shor haitztadin. shemmeyuchad lingichot, umelammedin oto lechach:
En lo chomesh. en habbealim tzerichin lehosif chomesh kesheppodim oto:

Veen lo viur. beshana shelishit veshishshit [nosach acher: reviit usheviit] shehammaasrot mitbaarin, dechomesh uviur lo neemru becherem revai ella vemaaser. umihu modu vet shammay defidyon miha it leh, veaf al gav delo neemar pidyon bammikra becherem revai, deyalfe leh middichtiv (Vayikra 19) kodesh hillulim, kare veh chillulim, achleh vehadar achleh:
Uvet hillel omrim yesh lo. deyalfe kodesh kodesh mimmaaser, litten lo kol din maaser:

Yesh lo feret veyesh lo ollot. desavre mamon bealim hu velo mamon gavoah, hilkach chayyav beferet uveollot kechol kerem dealma. vehaaniyyim shemmelakketim happeret veollot mikkerem revai, podin leatzman veochlin happidyon birushalayim:
Uvet hillel omrim kullo laggat. desavre mamon gavoah hu kemo maaser, hilkach en lo feret veollot, ella dorchim oto kullo keachat, umaale veochel birushalayim, o fodehu umaale haddamim lirushalayim:
Ketzad hashshen muedet. beeze davar hi muedet. umeshane, leechol et harauy lah:
Meshallem chatzi nezek. dimshunne hu:

Bamme devarim amurim vechulei. aachla perot o yerakot kae, devirshut harabbim patur devainan uvier bisde acher. aval achla kesut vechelim afillu birshut harabbim chayyav chatzi nezek, deavde inshe demanche kesut vechelim birshut harabbim lefi shaa, vehave keren birshut harabbim vechayyav:

Meshallem ma shennehenet. lav tashlumin mealleyata, ella im achla davar sheddamav yekarim roim oto keillu hen seorim, veeno meshallem ella deme seorim bezol, shehu shelish pachot mimma shehem nimkarim bashshuk. veim achla davar sheddamav pechutim min hasseorim, meshallem deme oto davar sheachla bezol. veim achla davar shehizzik lah, kegon sheachla chittim, hoil velo nehenet, patur:
Mitztzidde harchava meshallem ma shehizzika. im halcha veamda betzidde harechava bemakom sheen derech shevarim lalechet sham, lav kirshut harabbim dame, umeshallemet ma shehizzika:
Bemidda dakka. shel midbar keruya midda dakka. lefi sheyyesh midbarit yerushalmit vetzipporit, umidbarit ketanna shebbechullan:
Middot hallach. hin vachatzi hin:
Vehayyavesh. issaron vachatzi issaron:
Baitalki. bemidda shel italia shel yavan. vezo hi midbarit shehayta vime moshe:
Kefi ma shehu adam. ben katan uven gadol:
Kometz hammincha. dichtiv (Vayikra 2) vekamatz mimmennu melo kumtzo:
Vechofne ketoret. shel yom hakkippurim, dichtiv (sham 16) umelo chafnav ketoret sammim dakka:
Kimlo lugmav. im shata melo lugmav beyom hakkippurim, chayyav. ulefi lugmav shel shote meshaarinan:
Kimzon shete seuddot laeruv. eruve techumin eno befachot mimmezon shete seudot:
Mezono lechol. kemazon lishte seudot shel chol sheochel meat, velo chimzon shete seudot shel shabbat deachel tefe, mishshum divsim tavshileh, veravcha livsume shechiach:
Lashshabbat aval lo lachol. deadderabba, shete seudot shel shabbat pechutim mishshete seudot shel chol, kevan divshabbat saed shalosh seudot, eno marbe leechol bechol seuda:
Veellu vaellu mitkavvenim lehakel. kol echad mehen mitkavven lemaet bakkikkar shel eruv:
Mishshete yadot lechikkar mishshalosh lekav. day laeruv bishte yadot shel kikkar shel shalosh kikkarot lakkav, nimtza chikkar shalem shelishit hakkav, ushete yedoteha have kikkar shel eruv:

Mikkikkar befundeyon. kikkar hallakuach befundeyon min hannachtom keshennimkarim arba seim besela. vearba seim hen esrim vearbaa kabbin shekkol sea hi shishsha kabbin, vehassela hi arbaa dinarim, vehaddinar shesh main, nimtza hassela esrim vearba main, venimtza esrim vearbaa kabbin leesrim vearbaa main kav lechol maa, vehammaa shene fundeyonim, hare hakkikkar hannimkar befundeyon hu chatzi kav. aval mippene shehachenvani rotze lehistakker, vitziat haafiyya vehattechina, lo yihye hakkikkar hannimkar befundeyon keshennimkarim arba sein besela ella rova kav, veharova haacher holech bischar hachenvani vitziat haafiyya vehattechina. hare kikkar hallakuach befundeyon hu rova hakkav, dehaynu shesh betzim, vehu shiur shete seuddot, vehayenu chikkar shel eruv. vechen halacha:
Chamishsha tammin. sheenam regilim lehazzik, veim hizziku meshallemin chatzi nezek:
Vachamishsha muadin. shehem regilin lehazzik, umeshallemin nezek shalem:
Lo liggach. bekeren:
Velo liggof. dechifat kol hagguf. vechullehu havu tolada dekeren umeshallemin chatzi nezek. hare chamishsha tammin:
Veshor hammuad. shalosh peamim liggach o liggof o lirbotz o livot o lishshoch. hare hen chamishsha muadim leshallem nezek shalem. ulegabbe muad chashev lehu chad:

Veshor hammazzik birshut hannizzak. afillu keren tamma, have muad leshallem nezek shalem. umatnitin atya keman deamar meshunna keren bachatzar hannizzak shemmeshallemet nezek shalem vaafillu hi tamma. veen ken halacha:
Vehaadam. have muad mittechillato nammi, umeshallem nezek shalem im hizzik:
Hazzeev vehaari vechulei. muadim mittechillatan. veha delo chashev lehu bichlal chamishsha muadim dilel velihavu achad asar muadim, mishshum dehane lo shechiche beyishshuv:
Bardelas. chayya shekkorin lah baaravi 193:
Rabbi eliezer omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Min haaliyya. meiddit shebbinchasav. vaafillu en hannogeach shave shiur hannezek. divmuad ketiv (Shemot 21) yeshallem shor tachat hashshor, velo ketiv beh demigguf hannogeach yifra:
Kaggerogeret sheamru. lehotzaat shabbat, uleshittufe mevoot. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Arbaa avot nezikin. mishshum deikka lechol chad minnayhu toladot, kare lehu avot:

Hashshor. hu haregel, dehaynu ma shehabbehema mazzeket beragleha derech hilluchah, kedichtiv (Shemot 22) veshillach et beiro. vetanya veshillach ze haregel vechen hu omer (yeshaya lev) meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor. vetolada deregel hi keshehizzika begufah derech hilluchah, o bisarah derech hilluchah shennidbeku kelim bisarah ugerartan ushevartan. o bashshelif shealeha, vehu masseoy shebbaamtachot uvammartzufin shealeha. o bazzog shebbetzavvarah:

Vehabbor. happoteach bor birshut harabbim venafal shamma shor o chamor vamet im habbor amok asara tefachim, o huzzak im hu pachot measara tefachim, dichtiv (Shemot 21) ki yiftach ish bor vegomer. vetolada devor, kegon kicho venio leachar shennachu birshut harabbim, vehizziku:

Vehammave. ze hashshen, sheachla behemto bisde chavero, kedichtiv (sham 22) uvier bisde acher. venikra hashshen mave mippene shehu peamim mechusse peamim megulle, milleshon nivu matzpunav (Ovadya 1) dimtargeminan iggalyan matmerohi. vetolada deshen hi, keshennitchakkecha bakkotel lahanaatah kederech habbehemot shemmitchakkechot veshavra et hakkotel, o tinnefa perot keshennitchakkecha bahen lahanaatah:

Vehahever. zo haddeleka sheyyatza vehizzika, kedichtiv (Shemot 22) ki tetze esh vegomer‏ veneechal gadish o hakkama o hassade. vetolada deesh, avno vesakkino umassao shehinnichan berosh gaggo venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku, dumeya deesh sheharuach molicha. veha delo chashev tanna didan keren bichlal avot nezikin, mishshum delo mayre ella binzikin shehem muadim mittechillatan, kelomar shemmeshallemin nezek shalem mittechillatan, aval betammin veachar kach muadim lo ka mayre:

Lo hare hashshor kahare hammave. kelomar, i katav rachmana shor lo nafek mave minneh, dahava amena regel dehezzekah matzuy chayyeveh rachmana, shen deen hezzekah matzuy lo chayyeveh rachmana. vei katav rachmana shen, hava amena shen deyesh hanaa lehezzekah chayyav, regel deen hanaa lehezzekah eno chayyav. vei katav rachmana shen varegel velo katav esh, hava amena shen varegel sheyyesh bahen ruach chayyim, kelomar shebbaim mikkoach baale chayyim, chayyav, aval esh sheen bah ruach chayyim lo lichayyav. veim nichtevu shelashtan velo katav rachmana bor, hava amena hane lichayyevu sheddarkan lelech ulehazzik, aval bor sheen darko lelech ulehazzik lo lichayyav aleh. mishshum hachi itzterichu kullehu. uvaggemara massik dei katav bor vechad mehanach atu kullehu shear, levad mikkeren, behatztzad hashshave shebbahen sheddarkan lehazzik. velo hutzrechu kullan ella mippene shehen chalukim behilchotehen, sheyyesh baze ma sheen baze. shen varegel peturim birshut harabbim, ma sheen ken bevor vaesh. bor patar beh kera adam vechelim dichtiv (Shemot 21) venafal shamma shor o chamor, dedarshinan shor velo adam, chamor velo kelim, ma sheen ken bishar avot nezikim. esh patar bo et hattamun, sheim hayu begadim temunim baggadish patur hammavir, dichtiv (sham 22) o hakkama, ma kama begaluy af kol begaluy. uvishar avot nezikim lo patar et hattamun:
Hatztzad hashshave shebbahen vechulei. af ani avi kol sheddarko lehazzik ushemirato alecha, sheim hizzik nitchayyev hammazzik leshallem tashlume hannezek shehizzik:

Bemetav haaretz. meiddit shebbinchasav, min hammeshubbach shebbahem, im ba litten lo karka betashlume nizko, dichtiv (sham) metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem. aval im ba litten lo mittaltelin, kayma lan kol mille metav hu, dei lo mizdevan hacha mizdevan bemata achariti, veyahev leh kol may devae vaafillu subbin. vehane mille linzakin. aval levaal chov, i it leh zuze mechayyevinan leh lemittan zuze, vei let leh zuze yahev leh mittaltele may devae, vei magbe leh ara yahev leh bevenonit. vesachir, afillu let leh zuze lammaskir lo matze yahev leh beagreh ella zuze, umechayyevinan leh lezabbone minnichseh ad demashkach zuze veyahev leh:
Af al pi shemmekabbelim. kelomar af al pi shello nikkevu vintilat haraglayim veyesh lahen bet kibbul kevattechilla:
Tehorin. shekkevan shennittal achat min raglehen shuv enan chashuvin keli, lefi sheenan mekabbelin kedarkan ella notin letzad echad vechishvurim damu:

Rabbi yose metamme. kevan shello nikkevu vintilat achat meraglehen. veen halacha kerabbi yose. verambam gares, vesheenan mekabbelim kedarkan rabbi yose metamme. umilleta veanpe nafsha hi, vehachi kaamar, shidda teva umigdal sheenan mekabbelin arbaim sea keshehen yoshvin kedarkan veim mattin otan mekabbelin arbaim sea, rabbi yose metamme kevan sheen mekabbelim kedarkan, vachachamim omrim hoil umekabbelim mikkol makom, chashive machzikim arbaim sea utehorin:
Venaklite hammitta. shene ammudim echad meraashote hammitta veechad bemargeloteha, umesimin makkel mizze laze umashlichin alav sadin venaase ohel:
Vachamor. tachat malben hammitta mesimin etz chalul shehammalben munnach alav venikra chamor:
Vechippuy. kegon tzippuy shemmetzappim hammitta venakliteha:
Tehorim. dahave mattechet hameshammesh leetz:
Malben. luchot chalulim asuyim lehanniach tachat kare hammitta shello yerakvu millachluchit hakkarka. umittaltelim im hammitta, hilkach temeim, dechammitta damu:

Umalbene vene levi tehorin. lefi shergilin laalot lirushalayim veholchim meir leir, veen molichin hammittot immahen umolichin hammalbenim, hilkach afillu kevuim bekarkee hammitta hoil vesofan linnatel lav kammitta chashive:
Mucheni. ofan keen ofanne haagala. ulefi shehashshidda nisset aleha keruya mucheni. leshon et hakkiyyor veet kanno (Shemot 30):
Bizman shehi nishmetet. sheadam yachol lesallekah min haagala:

Enah chibbur lah. vehi chashuva keli leatzmah. vei shidda bat kibbule tuma sheenah machzeket arbaim sea venitmet hashshidda, lo nitmet hammucheni, vei lav bat kibbule tuma hi venaga tuma vammucheni, hammucheni temea, dela chashiva min hashshidda, vehi mittaltelet melea verekanit veyesh lah bet kibbul:
Veenah nimdedet immah. becheshbon amma al amma berum shalosh ammot. dela chashiva choovi haraglayim, vaafillu lerabbi yose enah nimdedet immah:

Veenah matztzelet immah beohel hammet. sheim hashshidda bevet hakkevarot matztzelet al kelim shebbetochah, kevan demachzeket arbaim sea. veim boltim mimmenna kelim keneged [gova] hammucheni millemala, en hammucheni matztzelet aleha, demucheni mekabbelet tuma veenah chotzetzet bifne hattuma:
Bizman shebbetochah maot. dichli bifne atzmah hi, uvasis ledavar haasur. aval im enah nishmetet share, meachar delo havu vetoch hashshidda shehi ikkar hakkeli:
Kimron. keen kubba sheosin al gabbe hashshidda:
Nimdad immah. lehashelim arbaim sea:
Ketzad moddim oto. keshehu kavua:

Rosh tor. baalachson. dehay kimron eno cheneged kol hashshidda ella chippa cheneged miktzat chalalah, ucheshebba limdod avirah roin keillu chut natun baalachson mikkotel hashshidda ad rosh hakkippa, vechalal shettachtav nimdad:
Im enah yechola laamod bifne atzmah. hashshidda velo hakkimron hakkavua bah:
Tehora. af al pi sheenah machzeket arbaim sea. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Beyom tov haacharon hayu mitvaddin. velo hayu mitvaddin beyom tov rishon miyyad achar habbiur, kede sheyyihye lo ma yochal baregel. hilkach erev yom tov rishon haya mevaer umeshayyer ad yom acharon:
Ze maaser sheni veneta revai. shennikreu kodesh:
Ze masar levi. kelomar maaser rishon:
Vegam netattiv zo teruma gedola. vegam, tosefet hu, mashma vegam netattiv lallevi, chutz mimma shennatatti lakkohen:
Min habbayit zo challa. shehi nitrema min haissa betoch habbayit:
Hu chullin. sheen derech bene adam lehakedish charasin levedek habbayit, veal shem ma shebbetocho nichtav:
Hu karban. kelomar hekdesh:
Chullin letoch karban. vehakkol karban. velo ifligu rabbanan aleh derabbi yehuda ella veshel mattechet bilvad, divshel cheres modu shehu chullin uma shebbetocho karban. vahalacha kachachamim:

Shum kesef. shum ze shel nezakim lo yehe ella bechesef. sheyyehu bet din shamin kamma shave hannezek vechach yeshallem lo. veim hizzika parato shel reuven tallito shel shimon sheddarsa alav birshut hannizzak ushevarattu, veachar kach era shennishbera raglah shel para zo shel reuven betallito shel shimon birshut harabbim dahave nammi bor birshut harabbim, en omrim hoil veze hizzik veze hizzik yatza hezzeko shel ze behezzeko shel ze, ella shamin shene hannezakim bedamim, umi shehizzik lachavero yoter, yeshallem:

Veshave chesef. ucheshebbaim leshallem hahezzek minnichse hayetomim, lo yifreu ella min hakkarkaot shehem shave kesef, velo mimmittaltelin shehem atzmam kesef. dechol mide demittaltel chashuv keillu hu kesef, dei lo mizdevan hacha mizdevan bemata achariti:
Bifne bet din. vehashshuma vehattashlumin shel nezakim lo yihyu ella bifne bet din mumchin, velo bifne bet din shel hedyotot:
Veal pi edim bene chorin uvene verit. laafoke avadim venachrim sheenam kesherim leedut shel nezakin:
Vehannashim bichlal hannezek. ben shehizzika hi et acherim, ben sheacherim hizzikuha, din haish vedin haishsha shavin binzakin:

Vehannizzak vehammazzik battashlumin. peamim shehannizzak shayyach im hammazzik battashlumin shel nizzak. kegon im pachata hannevela mishsheat mita ad sheat haamada baddin, sheppechat nevela denizzak hu, ben betam ben bemuad, venimtza sheen hammazzik meshallem lo afillu oto chatzi nezek shezzikketa lo tora im hu tam, o nezek shalem im hu muad, hare shehannizzak hu mafsid veshayyach betashlumin hallalu im hammazzik:
Vetikkenah temea midras. adayin omedet betumatah, kevan dekayma sheniyya:

Tehora min hammidras. af al gav denittakkena rishona kodem shennishbera sheniyya, mikkol makom tehora, defanim chadashot bau lechan, shelleachar sheyyarda lah tumat midras nitchaddeshu lah panim hallalu veen zo harishona, meachar shekkevar nitkalkel bah kede vittulah:

Aval temea magga midras. mishshum daarukka rishona cheshennishbera vetikkenah shehevi arukka acheret tachat hashshevura vechibberah lammitta, nitmet magga midras, shehare naga vammitta hattemea midras, vechi nishbera sheniyya defarach minna tumat midras, ishtayyar bah tumat magga, dechol hammitta mechubberet larishona shennittakkena:
Ad shennishbera sheniyya tehora. dechevan denishberu shete haarukkot, tu lo chazya. velo dame lehecha denitparka vechullah kayyemet, dehatam sofo lehachazir perakeha ulechabberah:
Happigyon. sakkin sheyyesh lo shete fiyyot:
Tik michchol. tik hakkeli shebbo kochalin haayin:
Uvet hakkechol. hakkeli sheshshomrim bo et hakkechol:
Machtev. kulmos shel nechoshet uvarzel:
Terunetek. teren tik. vehu cheli echad uvo tikin harebe chalukim, lakkulmos velassakkin velammisparayim. verofe hachabburot mishtammeshim bichli ze harebe. uvelaaz 377:
Pagoshot. chitztzim rechavim. umechi kavallo [yechezkel 26], metargeminan umechat pagoshohi:
Simponya. keli zemer shel mattechet:
Mitztziddo tahor. shekkol shemmachniso min hatztzad eno chashuv nartik, ella michse vealma:
Haalla. shevet shel barzel uverosho iggul kemo chaddur, veyotzim bo yetedot sheddomot lishkedim, baaravi korin lo 72, uvelaaz 132:
Heasuy lechippuy. lemichse. targum michse, chofaa:
Tahor. detanya, yachol sheani merabbe chippuy chelim letuma, talmud lomar (Vayikra 11) asher yease melacha vahem, perat lechippuy kelim:
Kera. shel mitta shehayta temea midras. sheddaras hazzav al hakkera keshehaya bifne atzmo shello haya mechubbar lammitta:
Kullah temea midras. dechibbur avid lah keillu chullah guf echad:
Hayta temea tumat shiva. kegon shennaga vemet:
Tumat arev. kegon shennaga vitme met:
Vehammitta tehora. delo nitmet bingiat hakkera. derishon hava, veen adam vechelim mekabbelin tuma ella meav hattuma:

Mader. keli etz sheyyesh lo shinnayim umehappechim bo et hatteven, veshinnav shel mattechet. ulefi shehashshinnayim shel perakim uneutzim bo, dino chedin mitta shehi shel perakim. vehay vechen, attumat shiva kae, deen mader mittamme midras:

Echad ratz veechad mehallech vechulei. matnitin chasure michassera vehachi katane, echad ratz veechad mehallech bearve shabbatot veyamim tovim, o shehayu shenehem ratzim bishar yemot hashshana, shenehem peturim. divarve shabbatot veyamim tovim mi sheratz ratz birshut, sheholech lidvar mitzva lehachin letzarche shabbat veyom tov, umishshum hachi patur. uvishar yemot hashshana kesheshshenehem ratzim, hoil ushenehem meshannim, shenehem peturim:
Mitta shehayta temea midras. sheshshachav aleha zav, o nitla o nishan:
Ketzara. otan etzim shebberochav hammitta letzad meraashoteha o margeloteha:
Arukka. otan etzim shebbeorech hammitta miyyamin o missemol, vehem nikraim arukkot hammitta:
Tehora. detu lo chazya vehaveya cheshivre chelim shehen tehorim:
Rabbi nechemya metamme. veen halacha kerabbi nechemya:
Gadad. chatach vekata. kemo godu ilana:

Shete leshonot lochsan. shene etzim haasuyin kelashon, shemmalbene hammitta munnachim alehen. chatachan baalachson, echad shebbemiktzoa mizrachit deromit veechad shebbemiktzoa maaravit tzefonit, tehora, detu lo chazya. vechen im gadad shete cheraayim tefach al tefach lochsan, mikkera shebbemiktzoa mizrachit deromit gadad tefach, umikkera shebbemiktzoa maaravit tzefonit gadad tefach, kishvura damya:
O shemmiatah mittefach. sheggadad ragleha veen tefach min hammitta laaretz, la chashiva:
Kol haammot hayu venoniyyot. beamma bat shishsha:
Chutz mimmizbach hazzahav. shehaya amma al amma:
Vehakkeren. shel mizbach hannechoshet. shehayu lo al arba pinnotav arba avanim shel amma gova, veamma al amma ovi. veotah amma hayta beamma bat chamishsha:
Vehassovev vehayesod. shel mizbach hannechoshet. uveferek 3‏ demassechet middot hen meforashim:
Ammat binyan. kegon chomat habbayit umizbach haola:
Ammat kelim. kegon aron veshulchan umizbach hazzahav. vahalacha kerabbi meir:
Maharu vetakkenu et perotechem. terumot umaasrot latet otan larauy lahen, umaaser sheni lehaaloto uleachlo virushalayim:
Shello higgiu leonat hammaasrot. kol peri uferi kemo shemmeforash onato beferek kamma demaasrot:
Peturim min habbiur. uvarishona hayu omrim dekodem onat hammaasrot nammi zakuk levaer. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Kerem revai metzayyenin oto. bonim etzlo tziyyun vesiman, sheyyakkiru shehu kerem revai vetaun pidyon:
Bekozzot. gavshushit verigve adama. simana kaadama, ma adama deikka hanaa minnah shehi osa ferot, af hay nammi ki mifreke share leithanoye minneh:
Veshel arla becharsit. baadama sheosim mimmennu kele cheres. simana kecharsit zo delet bah hanaa dichshezzorim bah enah motzia chede nefila, af zo en bah hanaa:
Veshel kevarot. shello yikkanes sham kohen venazir:
Besid. simana shehassid lavan kaatzamot:
Umemache veshofech. memache et hassid bemayim kede sheyyitlabben yoter, veshofech al hakkever:
Bamme devarim amurim. deavde hekkera lecherem revai velaarla:
Bashsheviit. shehakkol hefker venotlim behetter. aval bishar shene shavua shebbaim ligzol, haleitehu larasha veyamut veyikkechum leechol beissur:
Vehatztzenuim. hamedakdekim al atzmam, keshehaya lahem kerem revai bashsheviit hayu mannichin hammaot kodem lekita, veomrim kol hannilkat lichsheyyihye nilkat yehe mechullal al ze:
Bazzeman hazze. sheen bet hammikdash kayyam:
Tzarich lechallelan al hakkesef. dichtiv (sham 14) vetzarta hakkesef beyadecha, hakkesef bilvad maalin:
Echad shehen kesef veechad shehen perot. teunim geniza, uma moil hachillul:
Melo tarvad rakav. melo chaf afrurit min hammet achar shekkala kol lachut shebbo:
Melo tarvad gadol shel rofim. shehu gadol mishshear tarvadim. veshiuro melo chafnayim:

Kaggeris hakkilki. kachatzi fol habba mimmakom sheshshemo kilki, vehappolim shebbo gedolim mishshear polim. veshiur mekom geris hakkilki, tesha adashot shalosh al shalosh merubbaot. umekom adasha, arba searot, nimtza mekom haggeris sheloshim veshesh searot:
Kotevet haggassa. gedola mishshear temarim. veshiurah meat pachot mikkabbetza:
Kamoha uchegarinatah. shetztzarich limoch chalalah:
Venodot yayin vashemen. shel or shennikkevu, shiur hannekev shellahen:
Kefika gedola. shemmesimim bappelech keshehannashim toot bo:
Umaor. kemin challon shemmimmennu haora nichneset labbayit:

Shello naasa vide adam. kegon chor shecherruhu mayim o sheratzim, o shennafal heafar meelav venaasa sham nekev. veim lo chashav alav letashmish o lemaor, shiuro lehavi et hattuma meohel hammet labbayit lederech hannekev:
Keegrofo shel ben batiach. dehaynu adam yadua etzlam, uven batiach shemo, shehaya egrofo gadol:
Veshennaasa vide adam. sheasao adam lehachenis et haora:
Neronit. matbea shel neron kesar:

Kimlo nekev shebbaol. melo makdeach shel lishka. ufundeyon haitalki vesela hanneronit umelo nekev shebbaol, kullan shiur echad lahen. veyesh mekomot shehayu yodim beechad mehen velo veacher, hilkach teninhu lechullehu:
Harimmonim sheamru. ha ditnan beresh pirkin kol kele vaale vattim shiuran berimmonim, kesheyyihyu shelosha rimmonim achuzim ze vaze veyetze haechad derech hannekev, zehu shiur shel motzi rimmon:
Kede sheyyittol vihallech. shemmittoch ninua shel netila vehilluch memaher harimmon latzet derech hannekev:
Uvekuppa chede sheyyafshil laachorav. shemmittoch hafeshala laachorav hu memaher latzet:
Sheenan yecholim lekabbel rimmonim. shehen ketannim:
Kegon harova. rova hakkav:
Shiuran berubban. kevan denifchat rubbo, tahor:
Nifretzu. nifchatu vechasru:
Nigmemu. besiftotehen:
Shiuran bema shehen. im nishar bahen kede lekabbel kol shehu, temein. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Mippene shehen muadin. likpotz. uvirshut hannizzak kaamar, detolada deregel hi:
Charara. uga shenneefet al gabbe gechalim:
Al hacharara meshallem nezek shalem. dahave shen birshut hannizzak:
Veal haggadish meshallem chatzi nezek. dahave kemo tzerorot, dehilchata gemire la shemmeshallem chatzi nezek:
Shoro shebbiyyesh patur. dichtiv ish baamito, velo shor baamito. i nammi, en hamevayyesh chayyav ella keshemmevayyesh bechavvana, veshor lav mechavven levayyesh hu:
Shoro shessimme et en avdo patur. veen haeved yotze ben chorin al yado:
Vehu shessimme et en avdo chayyav. shenneemar (Shemot 21) lachafshi yeshallechennu:
Shoro shechaval beaviv uveimmo chayyav. betashlume nezek:
Vehu shechaval beaviv uveimmo patur. min hattashlumin. sheen adam met umeshallem:
Shoro shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat chayyav. chatzi nezek. dimshunne hu:
Shiuran bechikkarot shel pat. shiur sheviratan, bemotzi chikkarot shel pat:
Efifyarot. keli arug mikkanim o zemorot:
Sheasa lah kanim millematta lemala. shennifchatu shulehen vehichnis kanim mimmatta lemala lehachezik hashshulayim:
Gappayim. sheggippefah saviv. targum vaychabbek, vegappef. perush acher, gappayim, sheasa lah aznayim:
Im enah yechola linnatel baggappayim. shekkesheochez baggappayim en hakkeli ole immo:
Lizvalim. sheyyerakvu hatteven vehakkash, venaasim zevel lezabbel sadot ucheramim:
Kol hakkodem bahen zacha. dekansinhu rabbanan:
Kol hamekalkelim birshut harabbim. vaafillu osim birshut, kegon bishat hotzaat zevalim. im hizziku chayyavim:
Hahofech et haggalal. tzoat bakar:
Hare ellu chullin. ma shemmatza have chullin, sheani omer maaser sheni nittal:
Haya sham mane. amar lo aviv hare sham mane shel maaser sheni umatza matayim, mane maaser umane chullin. velo amrinan hammane shel maaser nittal veellu acherim hen:
Matayim umatza mane. amar lo aviv hare sham matayim umatza mane, hammane shemmatza maaser:
Kol hammaot hannimtzaim. bechol makom, ben baregel ben bishar yemot hashshana. uvirushalayim bishar yemot hashshana chutz mimot haregel:
Hare ellu chullin. veen choshshin lahem shemma maot shel maaser sheni hem:

Afillu dinar zahav im hakkesef veim hammaot. sheen derech learvan yachad, veikka lememar hallalu maot shel maaser sheni, shergilin lechallel hammaaser al dinre zahav, vehannishar sheeno maggia ledinar zahav mechallelo al hakkesef, vehammotar al maot shel nechoshet, umearvin otan yachad, afillu hachi lo chayshinan:
Matza vetochan. betoch hakkis o hatztzeror shehammaot netunim betocho:
Podin maaser sheni. yachol lifdot im yirtze kashshaar hazzol, kedimfaresh veazel:
Kemot shehachenvani lokeach. shehu lokeach bezol kede lehistakker:
Lo chemot shehu mocher. shehu mocher beyoker beyoter mimma shekkana:

Kemot shehashshulchani foret. habba lechallel perutot shel maaser al sela, mechashshev hassela bifrutot harebe, kashshulchani hazze keshebba likkach perutot mibbene adam velatet lahem sela, shehu lokeach perutot harebe:
Velo chemot shehu metzaref. keshemmetzaref hashshulchani perutot latet livne adam bechilluf hassela, noten lahem pachot:
Achsara. belo midda uvelo mishkal, ella kamma atta noten bichri ze o vimlo chafnayim hallalu:
Al pi echad. beshumat lokeach echad:
Al pi shelosha. shammaim bekiin, vaafillu echad mehen oved kochavim, vaafillu echad mehen bealim:
Karam. hitchil lehachemitz, vegirsa acheret shekkasas. vedugmato bevava vatra [daf 93:] mekabbel alav eser kossot lemea:
Kol shebbayyam tahor. kol beriyyot shebbayyam im asa meoran kelim, en mekabbelin tuma, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) o veged o or o sak, ma beged min haggadel min haaretz, af or min haggadel min haaretz:

Chutz mikkelev hammayim. lefi shekkol shear beriyyot shebbayyam en echad mehem boreach layyabbasha keshebbaim latzud otam, ella chelev hayyam bilvad, hilkach have vichlal orot hayyabbasha, veim asa cheli meoro mekabbel tuma. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Afillu chut afillu meshicha. uvilvad sheyyechabberennu lo bederech sheim hayu shenehem min haggadel baaretz mechubbarim bechibbur kaze haya tame haechad keshennitma chavero:
Bammotar chatzi nezek. shamin ma hezzeko shel ze yoter al nizko shel ze, uveoto motar meshallem mi shehizzik yoter, et hachetzi:
Muad battam meshallem bammotar. kelomar im hu hizzik et hattam yoter mimma shehizziko tam:
Adam betam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem. deadam muad leolam:

Vetam beadam meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek. dichtiv (Shemot 21) o ben yiggach o bat yiggach kammishpat hazze yease lo, kemishpat shor beshor kach mishpat shor beadam, ma shor beshor tam meshallem chatzi nezek umuad meshallem nezek shalem, af shor beadam tam meshallem chatzi nezek umuad meshallem nezek shalem:

Rabbi akiva omer af tam shechaval beadam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem. dedaresh kammishpat hazze, ledina dislik hay kera minneh, divshor muad mayre. vehachi kaamar kera, kammishpat hazze shel shor muad shemmeshallem nezek shalem, yease lo lechol shor shennagach et haadam vaafillu hu shor tam. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:

Mashach mimmennu maaser besela. hammocher maaser sheni, kede sheyyitchallel al deme hammechira veyihyu hammaot nitpasim bikdushshat maaser, divchi hay gavna share lemachro. veha ditnan beferek kamma en mochrin oto, hayenu leholicho lirushalayim, velo sheyyihyu hammaot nitpasim bikdushshat maaser. ucheshemmashach hammaaser liknoto haya shave sela velo hispik litten haddamim ad sheamad bishtayim, shehammaaser lo yatza lechullin ad sheyyitten damav lammocher:

Noten lo sela. lefi shekkenao vimshicha, umarviach hallokeach sela shennityakker. vetzarich lifdoto kashshaar shel achshav bishte selaim, shehammaaser lo yatza lechullin ad sheyyitten damav lammocher. vehassela echad shel maaser sheni shello veochlo virushalayim:

Ad sheamad besela. vetzarich litten lammocher shene selaim, shekkenao vimshicha, vehu nifde besela echad kashshaar shel achshav. hilkach noten lo deme sela middeme chullin shello, uvo nifde hammaaser, vehassela hashsheni noten lo middeme maaser sheni shello. veen ze keforea chovo mimmaaser sheni, lefi shebbitchillat hammikkach haya omed lechach, sheyyochal hammocher shete selaim birushalayim im lo huzal:

Im haya am haaretz noten lo middamav. veim haya hammocher am haaretz noten lo shene hasselaim middeme hachullin shello, lefi sheen mosrin deme maaser leam haaretz. veit degarse middemay, im yesh lo deme maaser shel demay noten lo sela echad meotan damim, demosrin deme demay leam haaretz:

Bifkaiyyot shel sheti. matve hashsheti dak mishshel erev. kidmuchach bichtubbot beferek af al pi [daf sad]. ufekaiyyot shel sheti hen ketannim mippekaiyyot shel erev. uferush pekaiyyot, 335 belaaz. i nammi 120 belaaz:

Af al pi shemmekabbelet shel erev temea. hachi kaamar, veaf al pi sheenah mekabbelet shel sheti im mekabbelet shel erev temea, sheshshiurah bemotzi erev, shehu gadol mimmotzi sheti. vechen af al pi shemmekabbel et hattamchuyin tame, kelomar af al pi shehannekev gadol sheenah mekabbelet et hakkearot, im mekabbel et hattamchuyin shehen gedolim min hakkearot, adayin mikkere chazi letashmisho harishon vetame:
Af al pi shemmekabbel et hari. af al pi sheeno mekabbel et hammashkin, im mekabbel et hari tame. bet hari, kemo vet hari. keli shennifne vo veyesh bo tzoa ume raglayim:

Mippene sheen mekayyemin oto. garsinan. veit degarse, mippene shehen mekayyemin oto, veammilleta detanna kamma kae, deamar im mekabbel et haerev veet hattamchuyin veet hari tame, mippene shehen mekayyemin veshomrim oto, kevan dachazi lehachi. veen halacha kerabban gamliel:
Haose cheli kibbul mikkol makom. vaafillu lo asao rauy lekabbel ella mashshehu:
Mishkav umoshav mikkol makom. lishiva muetet. kegon shehaya nishan o nitle vo:
Meor hammatztza. delo maliach velo kamiach velo afitz:
Umin hanneyar. heasuy measavim:
Sheyyesh lahen maase. kevan shechakakum:
Veen lahem machashava. im chashvu lamod bahen afar kemot shehen chakukim mealehen velo asu vahen melacha, en machshavtan meviatan lide tuma:
Muad liktannim. laagalim:
Amru lifne rabbi yehuda. shaalu talmidav mimmennu:
Muad leshabbatot. mippene shehu batel mimmelacha vedato zacha alav. i nammi lefi sheroe bene adam bemalbushim naim shel shabbat, chashuvim beenav nachrim veeno makkiram:
Veeno muad lechol. ma dino:

Mishsheyyachazor bo shelosha yeme shabbatot. leachar shehuad leshabbatot heeviru lefanav shevarim beshalosh shabbatot velo nagach, chazar letammuto, veim chazar venagach eno meshallem ella chatzi nezek:
Mishsheyyachazor bo shelosha yamim. sheroe shevarim veeno nogeach, chozer letammuto:
Shalosh peamim. vaafillu beyom echad. veen halacha kerabbi [meir]. delo have muad ad sheyyaidu bo shelosha yamim:
Memashmeshim bo. moshchim oto umesachakim bo veeno nogeach. uveha halacha [kerabbi meir], sheen shor muad chozer letammuto ad sheyyehu tinokot mesachakim bo:
Haya omed baggoren. verotze lehaarim velifdot maaser sheni belo chomesh:
Veen beyado maot. kede sheyyittenem lachavero, sheyyifde bahen hammaaser belo chomesh:
Hare happerot haellu netunim lach bemattana. vedavka shennatan otam lo betivlan kodem sheyyafrish maaser sheni, kidfarshinan leel:
Mippene shehu mosif chomesh. kedichtiv (Vayikra 27) veim gaol yigal ish mimmaasro, al shello mosif chomesh velo al shel chavero:
Besela veissar. haissar hu echad mishshishsha vetishim besela:
Mippene shehu mosif al hakkeren. vetosefet kol shehu dekeren adifa, mippene sheal hachomesh yachol lehaarim keditnan lekamman:
Uven shennittan lo bemattana. hattevel, kodem shehifrishu mimmennu maaser nittan lo bemattana. deillu maaser sheni leachar shehufrash, kayma lan keman deamar mamon gavoah hu veeno nittan bemattana:

Hashshidda. nimdedet mibbifnim. ditnan leel (perek 15) kele etz shehammachazik arbaim sea velach shehen korayim beyavesh, tahor, vehayenu amma al amma verum shalosh ammot. vehacha kamiflege chetzad moddim, levet shammay moddin chalal shebbifnim, velo ovi haddefanot vehashshulayim. ulevet hillel hakkol moddin, chutz meovi haraglayim ulevazbezim shehu hazzer sheal hassafa. ulerabbi yose moddim af ovi ragle hashshidda vehallevazbezim. ulerabbi shimon im en ragleha gevohim tefach moddim af haavir shebben regel leregel. vahalacha kevet hillel allibba detanna kamma:

Tachtit hatztzorfim. tzorfe zahav vachesef yesh tachtehem keli sheshshemo tachtit, vehu asuy latet betocho gerutaot shel kesef veshel zahav. aval shel nappachim en asuy lekabbel velo meyuchad nammi lishiva:
Mashchezet. shel etz shemmashchizin bah et hassakkin. veosin lah bet kibbul shemen, shemmoshchin bah shemen lehashechiz:
Pinkas shel shaava. sheyyesh lachenvani velashshulchani shekkotev alav becheret:
Kash. zanvot hashshibbolim. veosim mehem machtzelaot:
Ushefoferet hakkash. shehu chalul veyesh lo bet kibbul:

Rabbi akiva metamme. veaf al pi shekkibbulo muat, deha tenan leel haose cheli kibbul mikkol makom tame. vekamiflege i have davar haomed i lo, deen tame ella davar haomed meelav. verabbi akiva chashiv leh davar haomed, verabbi yochanan ben nuri la chashiv leh davar haomed. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Pakkuot. delaat midbarit. veyesh omrim avattichim ketannim marim, vekane shellahen chalul kishfoferet shel kash:
Chelef. min esev hu veosim mimmennu chalafim umachtzelaot. vekorin lo vaaravi 123:
Tehora. mittumat sheretz. aval lo mimmishkav umoshav. shehi mittammea mishkav umoshav deorayta im enah asuya lesakkech:
Kane shechatacho lekabbala. latet bo kechol vechayyotze vo:
Hakkachay. hammoach hallavan shebbetoch hakkane. vekodem lachen en lakkane tuma vaafillu middivre sofrim:
Velo kara shem. lo amar ze fidyon maaser sheni:
Tzarich lefaresh. velomar ze fidyono. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Velo feresh. lo amar hare ze gittech o hare at mekuddeshet:
Rabbi yose omer dayyo. kevan sheasukim beoto inyan umittoch otan haddevarim amad vegeresh o kiddesh en tzarich lefaresh. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Hashshofech mayim birshut harabbim. af al gav devirshut kaaved, kegon bimot haggeshamim shemmuttar lishpoch mayim birshut harabbim, afillu hachi im huzzak bahen acher, chayyav benizko:

Hammatznia et hakkotz vechulei. uchegon shehitznian birshut harabbim. vechen haggoder gidro bekotzim vehifrichan lirshut harabbim. aval hametzamtzem betoch shello vehuzzak bahen acher, patur. sheen derech bene adam lehitchakkech bakketalim:
Kene hammoznayim. harammaim osin oto chalul umannichin bachalalo chesef chay, uchesheshshoklin mattin bakkane meat veholech hakkesef chay letzad haddavar hannishkal umachbid umachrio:

Vehammachok. shemmochakin bo hammidda cheshehi gedusha. veim osin otah shel delaat vechayyotze vah min haddevarim hakkallim, hu mekel, vera lammocher. veim osim oto mimmattechet, hu machbid, vera lallokeach. aval osim oto shel zayit veshel egoz veshel eshkeroa. veharammay ose hammachok shel zayit veshel egoz chalul, keshehu mocher machnis bo mattechet kede sheyyachbid, ucheshehu kone mesalleko:

Vehaesel. mot shennosim bo vakkatef. uchesheyyesh poalim merubbim, leachar shekkibbel sachar mesim bevet kibbul shebbammot et secharo, veomer levaal habbayit lo natatta li sechari, ucheshemmechappesim oto en notnim lev lechappes sham:

Kane shel ani sheyyesh bo vet kibbul mayim. veshote mehen, uchesheshshoalim oto im taam kelum, omer ani mitanne hayyom. verabbotay pershu, bet kibbul mayim, bet kibbul mashkin, ucheshettoreach etzel baal habbayit bevet habbad gonev bo min hashshemen:
Makkel sheyyesh bo vet kibbul mezuza umargalit. veosin ken kede lignov bo et hammeches:
Oy li im omar. shemma yilmedu mimmenni vene adam lerammot:

Veoy li im lo omar. shemma yomru harammain, en talmide chachamim bekiim bemaase yadenu, umittoch kach yavou lerammot yoter. velamma amaram, mishshum dichtiv (Hoshea 14) ki yesharim darche Adonai‏ tzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam:
Yochanan kohen gadol. shimmesh bichhunna gedola achar shimon hatztzaddik:

Heevir hodayot hammaaser. lefi sheezra kanas et halleviyyim shello yittenu lahem maaser, kesheala min haggola uvene levi lo alu immo, vetzivva sheyyittenu hammaaser lakkohanim. veyochanan kohen gadol bittel havvidduy, kevan sheeno yachol lomar vegam netattiv lallevi:
Bittel et hameorrim. shehayu halleviyyim omrim bechol yom al hadduchan ura lamma tishan Adonai. amar lahem vechi yesh shena lifne hammakom, amad uvittelan:

Et hannokfim. shehayu mesartin laegel shel karban ben karnav kede sheyyippol lo dam beenav kede shello yire veyihye noach lechafto uleshachato. veamad hu uvittelo, shennire chevaal mum, vehitkin lahem tabbaot bakkarka lehachenis tzavvar habbehema letochah. nokfim, makkin, vedugmato en adam nokef etzbao millematta [chullin daf 7]:

Haya fattish makke virushalayim. charashe nechoshet uvarzel hayu makkin befattish laasot melechet haaved shehi mutteret bammoed. veamad hu uvittelam, mishshum deavvesha milleta tuva veikka zilzul moed:

Uveyamav en adam tzarich lishol al haddemay. shehu amar livne doro keshem shetteruma gedola avon mita kach terumat maaser vetevel avon mita. vetikken sheyyotziu min haddemay terumat maaser umaaser sheni bilvad, velo yotziu mimmennu maaser rishon velo masar ani, sheyyecholim lomar lallevi o leani have reaya shehu tevel vettol. umittakkana zo veelach hallokeach perot min hashshuk lo haya shoel im hem metukkanim im lav, ella miyyad mafrish mehen terumat maaser umaaser sheni veochel et hashshear, shekkol hallokeach perot meam haaretz hem bechezkat demay:

Vechen halacha. vadday ken halacha demane noten lo dehaynu chatzi nezek. aval en ze shor haamur battora, dekiyyamta umachru et hashshor hachay vegomer. ufelugta derabbi meir verabbi yehuda hu bishvach nevela, kegon shebbishat mita lo hayta shava kelum, venityakkera achar kach vehi shava lehaachilah lakkelavim o lemachrah lannachri, rabbi meir savar shevach nevela denizzak have, velo shakel bah mazzik kelum ella noten lo chatzi nizko, vehayenu dekaamar rabbi meir al ze neemar umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo, kelomar shetztzarich litten lo deme chatzi nizko middeme shor hachay veeno menakke lo kelum baavur hashshevach shehishbicha hannevela. verabbi yehuda savar dachatzi shevach nevela demazzik have, ucheshebba mazzik leshallem lannizzak deme chatzi nizko, menakke lo chatzi shevach shehishbicha hannevela mishsheat mita ad sheat haamada baddin, vehayenu dekaamar rabbi yehuda lerabbi meir kiyyamta umachru et hashshor hachay velo kiyyamta vegam et hammet yechetzun, shetztzarich lachalok hashshevach shehishbiach hammet, veshakal leh mazzik palga. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Kazzayit sheamru. kegon kazzayit min hammet umin hannevela shemmetamme, verov shiurim shebbattora vechazzayit:
Egori. sheshshamno agur betocho:
Kasseora sheamru. etzem kasseora:
