Kaadasha sheamru. sheretz metamme vechaadasha, umichya vechaadasha:
Meviin tuma. al adam hannosan:

Boovi hammardea. dehaynu malmad habbakar. veavyo etzba ushelish etzba beguddal, shehem shete etzbaot biktannot. shehattefach arba etzbaot beguddal, shehem shesh etzbaot ketannot. venimtza hekkefo tefach. shekkol sheyyesh berachbo tefach yesh behekefo shelosha tefachim. vegazru al sheyyesh behekefo tefach, attu al sheyyesh beavyo tefach shehu mevi et hattuma min hattora:
Manniach et hassal al pi shelosha. bekiin beshuma, distam neta revai en damav yeduim lefi shetztzarich lechashshev hayetziot keditnan hacha:
Lifdot besela. kelomar likkach besela bamchubbar lakkarka:
Al menat lehotzi yetziot mibbeto. sechar peullat hakkerem mishshaa shennikra peri, kegon sechar shemira veiddur:
Umanniach et hammaot. lefi hashshuma, leachar sheshshamu kach vechach sallim besela:
Kuf karban. hekdesh:
4‏ Demay. lakuach meam haaretz:
Bishat hassakkana. sheggazru shello lekayyem hammitzvot:
Shemot bene adam hen. otiyyot shel rashe shemot, kuf kehat, 4‏ daniyyel, 9‏ tovya. vehakkol chullin:
Eshtakad hayta melea ferot teruma ufinnah. verabbanan savre im ita definnah latteruma migrar hava garer la velo haya manniach shem teruma katuv sham. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Nagach nagaf vechulei. kullan toldot keren hen:

Dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon. keren birshut hannizzak sheatta mevi middin keren birshut harabbim, dekaamart keren shehechmir aleha birshut harabbim eno din shennachmir aleha birshut hannizzak, dayyo lihyot keniddon, kekeren birshut harabbim, velo yihye chayyav birshut hannizzak ella chatzi nezek kemo shehu chayyav birshut harabbim:
Ani lo adun keren mikkeren. kidamran leel, ella keren meregel. mekom shehechmir alav beshen varegel eno din shennachmir bekeren:

Dayyo labba min haddin. desof sof i lav keren birshut harabbim lo mashkachat tzad kal vachomer. verabbi tarfon af al gav divalma it leh dayyo, demiddeorayta hu, dichtiv (Bamidbar 12) halo tikkalem shivat yamim, kal vachomer lashshechina arbaa asar yom, ella dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, hilkach tissager shivat yamim vetu lo, mikkol makom hacha let leh dayyo, disvira leh lerabbi tarfon dechi amrinan dayyo hecha delo mifrich kal vachomer, kegon hatam deshivat yamim dishchina lo ketive, ata kal vachomer ayte arbesar, ata dayyo appek shiva, veoke shiva, ishtachach deahane kal vachomer lehane shiva deokimna velo ipperich legamre. aval hacha chatzi nezek ketiv ben birshut harabbim ben bachatzar hannizzak, vaata kal vachomer veayyeti chatzi nezek acharina venaasa nezek shalem, i darshat dayyo vetokmeh achatzi nezek kidmeikkara, ifrich leh kal vachomer velo ahane velo mide. verabbanan savre daafillu hecha demifrich kal vachomer amrinan dayyo. vahalacha kachachamim:
Haamma sheamru. leinyan shabbat veeruvin vesukka umiddot vechilayim:
Beamma benonit. hi amma bat shishsha tefachim. deikka amma bat chamishsha [ketanna mimmenna], veikka amma gedola bat shishsha veetzba, veamma bat shishsha hi habbenonit:
Shete ammot. shete middot shebbahen moddim haammot, vechol achat mehen amma:
Beshushan habbira. cheder echad banuy al shaar mizrachi shel azara, vealav shushan habbira metzuyyeret, kede shettehe alehem emat malchut:
Al shel moshe. al amma bat shishsha tefachim:

Shehaummanin notlim bakketanna. shehaya haggizbar matne im haummanim, kach vechach ammot binyan taasu levedek habbayit meammot shel moshe, bechach vechach damim, umachzirim lo vemiddat haamma hayetera aleha etzba, kede sheyyosifu mishshellahem al tenaam, pen yifchatu venimtzeu vain lide meila shennehenu min hahekdesh. velamma shetayim, chada lechaspa vedahava, shekkeshemmatnim im tzorfe zahav vachesef laasot tavla bat arba vechamesh ammot baamma shel moshe, machazirim lammidda hayetera aleha chatzi etzba, lo lammidda hayetera aleha etzba, lefi sheummanut yekara hi veen mafsidin otan kol kach:

Kerem revai. yesh lo din maaser sheni, vetzarich lehaalot happerot lirushalayim uleachlan sham, hem o fidyonam, vetikkenu chachamim shemmahalach yom [echad] kol sevivot yerushalayim yaalu happerot [atzmam] lirushalayim, kede leatter shuke yerushalayim beferot, mittoch sheyyochal kol adam neta revai shello yitmalle hashshuk shear perot:
Sheyyehe nifde samuch lachoma. afillu kerem hassamuch lachoma:
Sheematay sheyyirtzu. im yitmaatu happerot:

Mishshecharav bet hammikdash haya hattenay. lo lefi sherabbu happerot kedaamart, ella mishshecharav bet hammikdash vehayta yerushalayim beyad haoyvim velo hayu choshshin leatter shuke yerushalayim beferot:
Malben shennetano al leshonot. etz heasuy keen lashon shehammalben munnach alav:
Rabbi meir verabbi yehuda metammein. sheaf hu mittaltel im hammitta kemo malben:
Rabbi yose verabbi shimon metaharin. delo mittaltel bahade mitta chulle hay. vahalacha kerabbi yose verabbi shimon:
Shemmalbene vene levi tehorin. veaf al gav dikvie vechare hammitta, hoil vesofan linnatel tehorim, hane leshonot nammi feamim nittalim mimmalbene hammitta velav kammitta chashive:

Muad meshallem kofer. veaf al gav divkamma denagach katlinan leh, ashkechinan muad, kegon sheharag shelosha nachrim. i nammi, sheharag shelosha yisrael terefa, deatterefa lo katlinan leh, degavra ketila katel. i nammi, dekatel vaarak leagma leachar sheheidu bo:
Vechen beven vechen bevat. tinok vetinoket, chayyav alehen sekila vechofer kigdolim:
Hammanniach issar. lihyot mechallel alav perot maaser sheni. uchevar chillel:

Veachal alav ad chetzyo vehalach lemakom acher. veholich haissar immo, vesham hu shave fundeyon, uvattechilla lo haya yotze ella bachatzi fundeyon, shehappundeyon shene issarin, nimtza lefi ma shehu yotze achshav shennishar bo issar shel chullin, ulefichach ochel alav od issar:
Ochel alav od pelag. chatzi issar, velo amrinan kevan sheeno shave ella issar hare achalo chullo:

Hammanniach issar shel maaser sheni. lihyot ochel alav chullin shello bikdushshat maaser, veachal alav ad achad asar beissar, veechad mimmea beissar, yatza kol haissar lechullin. perush im haya oto issar mimmeot maaser sheni shel demay veachal asara chalakim meachad asar chalakim shebbo, kegon sheachad asar rimmonim shavin issar, veachal alav asara rimmonim venishar bo adayin chelek meachad asar bikdushshat maaser, yatza chullo lechullin. veim haya haissar mimmeot maaser sheni shel vadday veachal alav ad shennishar bo echad mimmea, kegon shemmea teenim nimkarim beissar, veachal alav tishim vetisha, yatza chullo lechullin:

Bet shammay omrim hakkol asara. echad vadday veechad demay, keshello nishar baissar ella asirito yatza lechullin. kegon shehayu asara rimmonim nimkarin beissar, veachal alav tisha, yatza lechullin. veim nishar bo yoter, kegon shello achal ella shemona, tzarich leechol kenegdo:

Uvet hillel omrim bavvadday achad asar uvaddemay asara. im nishar al haissar shel vadday echad measara chayyav leechol alav od [echad], lefi shekkol ma shehu pachot mishsheve feruta en choshshin lo, lo leinyan gazel, velo leinyan nehene min hahekdesh. vfruta hi echad mishshemona baissar haittalki nimtza asirit haissar hu shemone asiriyyot shel peruta dehaynu peruta pachot chomesh, nimtza keshettosif alav chomesh dehu revia millegav hayenu chumsha millevar yihye [ben] hakkol peruta, ulefichach choshshim lah. veim yihye pachot measirito en choshshim lo, sheafillu im tosefet hachomesh yihye vo pachot mishsheve feruta. ulefichach amru bavvadday achad asar, uvaddemay asara, lefi sheen chayyavin chomesh al haddemay, vaasirito hu pachot mishsheve feruta, vahalacha kevet hillel:
Besela laka. mitchakkech haya bassela velaka:
Hayu shenayim rodfin achar echad. shene shevarim shel shene bene adam rodfim achar shor shel adam echad:
Shenehem peturim. detarvayhu maddechu leh:

Shenehem chayyavim. baggemara mefaresh lematnitin kegon sheshshenehem tammin, sheen hattam meshallem ella miggufo. vechi itnehu letarvayhu kamman mishtallem hannizzak chatzi nizko mibben shenehem, aval letnehu letarvayhu matze amar leh zil ayte reaya dehay tora azzekach vaashallem lach:
Gadol hizzik. veyesh begufo shave chatzi nezek:
Katan hizzik. udeme hakkatan tikkach, umotar chatzi nizkecha tafsid:

Katan hizzik et haggadol. veaf al pi shechatzi nizko shel gadol merubbe, lo tikkach ella katan shelli, vachatzi nizko shel katan shellecha kach min haggadol. vechol hanach hammotzi mechavero alav haraya ditninan bematnitin, im lo hevi reaya en lo kelum, vaafillu deme tam, vaafillu katan shehoda lo en lo, shehattoen et chavero chittin vehoda lo bisorim patur af middeme seorim. vei tafas hannizzak shiur ma shehoda lo hammazzik, lo mappekinan minneh:
Harimmon sheamru. dichli shennikkav bemotzi rimmon tahor:
Ulema huzkeru rimmone vadan. kevan sheen meshaarin bahen, ella verimmon benoni:
Sheyyehu mekaddeshim bahen. sheim echad merimmone vadan shel arla o shel kile hakkerem nitarev im elef rimmonim shel hetter, nitkaddeshu kullan veneesru. ma sheen ken berimmonim shel shear mekomot:
Badan. shem makom:
Leshaer bo et hakkelim. kasavar demotzi rimmon dechelim, berimmone vadan meshaarinan:

Amar rabbi yehuda lo huzkeru rimmone vadan vechulei. aval leinyan kiddush en chilluk ben rimmone vadan lishar rimmonim, dechullan mekaddeshim, desavar rabbi yehuda kol sheddarko limmanot mekaddesh. beferek hattaarovot uveresh massechet betza:

Badan vegeva. shene mekomot shel kutim hen, venikkarim hayu rimmonim vechatzir shel mekomot hallalu [merimmon vechatzir] shel shear mekomot. vechutae vadday lo meassere may dimzabbene leacharine, delo chayshe allifne ivver lo titten michshol, af al gav dilnafshayhu meassere. hilkach mitasserim vadday bechol makom:
Chatzire. karti 592 belaaz. kemo et hechatzir veet habbetzalim (Bamidbar 11):
Uvashsheviit. sheen sechar shemira velo avodat karka, podehu veshavyo:

Im haya hakkol mufkar. im hifkiru habbealim neta revai shellahem, en hazzoche vo menakke ella sechar lekita, umaale happerot lirushalayim o fode umaale haddamim. velo amrinan kevan demehefkera ka zache en din revai noheg bo. uvashsheviit eno menakke sechar lekita, shekkol adam melakket leatzmo:
Mosif alav chomesh. setam matnitin kevet hillel deyalfe kodesh kodesh mimmaaser:
Uven shennittan lo bemattana. keshehu semadar, deillu leachar shennigmar bishshulo ha savre vet hillel demamon gavoah hu kemaaser veen yecholim litten oto bemattana:
Velo min hattalush al hamechubbar vechulei. dehaynu min hachiyyuv al happatur umin happatur al hachiyyuv:
Velo min hechadash al hayyashan. dichtiv (Devarim 14) hayyotze hassade shana shana, velo mishshana zo al shel chavertah:
Velo shachachti millevarechcha umillehazkir shimcha alav. lefi shemmevarchim lehaferish teruma. vechen al maaser rishon vesheni umasar ani, ulefidyon maaser sheni, ulechalla, al kullan mevarchim:

Ben er ben yashen. im haya yashen uva acher veyashan betziddo, vehizzik sheni larishon, chayyav. veim hizzik rishon lashsheni, patur. veim shachvu yachad, kol echad mehem shehizzik et chavero chayyav, lefi sheshshenehem muadim ze laze:
Simme et en chavero. afillu beshogeg chayyav bannezek. aval lo bearbaa devarim, delo michayyav bearbaa devarim ella mezid, o karov lemezid:
Kol kele vaale vattim shiuran berimmonim. im nikkevu bemotzi rimmon, tehorim:

Rabbi eliezer omer bema shehen. kol hakkelim shiuran kesheen reuyin lehishtammesh bahen meen hattashmish shehayu mishtammeshim bahen techilla, kegon kelim hameyuchadim latteenim shiuran bemotzi teena, vehameyuchadim lazzetim shiuran bemotzi zayit. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Kuppot haggannanim. kuppot baale hagginnot sheasuyin litten bahem yerakot:
Shiuran bemotzi aguddot yarak. uveha mode tanna kamma lerabbi eliezer deen shiuran bemotzi rimmon:
Beteven. bemotzi teven:
Gevava. teven dak meorav bezevel. targum lekoshesh kash (Shemot 5), legabbava gila. vehabballanim dehaynu baale hammerchatzaot sorfin oto vammerchatzaot:
Kullan berimmonim. ben shel baale vattim ben shel gannanim. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua:
